sub: Phrasing corrections from the session that built this page
subZh: 製作本頁時的對話修正

entries.o: 製作互動式頁面，中英文版，主要英文，歸類相同類別，function, 參數等名稱替換為代名詞
nat: **Turn these notes into an interactive page in** English and Chinese, mainly English. **Group** entries of the same type **together**, and replace function and parameter names with **placeholders**.

Could you **turn these notes into an interactive page in** English and Chinese, mainly English? **Group** entries of the same type **together**, and replace function and parameter names with **placeholders**.
entries.k: 中文片語串轉英文時要補成完整句：**turn X into Y**（把筆記做成頁面）；「歸類」= **group … together**；「代名詞」在這裡指程式的佔位名稱，英文是 **placeholders**——pronoun 是文法上的代名詞（it / they）。
entries.ken: When turning a string of Chinese fragments into English, build full sentences: **turn X into Y** ("make the notes into a page"); 「歸類」 is **group … together**; 「代名詞」 here means stand-in names in code — **placeholders**. A *pronoun* is the grammar term (it / they).

entries.o: 互動式介面一律用暗黑背景
nat: **Always** use **a dark background** for interactive interfaces.
**Interactive UIs should always** have **a dark background**.
entries.k: 「一律」= **always**，放句首加強規則語氣；陳述規範也可用 **X should always …**；「暗黑背景」= **a dark background / dark mode**，black background 太絕對（純黑）。
entries.ken: 「一律」 is **always** — put it first to sound like a rule; for a standing guideline, **X should always …** also works. 「暗黑背景」 is **a dark background / dark mode**; *black background* sounds too literal (pure black).

entries.o: 不要出現Foo by foo，這會以為是一樣的東西
nat: **Don't use** `Foo` and `foo` in the same entry — **it looks like** they're the same thing.
entries.k: 「會以為」缺主詞，英文要補 **it looks like … / people will think …**；「不要出現」= **don't use / avoid**，不說 don't appear（appear 不及物，主詞得是東西本身：Foo shouldn't appear with foo）。
entries.ken: 「會以為」 has no subject; English needs one — **it looks like … / people will think …**. 「不要出現」 is **don't use / avoid**, not *don't appear* (appear is intransitive; the thing itself must be the subject: *`Foo` shouldn't appear alongside `foo`*).

entries.o: the key points description in english version also have to be english / your correct phrasing this conversation also need to save into this page
nat: The key points **in** the **English** version need **to** be in English **too**.
The phrasing corrections you gave me **in** **this conversation** should also be saved **to** this page.
entries.k: **correct 當形容詞是「正確的」**，「你修正過的說法」要用過去分詞 **corrected phrasing / your corrections**；主詞是「說法」這種東西時要用被動 **need to be saved**；**this conversation 前缺介係詞 in**；存到頁面用 **save to**；English 要大寫；also 放句尾改 **too** 更口語。
entries.ken: *Correct* as an adjective means "right"; for "the phrasing you corrected" use the past participle — **corrected phrasing / your corrections**. When the subject is a thing, use the passive: **need to be saved** (*need to save* means the phrasing saves something). Add **in** before *this conversation*; you save **to** a page; capitalise **English**; ending with **too** sounds more natural than *also*.

entries.o: could "the formatting tests" a general name that can represent all the features?
nat: **Could** "the formatting tests" **work as** a general name that covers any feature?
**Is "the formatting tests" generic enough to** **stand for** any feature?
entries.k: **could 後面缺動詞**——could X **be / work as** a name（could ＋名詞直接接名詞不成句）；「代表任何一個功能」用 **stand for / cover any feature**，represent all the features 會被讀成「同時代表全部功能」；問「夠不夠通用」最道地是 **Is X generic enough to …?**
entries.ken: **could is missing a verb** — could X **be / work as** a name (could + noun straight into another noun isn't a sentence). "Represent any one feature" is **stand for / cover any feature**; *represent all the features* reads as representing every feature at once. The most idiomatic way to ask "is it general enough" is **Is X generic enough to …?**

entries.o: what would you translate ""Fold 這個功能 into file-b.js"?"
nat: **How** would this be said in English?
**How** would you say this in English?
**How** would you translate this phrase?
entries.k: 問「怎麼翻」用 **How**，不用 **What**——translate 已經以 X 為受詞，what 沒有位置可放（what would you translate 是在問「你會翻譯什麼東西」）；要用 what 就改成 **What's the English for X?**；引號只用一層，問號放引號外。
entries.ken: **Ask "how to translate" with How, not What** — *translate* already takes X as its object, so *what* has no slot (*what would you translate* asks "which thing would you translate"). To use *what*, say **What's the English for X?** Use one set of quotes, with the question mark outside.

entries.o: ok, add your example "Fold scattered tests back into the main file" to native part too
nat: **OK**. Also add the example "Fold scattered tests back into **the** main file" to **the native-speaker section**.
**OK**. Also add your example "Fold scattered tests back into **the** main file" to **the native-speaker section**.
entries.k: 特定的段落要冠詞 **the**——to **the** native-speaker section；**native part** 太含糊，講清楚是 **the native-speaker section / the Native line**；句首 ok 寫成 **OK**，接續指令另起一句。
entries.ken: A specific section needs **the** — to **the** native-speaker section. **native part** is vague; say **the native-speaker section / the Native line**. Write **OK** in caps and start the instruction as a new sentence.

entries.o: since it is at native part, remove it from key points
nat: Since **it's** **in** **the** native-speaker section now, remove it from the key points.
entries.k: 段落／區塊用 **in** 不用 at——**in** the native-speaker section（at 是「某個點／位置」，如 at the top、at line 5）；**the** key points 要冠詞（指那一條的重點）；口語縮寫 **it's** 比 it is 自然。
entries.ken: A section takes **in**, not *at* — **in** the native-speaker section (*at* is for a point or position: at the top, at line 5). **the** key points needs the article (that entry's key points). The contraction **it's** sounds more natural than *it is*.

entries.o: mark the keyword bold in native
nat: **Bold** **the** **key phrase** in **the native-speaker lines**.
**Put the keyword in bold** in the native-speaker **section**.
entries.k: **bold 本身就能當動詞**——bold X，不必 mark X bold（mark 偏「標記、打勾」）；也可說 **put X in bold**；特定段落要冠詞 **the**，且 native 單獨不是名詞——**the native-speaker lines / section**（同第 103、104 條）；這裡要加粗的是一組片語（fold … into），用 **key phrase** 比 keyword 精準。
entries.ken: **bold works as a verb on its own** — bold X; no need for *mark X bold* (*mark* leans toward tagging/ticking). You can also say **put X in bold**. A specific section needs **the**, and *native* alone isn't a noun — **the native-speaker lines / section** (same as Prepositions #103, #104). What's being bolded is a phrase (fold … into), so **key phrase** is more precise than *keyword*.

entries.o: can I say "fold file-a.js into file-b.js."?
nat: Is "**Fold** `file-a.js` into `file-b.js`" correct?
Can I say "**Fold** `file-a.js` into `file-b.js`"?
entries.k: 句子正確；只差標點——引號內的句號與外面的問號重複，**引述句尾的句號要拿掉**，問號放引號外（引述的不是問句）；引述的句子首字母大寫 **Fold**。
entries.ken: The sentence is correct; only punctuation — the period inside the quotes doubles up with the question mark outside. **Drop the quoted period** and keep the question mark outside the quotes (what you're quoting isn't a question). Capitalise the quoted sentence: **Fold**.

entries.o: could you 重新編號
nat: **Renumber** **the entries**.
Could you **renumber** **the entries**?
entries.k: 「重新編號」= **renumber**（一個動詞）；renumber 及物要受詞——renumber **the entries**（缺受詞同動詞與受詞系列）；請求句收問號。
entries.ken: 「重新編號」 is **renumber** (a single verb). *renumber* is transitive — renumber **the entries** (missing object, same as Verb & Object). End the request with a question mark.

entries.o: group the "clean/cleaner/cleanest" together
nat: **Group** the "clean / cleaner / cleanest" **entries** **together**.
entries.k: 引號片語當修飾語後面要接名詞——the "clean" **entries** together（同 Could you・group 系列「the "get rid of" mistakes」，引號片語放名詞前）；並列選項用斜線時前後留空格 **clean / cleaner / cleanest**，讀起來才像三個選項。
entries.ken: A quoted phrase as a modifier still needs a noun after it — the "clean" **entries** together (same as "Could you" · group: the "get rid of" mistakes, quoted phrase before the noun). When listing options with slashes, add spaces — **clean / cleaner / cleanest** — so they read as three options.

entries.o: remove words like "（正確，依指示收錄）" / "原句文法正確。更道地：" move to the key points, and fix it in every item
nat: Remove **tags** like "(correct, saved as requested)", move "Your sentence is correct. More natural:" into the key points, and **apply the same fix to every entry**.
entries.k: 括號裡的標記用 **tags / notes** 比 words 精準；「每一條都照改」= **apply the same fix to every entry**——fix it 會讓人以為是修 bug；頁面上一條叫 **entry**，item 偏清單項目。
entries.ken: For bracketed labels **tags / notes** is more precise than *words*. "Do the same for every one" is **apply the same fix to every entry** — *fix it* sounds like repairing a bug; on this page each one is an **entry** (*item* suggests a list item).

entries.o: unbold "take , not ", since they are 連接詞 not 重點, and apply the same fix to every entry
nat: Unbold "take" and ", not" — they're just **connecting words**, **not the key point**. Apply the same fix to every entry.
entries.k: 「連接詞」在這裡指的是說明用的串場字，英文說 **connecting words / filler words**——conjunction 專指 and / but / or 這類文法上的連接詞；「不是重點」= **not the key point**；兩個指令拆成兩句比用 and 串長句清楚。
entries.ken: The linking words here are **connecting words / filler words** — *conjunctions* technically means grammatical joiners like and / but / or. "Not the important part" is **not the key point**. Splitting the two instructions into two sentences reads more clearly than one long *and* sentence.

entries.o: when Search results, mark keywords in different color
nat: **Highlight** **the search terms** in **a** different colour **in the search results**.
**When I search**, **highlight** the matching words.
entries.k: **when 後面要接完整子句**——when Search results 沒有動詞，改 **In the search results, …** 或 **When I search, …**（同 when 子句缺主詞系列）；搜尋時輸入的字叫 **the search terms**，「上色標出」慣用 **highlight**；**a** different colour 要冠詞；search 句中不大寫。
entries.ken: **when needs a full clause** — *when Search results* has no verb; use **In the search results, …** or **When I search, …** (same as the when-clause series). The words you typed are **the search terms**, and the usual verb for colouring them is **highlight**. **a** different colour needs the article; don't capitalise *search* mid-sentence.

entries.o: move the Vue-specific category at the end
nat: **Move** the Vue category **to** the end.
**Put** the Vue category **last**.
entries.k: **move 表示移動的目的地用 to**——move X **to** the end；at the end 是描述「已經在那裡」的位置；口語也可說 **put X last**；Vue-specific 在這裡可省，category 本身就叫 Vue。
entries.ken: **move takes to for the destination** — move X **to** the end; *at the end* describes where something already is. Casually you can also say **put X last**. *Vue-specific* can go — the category is already called Vue.

entries.o: move this kind of "cleaner " to the "clean" category too
nat: Move **entries like** "Would it be cleaner to fold `FOO` into `BAR`?" into the "clean" **series** too.
entries.k: **this kind of "cleaner"** 指的是這個字，你要搬的是**條目**——**entries like …**；「clean / cleaner / cleanest」是慣用說法底下的**系列 series**，不是 category；引號內不要留多餘空格（"cleaner "）。
entries.ken: **this kind of "cleaner"** points at the word, but you mean the entries — **entries like …**. "clean / cleaner / cleanest" is a **series** inside Idiomatic Phrasing, not a category. Don't leave a stray space inside the quotes ("cleaner ").

entries.o: mark "What's the cleanest way to" and "pull ...from" in different, and apply this issue to others
nat: Show "What's the cleanest way to" and "pull … from" **in different colours**, and **apply the same fix to** the other entries.
entries.k: **in different 後面缺名詞**——in different **colours**；「套用到其他條」是 **apply the same fix to** the others（apply this issue 是「套用這個問題」，語意相反，同慣用說法第 111 條）；省略號用 **…** 或 "..." 前後留空格（pull … from）。
entries.ken: **in different is missing its noun** — in different **colours**. "Apply to the others" is **apply the same fix to** the others (*apply this issue* means applying the problem; same as Idiomatic #111). Write the ellipsis as **…** with spaces around it (pull … from).

entries.o: replace "…" with bullet … and mark the color "get" in native "How do I get the keys out of FOO[op].children?" / apply the same to others
nat: Replace that key point **with these bullet points**: … Also **colour "get"** in **the native line** "How do I get the keys out of `FOO[op].children`?", and apply the same **to the other entries**.
entries.k: **with bullet 缺名詞與複數**——with these **bullet points** / a **bulleted list**；**mark the color "get"** 受詞重複，說 **colour "get"** 或 **highlight "get" in the same colour**；native 單獨不是名詞，補 **the native line**（同介係詞與冠詞第 103–105 條）；apply the same **to the other entries**。
entries.ken: **with bullet is missing its noun and plural** — with these **bullet points** / a **bulleted list**. **mark the color "get"** doubles up the object; say **colour "get"** or **highlight "get" in the same colour**. *native* alone isn't a noun — **the native line** (same as Prepositions #103–105). Apply the same **to the other entries**.

entries.o: the bullet needs 縮排
nat: The **bullets** **need to be indented**.
**Indent** the bullets.
entries.k: 「縮排」= **indent**；主詞是被縮排的東西要用被動 **need to be indented**（同被動語態錯型）；有好幾個點要用複數 **bullets**；最短的說法是祈使句 **Indent the bullets.**
entries.ken: 「縮排」 is **indent**. The bullets are what gets indented, so use the passive **need to be indented** (same passive-voice issue). There are several, so use the plural **bullets**. The shortest version is the imperative **Indent the bullets.**

entries.o: explain what is "gerund ", "transitive " in a new tab and how to use them
nat: Explain **what a "gerund" and a "transitive verb" are** in a new tab, and how to use them.
Could you add a new tab explaining **gerunds** and **transitive verbs**, with how to use them?
entries.k: **間接問句不倒裝**——explain **what X is**，不是 what is X（同拼字與易混字・describe 那條、文法結構 why you didn't 的嵌套問句規則）；兩個術語要冠詞與完整名詞——**a** gerund、**a transitive verb**（transitive 是形容詞）；並列兩項用 **and**；引號內不留空格。
entries.ken: **Embedded questions don't invert** — explain **what X is**, not *what is X* (same rule as the other embedded-question entries). Give both terms articles and full nouns — **a** gerund, **a transitive verb** (*transitive* is an adjective). Join the two with **and**; no stray spaces inside the quotes.

entries.o: add infinitive too
nat: Add a card for **the infinitive** too.
Add **infinitives** too.
entries.k: 文法術語當名詞用要冠詞或複數——**the** infinitive / **infinitives**（同可數名詞要冠詞系列）；要講清楚加的是什麼可補 **a card for**。
entries.ken: A grammar term used as a noun needs an article or the plural — **the** infinitive / **infinitives** (same as the countable-noun article entries). To say what you're adding, use **a card for …**.

entries.o: remove Chinglish from native, it is not the native way I need to learn
nat: Remove the Chinglish from **the native-speaker lines** — that's not **the native phrasing to learn**.
Remove the Chinglish from **the native-speaker lines**. That's not **the native phrasing I want to learn**.
entries.k: **the** native-speaker lines 要冠詞與名詞——native 單獨不是名詞（同介係詞與冠詞第 103–105 條）；兩個完整句用逗號連是 comma splice，拆句或用破折號；「我要學的說法」= **the phrasing I want to learn**，the native way 偏「本地人的方式（習俗）」。
entries.ken: **the** native-speaker lines needs the article and noun — *native* alone isn't a noun (same as Prepositions #103–105). Two full sentences joined by a comma is a comma splice; split them or use a dash. "The way I want to learn" is **the phrasing I want to learn**; *the native way* sounds like "the locals' customs".

entries.o: fix this bug in every item
nat: Fix this bug in every **entry**.
entries.k: 這頁上的一條叫 **entry**，item 偏清單項目（同慣用說法第 111 條，**第二次**）；this bug 要讓對方知道指哪個——附截圖或點名條目。
entries.ken: On this page each one is an **entry**; *item* suggests a list item (same as Idiomatic #111, **second time**). Make *this bug* clear — attach a screenshot or name the entry.

entries.o: like How about moving this into a shared helper? still in native
nat: **For example**, "How about moving this into a shared helper?" **still isn't bold** in **the native-speaker line**.
entries.k: 舉例開頭用 **For example, …** 或 **e.g.**，單獨一個 like 會讀成「喜歡」；「還在 native 裡」要說出**問題是什麼**——**still isn't bold / still isn't highlighted**；native 後補 **the native-speaker line**（同介係詞與冠詞第 103–105 條，**第五次**）。
entries.ken: Start an example with **For example, …** or **e.g.** — a bare *like* can read as the verb. "Still in native" should say **what's wrong** — **still isn't bold / still isn't highlighted**. Give *native* its noun: **the native-speaker line** (same as Prepositions #103–105, **fifth time**).

entries.o: "How about moving this into a shared helper?" "How about refactoring it like this?" 直接從 native 移除
nat: **Remove** "How about moving this into a shared helper?" and "How about refactoring it like this?" **from the native-speaker lines**.
entries.k: 「直接移除」= **remove X from Y**（remove 的介係詞用 **from**）；native 後補 **the native-speaker lines**（同介係詞與冠詞第 103–105 條）；兩句並列用 **and**。
entries.ken: "Just remove" is **remove X from Y** — *remove* takes **from**. Give *native* its noun: **the native-speaker lines** (same as Prepositions #103–105). Join the two quotes with **and**.

entries.o: add an input area that I can put something I want to replace, when I click the sending button, you will replace it
nat: Add an input box **where** the text to replace **can be typed** — clicking **Send** should replace it.
Add an input box **where** I can **type** what I want to replace — when I click **Send**, replace it.
entries.k: **an input area that I can put something** 少了介係詞，地點要用 **where**（= in which）；「輸入」用 **type / enter**，put 太籠統；按鈕叫 **the Send button**，sending button 不自然；when 子句後面不必加 you will，直接祈使句 **replace it**。
entries.ken: **an input area that I can put something** is missing a preposition — for a place use **where** (= in which). "Input" is **type / enter**; *put* is too vague. The button is **the Send button**; *sending button* sounds off. After the when-clause, skip *you will* and use the imperative **replace it**.

entries.o: send it to you, and you would suggest the better way to replace with
nat: Send it for review and **suggest** a better replacement.
Send it to you, and you **suggest** a better replacement.
**Have it send** the text to you so you can **suggest a better replacement**.
entries.k: **would** 是假設語氣，描述你要的功能用現在式 **suggest** 或 **so you can suggest**；「更好的替換」= **a better replacement**，the better way to replace with 結尾掛介係詞又多了 the；說明「讓 A 做 B」用 **have it + 原形**（同不定詞・let / make / have 規則）。
entries.ken: **would** is hypothetical; to describe the feature you want, use the present **suggest** or **so you can suggest**. "A better way to replace with" is simply **a better replacement** — the original dangles a preposition and adds an extra *the*. "Make it do B" is **have it + base verb** (see Infinitive · let / make / have).

entries.o: if I enter * in text to replace, * means any, like SOCMSSPP-*
nat: Treat `*` in the "text to replace" box as a **wildcard** — `SOCMSSPP-*` should match **any** ticket number.
If I type `*` in the "text to replace" box, treat it as a **wildcard** — `SOCMSSPP-*` should match **any** ticket number.
entries.k: 「* 代表任意」= **a wildcard** / **\* matches anything**——any 單獨當補語不完整，要說 any **what**（any ticket number / any characters）；欄位名稱加引號與 **box**（the "text to replace" box）；描述你要的行為用 **treat it as …**。
entries.ken: "* means any" is **a wildcard** / **\* matches anything** — *any* on its own is incomplete; say any **what** (any ticket number / any characters). Quote the field name and add **box** (the "text to replace" box). To describe the behaviour you want, use **treat it as …**.

entries.o: If I type somthing in the 'text to replace' box, 連動搜尋框
nat: Typing in the "text to replace" box should **update the search box** to match.
When I type something in the "text to replace" box, **update the search box** to match.
Keep the search box **in sync with** the "text to replace" box.
entries.k: 「連動」= **keep X in sync with Y** / **update X to match**；**something** 拼字少了 e（somthing）；條件句後要接主要子句的動作，祈使句 **update the search box** 即可。
entries.ken: 「連動」 is **keep X in sync with Y** / **update X to match**. **something** is missing an e (*somthing*). After the if-clause, give the main action as an imperative: **update the search box**.

entries.o: when I click send button, 你會直接取代，而不是新增一個過濾條件
nat: Clicking **Send** should just **do the replacement** — not add it as **a filter**.
When I click **Send**, just **do the replacement** — don't add it as **a filter**.
Clicking **Send** should **replace the text directly**, not **add a filter**.
entries.k: 按鈕名稱前要冠詞或直接用名稱——**the Send button** / **Send**；「直接取代」= **replace it directly / just do the replacement**；「而不是」= **instead of + V-ing** 或 **…, not …**；「過濾條件」= **a filter**。
entries.ken: A button needs *the* or just its name — **the Send button** / **Send**. 「直接取代」 is **replace it directly / just do the replacement**. 「而不是」 is **instead of + -ing** or **…, not …**. 「過濾條件」 is **a filter**.

entries.o: 'text to replace' box replace all, including "You wrote"
nat: The "text to replace" box should **replace every match**, including **the ones in** "You wrote".
entries.k: 主詞是 box、動詞要有情態——**should replace**（box replace 少了 s 也少了 should）；replace all 要說出 all **what**：**every match / all occurrences**；**including the ones in …** 指出範圍。
entries.ken: With *the box* as subject, the verb needs a modal — **should replace** (*box replace* is missing both -s and *should*). *replace all* should say all **what**: **every match / all occurrences**. Use **including the ones in …** for the scope.

entries.o: "replace with" box 是取代成一模一樣的字
nat: Text in the "replace with" box should be inserted **exactly as is**.
Whatever I type in the "replace with" box should be inserted **exactly as is**.
The "replace with" text is used **verbatim**.
entries.k: 「一模一樣地放進去」= **exactly as is / verbatim / as-is**；描述規則用 **should be inserted** 被動（同及物動詞・被動規則）。
entries.ken: 「一模一樣」 here is **exactly as is / verbatim / as-is**. To state the rule, use the passive **should be inserted** (see Transitive verb · passive).

entries.o: the stylish like bold and color are gone
nat: The **styling**, like the bold and the colours, **is gone**.
The bold text and colours **disappeared**.
entries.k: **stylish** 是形容詞「時髦的」，名詞「樣式」是 **styling / formatting**；主詞 styling 是不可數單數，動詞用 **is gone**；bold、colour 當名詞要冠詞 **the**。
entries.ken: **stylish** is an adjective ("fashionable"); the noun for 「樣式」 is **styling / formatting**. *Styling* is uncountable, so the verb is **is gone**. *bold* and *colour* as nouns need **the**.

entries.o: add a switch if I don't want * as a wildcard
nat: Add a **toggle** to **turn off** `*` as a wildcard.
Add a **toggle** so I can **turn off** `*` as a wildcard.
Add a switch **in case** I don't want `*` **to act as** a wildcard.
entries.k: 「萬一不想要」用 **in case** 或 **so I can turn it off**，if 會讀成「只有在我不想要時才加開關」；開關 UI 常說 **toggle**；**want X to act as Y** 比 want X as Y 完整。
entries.ken: For "in case I don't want it", use **in case** or **so I can turn it off**; *if* reads as "add the switch only when I don't want it". The UI control is usually a **toggle**. **want X to act as Y** is more complete than *want X as Y*.

entries.o: when I switch the toggle, 沒有重新過濾
nat: Flipping the toggle **doesn't re-filter** the list.
When I flip the toggle, the list **doesn't re-filter**.
Switching the toggle **doesn't update the results**.
entries.k: 「切換開關」= **flip / switch / turn on-off the toggle**；「沒有重新過濾」= **doesn't re-filter / doesn't update the results**，回報 bug 用現在式描述行為。
entries.ken: 「切換開關」 is **flip / switch the toggle**. 「沒有重新過濾」 is **doesn't re-filter / doesn't update the results** — describe bug behaviour in the present tense.

entries.o: when I enter "TICKET*" in the "text to replace", the result is wrong
nat: Typing `TICKET*` in the "text to replace" **box** gives **the wrong results**.
When I type `TICKET*` in the "text to replace" **box**, the results **are wrong**.
`TICKET*` in the "text to replace" box **gives the wrong results**.
entries.k: 欄位名稱後補名詞 **box**（同第 10029 條）；搜尋結果通常用複數 **the results are wrong**；回報時最好補一句**預期 vs 實際**——"I expected X, but got Y"。
entries.ken: Add the noun **box** after the field name (same as the wildcard entry). Search output is usually plural — **the results are wrong**. When reporting, add **expected vs actual**: "I expected X, but got Y".

entries.o: "text to replace" need to include the space, not just one word
nat: The "text to replace" box **should** also **match across spaces**, not just a single word.
`*` should be able to **span multiple words**.
entries.k: 主詞是 box 單數，動詞要 **needs** 或用 **should**（同第 10032 條 box replace）；「包含空白」的意思其實是**可以跨多個字比對**——**match across spaces / span multiple words**；**a single word** 比 one word 更明確。
entries.ken: With *the box* as a singular subject, use **needs** or **should** (same as the "box replace" entry). "Include the space" really means **match across spaces / span multiple words**. **a single word** is clearer than *one word*.

entries.o: add a "text to mark" box
nat: Add a "text to **highlight**" box.
Add a box where I can type text to **bold**.
entries.k: 「標記」在 UI 上通常說 **highlight**（上色）或 **bold**（粗體），mark 比較籠統，最好講清楚要哪種效果。
entries.ken: For 「標記」 in a UI, say **highlight** (colour) or **bold**; *mark* is vague, so name the effect you want.

entries.o: add a "group together" box
nat: Add a box for **grouping** matching entries **together**.
**Add a** "group together" **box**.
entries.k: 原句可用；把「歸組」說得更明確可用動名詞 **grouping … together**（box **for** + V-ing，同動名詞・介係詞後接 -ing）。
entries.ken: Your sentence works. To be more specific, use the gerund **grouping … together** (a box **for** + -ing; see Gerund · after a preposition).

entries.o: "group together" box 裡面會是自然語言，需要解析，並非完全等於 ／ What I type in the 'text to mark' box will be natural language, so it needs to be interpreted, not matched exactly
nat: Input in the "group together" box will be **natural language**, so it needs to be **interpreted**, not **matched exactly**.
What I type in the "group together" box will be **natural language**, so it needs to be **interpreted**, not **matched exactly**.
Input in the "text to mark" box will be **natural language**, so it needs to be **interpreted**, not **matched exactly**.
What I type in the "text to mark" box will be **natural language**, so it needs to be **interpreted**, not **matched exactly**.
entries.k:
「解析」對自然語言說 **interpret / parse**；「並非完全等於」= **not matched exactly / not an exact match**；用 **so** 連接原因與結果。
完全正確——上一條的說法已經內化；改用雙引號 "…" 標示欄位名稱，與前幾條一致。
entries.ken: For natural language, 「解析」 is **interpret / parse**. 「並非完全等於」 is **not matched exactly / not an exact match**. Link cause and result with **so**.

entries.o: add a suggestion button for "'text to mark'"
nat: Add a **Suggest** button to the "text to mark" box.
entries.k: 按鈕通常直接用按鈕上的字稱呼——**a Suggest button**；「給某欄位加按鈕」介係詞用 **to**（add X **to** the box）；引號不要雙層 "'…'"。
entries.ken: Refer to a button by its label — **a Suggest button**. Adding it to a field takes **to** (add X **to** the box). Don't nest quotes "'…'".

entries.o: add a meaning description  for color
nat: Add a **legend** that explains **what each colour means**.
Add a **colour key**.
entries.k: 說明顏色意義的圖例英文叫 **legend / colour key**；「說明…的意思」= **explain what X means**（間接問句不倒裝，同文法術語那條）；a meaning description 是中式直譯。
entries.ken: A chart or UI guide to colours is a **legend / colour key**. "Describe the meaning" is **explain what X means** (no inversion in embedded questions). *A meaning description* is a literal translation.

entries.o: Add a colour key at the left, which below "Code names → placeholders"
nat: Add a colour key **on the left**, **below** "Code names → placeholders".
Put the colour key **in the sidebar**, **under** the "Code names → placeholders" box.
entries.k: 位置「在左邊」用 **on the left**（at the left 較少用）；which below 缺動詞，關係子句要 which **is** below，但直接用介係詞片語 **below …** 更簡潔；左側欄英文常說 **the sidebar**。
entries.ken: "On the left side" is **on the left** (*at the left* is less common). *which below* is missing its verb (*which **is** below*), but a plain prepositional phrase **below …** is tighter. The left column is usually **the sidebar**.

entries.o: yellow for 1st key phrase
nat: Use **yellow for the first** key phrase.
**Make** the first key phrase **yellow**.
entries.k: 片語可用，但完整句需要動詞——**Use yellow for …** / **Make X yellow**；序數前要 **the**（the first）。
entries.ken: Works as a note, but a full sentence needs a verb — **Use yellow for …** / **Make X yellow**. Ordinals take **the** (the first).

entries.o: replace pink to other color
nat: **Replace** pink **with** another colour.
**Change** the pink **to** something else.
entries.k: **replace A with B**（replace 不接 to，同 replace 系列）；或用 **change A to B**；other 接單數可數名詞要用 **another**（another colour）。
entries.ken: It's **replace A with B** — *replace* doesn't take *to* (see the replace series). Or use **change A to B**. Before a singular countable noun, use **another**, not *other*.

entries.o: switch third and fourth color
nat: **Swap the** third and fourth colours.
entries.k: 互換兩者用 **swap**（switch 也可）；序數前加 **the**，兩個顏色用複數 **colours**。
entries.ken: For exchanging two things, **swap** is the usual verb (*switch* also works). Add **the** before the ordinals, and make it plural — **colours**.

entries.o: add search only in native
nat: **Add an option to** search only **the native-speaker lines**.
Let me **limit the search to** the native-speaker lines.
entries.k: **add 後面要有名詞**——add **an option to** search …（add search 缺了要加的東西）；native 單獨不是名詞——**the native-speaker lines**（同介係詞與冠詞第 103–105、108 條，**第五次**）；「把搜尋範圍限縮到」= **limit the search to X**。
entries.ken: **add needs a noun** — add **an option to** search … (*add search* is missing the thing being added). *native* alone isn't a noun — **the native-speaker lines** (same as Prepositions #103–105, #108 — **fifth time**). "Narrow the search to" is **limit the search to X**.

entries.o: 我偏好用第三人稱的敘述方式，像是不要用 you me I（you gave me / How would you / your example / Can I say）。幫我在這些相關的 native 加上優化的句子，順位放第一個
nat: An **impersonal** style is preferred — **no** *you*, *me* or *I*. **Add an impersonal version** to the related native-speaker lines and **put it first**.
I prefer an impersonal style, without *you*, *me* or *I*. Add an improved version to the related native-speaker lines and put it first.
entries.k: 「第三人稱、不用 you/me/I」英文常說 **impersonal style**（嚴格說是無人稱，不是 third person）；改寫三招：**祈使句**（Could you merge … → **Merge …**）、**被動**（Should we rename X → **Should X be renamed**）、**名詞化**（I tested it → **Tested:** …）；「放第一個」= **put it first**。
entries.ken: "No you / me / I" is usually called an **impersonal style** (strictly it's impersonal, not third person). Three ways to rewrite: **imperative** (Could you merge … → **Merge …**), **passive** (Should we rename X → **Should X be renamed**), and **noun-style notes** (I tested it → **Tested:** …). "Put it first" is **put it first**.

entries.o: 新增一個重新編號按鈕，不需要再更新 The notes file (english-phrasing-notes.md)
nat: Add a **Renumber** button. The notes file (`english-phrasing-notes.md`) **no longer needs to be updated**.
Add a Renumber button, and stop updating the notes file.
entries.k: 按鈕用上面的字稱呼——**a Renumber button**；「不需要再…」= **no longer needs to be …**（無人稱被動）或 **stop + V-ing**。
entries.ken: Name a button by its label — **a Renumber button**. "No need to … anymore" is **no longer needs to be …** (impersonal passive) or **stop + -ing**.

subZh: 時態、語態、助動詞、動詞用法

entries.o: what will be if split Foo whether is base?
nat: What **would** it look like if `Foo` **were** split **by** `bar`?
What **would** it look like if **we** split `Foo` **by** `bar`?
entries.k: 假設性問題用 would 不用 will；if 子句要有主詞（if **we** split）；「依條件拆分」用 split **by/on**，不能用 whether 掛句尾。

ex.label: 其他常見講法
items: 問影響／後果：What would happen if we split `Foo` into base and custom versions?
問值不值得做：Would it be worth splitting `Foo` based on `bar`?
請對方評估（工作情境很常用）：Can you assess what splitting `Foo` by `bar` would involve?
更口語、丟給同事討論：How would `Foo` look if we split it on the `bar` flag?

entries.o: use foo.response.data or the fixed message?
nat: **Should** `foo.response.data` **or the fixed message** be used?
**Should we use** `foo.response.data` **or the fixed message**?
**Which should** the login page show on 5xx — **the backend message or the fixed one**?
entries.k: 選擇題問句要有主詞＋助動詞——**Should we use A or B?**（動詞開頭沒問號語調是祈使句，同第 2 條「疑問句要有助動詞」）；二選一也可用 **Which should ... — A or B?**；「固定文案」= **the fixed message / a canned message**。

entries.o: need to limit NOT only has one nest AND, like before
nat: **NOT should only allow** **one level of nested AND**, like before.
**Limit** NOT **to** **a single nested AND**, the way it was before.
entries.k: **limit 後面接 to**——limit X **to** Y，不能接一個完整子句（limit NOT only has ... 是兩個動詞相撞，同第 65 條 follow name by 的錯型）；換成主詞開頭的 **NOT should only allow ...** 最順；**nest** 是動詞／名詞，當形容詞要用 **nested**（a nested AND）；句首 need to 缺主詞，補 **We need to** 或直接用祈使句 **Limit ...**；「一層巢狀」與「只能有一個」在英文要講清楚——**one level of nested AND**（深度）vs **a single nested AND**（數量），中文的「只有一個巢狀 AND」兩種都讀得通，寫英文時挑一個講明。

entries.o: could you suggest the color? if NOT->AND, this AND show green, seems strange
nat: Is there **a better colour scheme**? An AND inside a NOT still **shows** green, which **looks off**.
Could you suggest **a better colour scheme**? When an AND sits inside a NOT, it still **shows** green, which **looks off**.
entries.k: **第三人稱單數要加 -s**——this AND **shows**（同動詞與受詞系列多條的主謂一致問題）；**seems strange 缺主詞**，用關係代名詞接上去 **, which looks off** 最省事，或另起 **That looks odd.**（同第 142、80 條「when 子句／子句缺主詞」的家族錯型）；請對方提案用不定冠詞 **a better colour scheme**（the color 指「那個已知的顏色」，你要的是還沒決定的方案）；`NOT->AND` 這種箭頭寫法只適合筆記，講給人聽要展開成 **when an AND is nested inside a NOT**；「看起來怪怪的」母語者說 **looks off / looks odd**，strange 偏「詭異」語氣重。

entries.o: foo->bar need to put just bar, remove previous must
nat: When a NOT sits directly under the top-level AND, **put it straight into** `bar` — don't wrap it in another `foo` bool.
entries.k: **need 前面缺主詞**（**we need to** / 或直接用祈使句 **put it into …**，同第 67 條 need to limit、第 142 條的家族錯型）；`A->B` 箭頭只適合筆記，講給人聽要展開成 **when A contains B** 或 **A nested inside B**（同第 69 條）；**previous 不是「外面那層」**——指包在外面的那層用 **the enclosing / the surrounding wrapper**，previous 是「前一個」（時間或順序上的）；「直接放進去」用 **put it straight into X**，straight 比 just 更能表達「不要中間那層」。

entries.o: also AND-AND-NOT put it straight into foo — don't wrap it in another bar bool
nat: **Same for** **an AND inside an AND** — put the NOT straight into `foo`, don't wrap it in another `bar` bool.
entries.k: **also ＋ 名詞 ＋ 祈使句 中間缺連接**——要嘛用 **Same for X:**（最省字，工作對話最常用），要嘛補完整句 **This should also apply when …**；`also` 單獨放句首再接一個名詞片語，讀者會以為 AND-AND-NOT 是這句的主詞；`AND-AND-NOT` 這種連字號串法只有你自己看得懂，展開成 **an AND inside an AND** 或 **a NOT two levels down** 才不用猜（同第 69、71 條的箭頭寫法）；後半句沿用我的說法完全正確，把破折號換成逗號也可以。

entries.o: foo->foo->bar   , put the NOT straight into `bar`, don't wrap it in another `foo` bool.
nat: **When** a NOT sits two levels down — a bool inside `foo` with its own `bar` — **put it** straight into the top-level `bar` instead of leaving it wrapped in another `foo` bool.
entries.k: **與第 72 條同一個問題（箭頭寫法第三次出現）**——`A->B->C` 這種串法只有你自己看得懂，講給人聽要展開成 **a NOT two levels down** 或 **a bool inside `foo` with its own `bar`**；句子缺主詞與情境子句，用 **When …, put it …** 開頭才成句（同第 67、71 條 need to 缺主詞的家族）；逗號前不留空白（`bar   ,` → `bar,`）；後半句 **put the NOT straight into X, don't wrap it in another Y** 完全正確，是沿用第 71、72 條的說法（已內化）；「把巢狀的東西往上搬到最外層」母語者也常說 **hoist it to the top level / lift it up one level**。

entries.o: hide OR button if have one
nat: Hide **the OR button** once one already exists.
**The OR button** should disappear when there's already an OR block.
entries.k: **條件子句缺主詞**——if have one 不成句，要寫 **if there's already one** 或 **once one exists**（同第 67、71、82 條缺主詞的家族）；祈使句的受詞要帶冠詞 **the OR button**；「按鈕收起」母語者說 **hide it / it should disappear**，反過來描述顯示條件則用 **only show it when …**。

entries.o: rename t('key')＝OR in FOO
nat: **Rename** **it to** `t('key')` — "OR" — in `FOO`.
Use `t('key')` ("OR") **for the OR label** in `FOO`.
entries.k: **rename 要有受詞與 to**——rename **it to** X（同第 68 條的 rename A to B）；`＝` 是筆記符號，寫成句子要展開成破折號補充或括號 **`t('key')` ("OR")**；指明改哪一個欄位補 **for the OR label**，對方才不用回頭猜是哪一顆按鈕。

entries.o: [建議] 快捷條件插入 OR 不受「OR 入口已收起」限制, same as AND and NOT, so it is not an issue
nat: **That's the same as** AND and NOT, so **it's** not an issue.
**AND and NOT behave the same way** — not a problem.
entries.k: **反駁一個論點要有主詞**——**That's the same as …**，只寫 same as … 會像修飾前一個名詞而不是在下結論（同第 82、88 條缺主詞／冠詞的家族）；口語縮寫 **it's** 比 it is 自然；要更明確可換成 **AND and NOT behave the same way**（把「一樣」的內容講出來）；駁回審查意見的收尾母語者常說 **so it's working as intended / that's by design**。

entries.o: you can follow this rule to normalize clauses
nat: **These rules** apply **when normalising** clauses.
You can follow **these rules** **when normalising** clauses.
Use the old `FOO` rules **as the spec** **for normalising** clauses.
entries.k: 貼出來的是一張**六條**規則的表，要用複數 **these rules**（this rule 會讓人以為只看其中一條）；**to V 表示目的**在這裡讀起來像「遵循規則以便正規化」，若是「正規化時請照這些規則」用 **when normalising / for normalising** 更準；把舊程式當規格書可直接說 **use X as the spec**，對方就知道你不是要我恢復那段程式碼。

entries.o: what if use FOO to map i18n keys and replace BAR with baz, would you suggest a better name?
nat: **What if** `FOO` **were used** to **map ops to i18n keys and** `BAR` **replaced** with `baz()`? A better name is welcome too.
**What if** we **used** `FOO` to **map ops to i18n keys and replaced** `BAR` with `baz()`? Can you suggest a better name?
**Here's an idea** — `FOO` for the i18n keys, `baz()` instead of `BAR`. **Any better names**?
entries.k: **What if** 後面要接完整子句——要有主詞 **what if we use/used …**（同第 1 條 what will be if split 的缺主詞＋假設語氣）；**map A to B** 才完整，只說 map i18n keys 沒交代從什麼對應過去；兩個問題不能用逗號連（comma splice，同第 4、50 條）——各自加問號，或第二句縮成 **Any better names?**；提案再徵詢命名，母語者常用 **Here's an idea — …** 起頭。

entries.o: what would it look like if wrong setting FOO->BAR
nat: **What would it look like if** `FOO` **were wired to** `BAR` **by mistake**?
What happens **if** someone **misconfigures** `FOO`'s child as `BAR`?
entries.k: **What would it look like if** … 這個句型用對了（第 1 條已內化）；但 **if 子句還是要有主詞＋動詞**——if **it were set** / if **we set** …（wrong setting 是名詞片語，接在 if 後面不成句，同第 1 條）；「設錯」用副詞或動詞表達——**by mistake / incorrectly**，或直接用動詞 **misconfigure**，不要用 wrong 當前位修飾語；**箭頭 `->` 是筆記符號，寫成句子要還原成介係詞**——set／wire／point **X to Y**（同第 44 條）。

entries.o: not changing file-a.js, I meant if FOO->BAR
nat: **The point isn't** changing `file-a.js` — **the question is**, **what if** `FOO` **were** `BAR`?
**I didn't mean** changing `file-a.js` — **I meant**, **what if** `FOO` **were** `BAR`?
**Not** `file-a.js` — **what if** `BAZ[QUX]` **pointed at** `BAR` instead?
entries.k: **否定要有主詞＋助動詞**——**I didn't mean …** / **I wasn't asking about …**（not changing X 是分詞片語，單獨當句子不成立）；澄清誤會時 **I meant** 後面要接完整子句，假設情境用 **what if … were …**（與現實相反用過去式 were，同第 1、43 條的假設語氣）；**箭頭 `->` 同樣要還原成介係詞**——**were mapped to / pointed at / were changed to**（同第 43 條，第二次出現）；口語要快速否定對方的理解，開頭直接說 **Not X —** 也很自然。

entries.o: need to keep foo
nat: `foo` needs to **be kept**.
**We** need to **keep** `foo`.
**Please keep** `bar_key` **in the output**.
entries.k: **英文陳述句不能省主詞**——need to 前面要有 **We / I**（中文「要保留」可以無主詞，英文少了主詞會像筆記片語，同第 189 條 find it 讀成祈使句的問題）；要當成指令講就用 **Please keep …** 或祈使句 **Keep … in the output**；順帶把「保留在哪裡」講出來 **in the output / in the generated DSL**，對方不用猜。

entries.o: click edit button can paste ELK or BI query
nat: **Clicking** **the** edit button should **allow** **pasting in** **an** ELK or BI query.
**Clicking** **the** edit button should **let me** **paste in** **an** ELK or BI query.
The edit button should open a box where I can paste **an** ELK or BI query and overwrite **the** current one.
entries.k: **動作當主詞要用動名詞**——**Clicking** the button（click … can paste 是兩個動詞黏在一起，沒有主詞；同第 49 條 run-on 的問題）；「讓使用者能做某事」用 **let me / let the user + 原形**，或改以功能為主詞 **the button should open …**；**the** edit button、**an** ELK or BI query 補冠詞；「貼進去」口語用 **paste in**。

entries.o: what if change foo_key to hint, not button text
nat: **What if** `foo_key` **were made a hint** **instead of** the button text?
**What if** **we made** `foo_key` **a hint** **instead of** the button text?
How about showing `foo_key` as **a hint** **rather than** on the button?
entries.k: **What if** 後面要接完整子句——what if **we made / we turned** X into …（what if change 少了主詞，同慣用說法第 82 條 how about splice、本節第 124 條 click … can paste 的無主詞問題）；假設性提案動詞常用過去式 **made / turned**，語氣比 make 更像在商量；「而不是」= **instead of / rather than**，逗號接 not … 是中文語序；「提示文字」在 UI 語境說 **a hint / helper text**，tooltip 專指滑鼠停留才出現的那種。

entries.o: if FOO, bar= baz+qux.queryInfo, quux= qux.aggInfos
nat: **In custom mode**, **the preview's** `bar` **should be** `baz` **combined with** `qux.queryInfo`, and `quux` **should come from** `qux.aggInfos`.
entries.k: 規格式的 `A = B + C` 寫成句子要有動詞——**should be / should come from**；「合併」用 **combined with / merged with**，`+` 只在程式碼裡通；條件開頭 **In custom mode** 比 if FOO 自然（if 後面要接完整子句 if the mode is custom）；主詞補上「誰的 bar」——**the preview's** bar，對方才知道講的是 Dev Tools 預覽而不是儲存的資料。

entries.o: when index is null if type= FOO, use customer-event-hn-YYYY.MM else customer-event*
nat: **When the index is empty**, **fall back to** `customer-event-hn-YYYY.MM` for the LOGGER type, **otherwise** `customer-event*`.
If no index is set, **default to** … for LOGGER and … for everything else.
entries.k: 兩層條件要用句子接起來——**When X …, use A if …, otherwise B**（when … if … , use … else 是把程式碼的 if/else 直接唸出來，else 在英文句子裡要換成 **otherwise**）；「沒填就用預設值」慣用 **fall back to / default to**；前端「沒填」講 **empty / not set** 比 null 貼近使用者情境（null 是型別層的講法）；index 是特定那個欄位，加 **the**。

entries.o: rename text to dsl json or readonly?
nat: **Should** `text` **be renamed to something like** `foo` or `bar`?
**Should I rename** `text` **to something like** `foo` or `bar`?
**Would** `foo` **or** `readonly` **be a better name than** `text`?
entries.k: 問「該不該改名」要有主詞和助動詞——**Should I rename X to Y?**，光寫 rename … or …? 是祈使句加問號，母語者會以為你在下指令；候選名稱用 code 格式且照程式寫法連在一起（**`foo`**，不是 dsl json）；「哪個比較好」的問法是 **Would A or B be a better name than C?**。

entries.o: rename both file-a.js and file-b.js that can 對齊both side
nat: Rename both `file-a.js` and `file-b.js` so **the two names** **line up**.
Rename **both files** so they're consistent with each other.
entries.k: 「這樣才能…」表目的用 **so (that) …**，**that can** 少了主詞、也不是目的子句（同第 60 條 that 子句缺先行詞）；「對齊、一致」講 **line up / match / be consistent with each other**，「both side(s)」在這裡是中文直譯，英文直接說 **the two names / both files**；both 已經涵蓋兩者，後面不必再補 both side。

entries.o: terms, if equal to foo_key, do not convert
nat: **Go with** `terms`, but if the field is `foo_key`, **drop it** instead of converting.
**Map it to** `terms`, except when the field **is** `foo_key` — **skip** that one.
entries.k: 選定方案要有動詞 **Go with / Map it to terms**，光丟一個字 terms 對方得猜是在選還是在講別的；條件句主詞不能省——**if the field is `foo_key`**（if equal to 少了主詞與 be 動詞；「等於」在口語直接用 **is**，equal to 偏數學／程式語氣）；「不要轉、直接丟掉」講 **drop it / skip it**，do not convert 沒說清楚不轉之後要怎樣。

entries.o: only file-a.js equal to FOO do not show hn in dsl json, not module\file-b.js)
nat: Put the `FOO` check **only in** `file-a.js`, not in `file-b.js` — and when it's the general customer, leave the hn out of the DSL JSON entirely.
**Revert the** `file-b.js` **change**; handle the general customer in the strategy instead, and **don't put** the hn into the DSL at all.
entries.k: **一句塞了三件事卻沒有動詞把它們接起來**——「只在 A 做、不在 B 做」是 **only in** A, **not in** B，前面要有動作 **put the check / handle it**；**equal to** 又少了主詞與 be 動詞（同第 64、65 條，**第四次**，這次連 if 都省了）；「不要出現在 JSON 裡」講 **leave X out of the JSON / don't put X into the JSON**，do not show 是 UI 顯示的講法；要對方撤回前一步的修改直接說 **revert the X change**。

entries.o: fix file-a.js:193-196 寬鬆清理可能誤刪字串內的 //
nat: Also fix `file-a.js:193-196` — the lenient cleanup can **strip** `//` **inside strings**.
Make the comment **stripping** **string-aware** so it doesn't **eat** `//` inside JSON strings.
entries.k: 文法上只是把 review 條目的中文標題直接貼回來，英文要把它改成子句 **the cleanup can strip X inside strings**；「不要誤刪字串內的東西」程式圈說 **string-aware**（會辨識字串邊界）；「誤刪」可用 **eat / strip / swallow**，eat 最口語。

entries.o: if paste like [樣本], insert user.name wildcard
nat: **If someone** pastes this (with the wildcard value commented out), **still insert** a `user.name` wildcard condition.
When the pasted wildcard has no value, like in this sample, add the condition anyway with an empty value **instead of skipping it**.
entries.k: **if paste** 少了主詞——**if someone / the user pastes**；貼樣本時把「樣本的重點是什麼」講出來（**with the value commented out**），對方不用自己比對哪裡不一樣；「照樣加進去」用 **still insert / add it anyway**，並補 **instead of skipping it** 點出要改的行為。

entries.o: file-a.vue import { FOO as BAR,
nat: In `file-a.vue`, **alias the imports instead** — `import { FOO as BAR, … }` — so the rest of the file keeps the short names.
**Just alias them on import** in `file-a.vue` and leave the usages as `BAZ_*`.
entries.k: 整句只有檔名加半截程式碼，沒有動詞——要對方改做法時說 **alias the imports instead / just alias them on import**（**alias** 當動詞就是「用 as 取別名」）；貼半行程式碼當指令，前面加 **In <file>,** 定位、後面補 **so (that) …** 講目的，對方才知道是「取別名、其餘不動」而不是只改那一行。

entries.o: default time range empty, backend has supported foo
nat: Leave **the** default time range empty. The backend **already supports** `foo`.
The default time range **should be empty**; **the** backend **already supports** filtering by `foo`.
entries.k: 第一句**沒有動詞**——「預設為空」要說 **should be empty** 或用祈使句 **leave it empty**（default time range empty 只是三個詞排在一起）；**has supported → already supports**：講「現在就有這功能」用**現在式**，現在完成式 has supported 會被讀成「曾經支援過、現在未必」（時態選錯，同動詞與受詞系列第 17 條「描述慣常行為用現在式」）；backend 前補 **the**；兩句用逗號相連是 comma splice（同第 136 條），拆句或改分號。

entries.o: when reset value, UI Foo did not go back to first page
nat: After resetting **the** values, the Foo didn't go back to **the first page**.
After **I** reset **the** values, the Foo didn't go back to **the first page**.
**Resetting the filters doesn't** send the table back to **page 1**.
entries.k: **when 子句要有主詞**——when **I** reset the values（同動詞與受詞系列第 16、17、82 條與 Could you 系列第 27、40 條，**第六次出現**，值得刻意練：when / after / if 後面一定先放主詞）；**the first page** 補冠詞（或口語 **page 1**）；元件名前加 **the**，不需要 UI 當修飾語；回報 bug 也可把動作當主詞 **Resetting X doesn't …**，一句話講完現象。

entries.o: what is D1 顯示方式：新增小型 viewer 元件（採用）vs 內嵌複製既有 span 迴圈 vs 沿用 Foo
nat: **Please explain D1**, the three display options.
**Can you explain D1**, the three display options?
**What's the difference between** the three options in D1: **a new viewer component**, **inlining the span loop**, or reusing `Foo`?
entries.k: 要人「解釋一段內容」用 **can you explain X / walk me through X**，或 **what do you mean by X**（同第 146 條 what does X mean）；**what is X** 後面直接貼整段標題會讀成在問定義；比較幾個選項用 **what's the difference between A, B, and C**；把三個選項換成名詞片語 **a new viewer component / inlining the span loop / reusing Foo**，不要整段中文照貼。

entries.o: if foo, show the bar instead of full string, over120.png is not what expect
nat: When `foo` is true, the cell should show **the truncated text**, **not the full string**. See over120.png — that's not **the expected result**.
When `foo` is true, the cell should show **the truncated text**, **not the full string**. See over120.png — that's not **what I expected**.
entries.k: **what expect 缺主詞與時態**——**what I expected**（關係子句 what 後面要有完整的主詞＋動詞，同第 143 條缺主詞型）；**the bar → the truncated text**：函式名不能直接當名詞用，講結果用過去分詞修飾；指出截圖不符預期的兩句用句號或破折號分開，逗號直接黏是 comma splice（同第 4、50 條）；「而不是」用 **not X / rather than X** 比 instead of 更口語。

entries.o: if foo like this, remove all the item and leave fieldname
nat: When `foo` **looks like this**, **drop** all the rows and **keep** only **the field names**.
If every `result` is an empty object, **clear the rows** but **keep** the columns.
entries.k: **if X like this 缺動詞**——**looks like this**（like 是介係詞，前面要有動詞，同第 84 條 if 子句缺動詞型）；**all the item → all the items**（all the 後接可數複數，同第 148 條）；「留下欄位名」用 **keep (only) the field names**，leave 偏「放著不管／離開」（見 leave 系列）；「移除列」口語 **drop / clear the rows**；描述資料形狀可以講得更準——**every `result` is an empty object**，對方不必看 JSON 也懂。

entries.o: what does beforeEach issue
nat: **What's the issue with** `beforeEach`?
**What's wrong with the** `beforeEach`?
entries.k: **what does X issue 沒有動詞**——issue 在這裡是名詞，does 後面接不了它；問「X 有什麼問題」的固定句型是 **What's the issue with X?** 或 **What's wrong with X?**（第 33、34 條 what is X 問意思、本條 what does X 問問題，都是把中文「X 怎麼了」直翻成 what + X 的同一個毛病）；要對方指出 review 裡某條的細節也可說 **Can you elaborate on the `beforeEach` point?**

entries.o: how to fix assertion 讀私有狀態
nat: **How can** **the assertions that read private state** **be fixed**?
**How do I** fix **the assertions that read private state**?
**How should I** rewrite the assertions **so they don't read private state**?
entries.k: **how to** + 動詞單獨成句是片段（標題、搜尋關鍵字才這樣寫），對人發問要補主詞與助動詞 **How do I … / How should I …**；「讀私有狀態的 assertion」用關係子句 **the assertions that read private state**，或改講目標 **so they don't read private state**（與第 112 條 so it doesn't rely on 同型）；assertion 要複數，這類問題通常不只一條。

entries.o: option from 使用者自行輸入 and foo, bar
nat: **Take the options from user input plus** `foo` and `bar`.
Options should come from **free-text input** and the two ELK field lists, **not the loaded rows**.
entries.k: **沒有動詞**——「選項來自 X」要 **options come from X** 或指令式 **take the options from X**；options 可數複數；三個來源並列最後一個用 **and**，中間不能只用逗號（A, B 結尾會像沒講完）；要否定我原本的做法可補 **not the loaded rows**，對方一眼看出哪裡要改；「使用者自行輸入」= **free-text input / user-entered values**。

entries.o: take a look at file-a.html, if missing {}[] auto complete
nat: Take a look at `file-a.html` — **does it** **auto-close** missing **braces** and **brackets**?
Check **whether** `file-a.html` fills in missing `{}`
`[]`; if not, **let's add** that.
entries.k: **if missing** … **auto complete** 少了主詞、也不知道是問句還是指令——問「它有沒有做」用 **does it …?**，要加功能用 **let's add / add …**，兩者要分開講；「自動補上缺的括號」程式圈固定說 **auto-close / balance the brackets**（auto complete 是編輯器打字時的自動完成，意思不同）；`{}` 叫 **braces**、`[]` 叫 **brackets**（同拼字與易混字第 27 條的標點專名）；兩個子句用逗號連是 comma splice，用破折號或分號。

entries.o: also do not show hn if FOO
nat: Also, **don't** show **the hn** **for the general customer**.
And leave **the hn** blank when the customer is `FOO`.
entries.k: **if FOO** 少了主詞與動詞——常數不能自己當條件句，要 **if the customer is `FOO`** 或直接講人話 **for the general customer**（同第 138、139 條 if 子句省略主詞的問題，**第三次出現**）；**the hn** 冠詞（同第 39 條，第二次）；口語 **don't** 比 do not 自然，do not 偏規格書語氣。

entries.o: only sync file-a.vue
nat: **Just** **sync** `file-a.vue`.
Only **sync** `file-a.vue` — **leave** `file-b.vue` **as is**.
entries.k: 限縮範圍的祈使句慣用 **Just ...**（only 放句首偏「只做這件、別的都不要」的強調，單獨用會有點生硬）；要強調不動別的就把對象講出來——**leave ... as is**（同 leave 系列）；「同步成一樣」用 **sync ... with ...** 也可：Sync `file-a.vue` with `file-b.vue`。

entries.o: remove ，1000 筆約多花 0.5 秒
nat: **Drop** the "1,000 rows adds about 0.5s" part.
Remove the **bit** about 1,000 rows.
entries.k: 直接貼原文指定刪除範圍也可通。刪一小段文字慣用 **drop / remove the part (the bit) about X**——只丟 remove ＋一段原文對方要自己找範圍，加上 the part about 會更明確；**bit** 在口語中就是「一小段」，很常用於文件修改（cut that bit / reword this bit）。

entries.o: only update the description, will be slower
nat: **Just** update the description — being slower **is acceptable**.
**Just** update the description — **I'll live with it** being slower.
**Only** update the PR description; **the slower render is fine**.
entries.k: 後半子句**沒有主詞**，讀者得猜是誰變慢——接回主題說 **the slower render is fine**；表示「可以接受這個缺點」母語者常用 **I'll live with it / that's fine by me / I can accept that**；「只做 A 不做 B」用 **just / only** 都可以，**just** 語氣更輕。

entries.o: where did editor header title size define, H1=?px...
nat: Where is the editor's **heading font size** defined? **What's H1 in px**?
Where do the editor's heading sizes **come from** — and **what is H1 in px**?
entries.k: size 是「被定義」，要用被動 **is defined**（did ... define 是主動，語意變成「size 定義了什麼」，同第 2 條被動語態）；現在的狀態用 is 不用 did；編輯器裡的「標題大小」講 **heading font size**（header 在網頁多指頁首／表頭）；問數值另起一句 **What's H1 in px?**，不要寫成 `H1=?px` 這種筆記式縮寫。

entries.o: can (block.rules ?? []).map(foo) extract into a helper?
nat: Can `(block.rules ?? []).map(foo)` **be extracted** **into a helper**?
**Should we** **pull** that **into a helper**?
entries.k: **extract** 是及物動詞，主詞是被抽出來的東西時要用被動 be **extracted**（同第 63 條 size is defined 的被動語態錯型）；主動說法要補主詞 **Can we extract …?**；口語常用 **pull X into a helper / factor X out into a helper**；徵詢意見用 **Should we …?** 比 Can 更貼近「你覺得要不要」。

entries.o: rules are insert in block.rules.push(foo(item)) / block.rules.push(...inner.rules) will never run
nat: Rules only ever get **inserted** **by** `block.rules.push(foo(item))`, **so** `block.rules.push(...inner.rules)` never runs.
**Isn't** `block.rules.push(...inner.rules)` **dead code**? Rules are only added in the leaf branch.
entries.k: **被動語態要用過去分詞**——are **inserted**（are insert 是把原形動詞塞進 be 動詞後面，同第 63 條 size **is defined**）；動作者用 **by** 不用 in——inserted **by** that line；兩句要有因果連接詞 **so**，否則像各自獨立的兩個宣告；斷定對方寫的東西沒用時，用 **Isn't X dead code?** 這種附加問句比直述 will never run 更安全（同拼字節第 24 條），萬一結論不成立也不尷尬。

entries.o: what is this meant
nat: What **does** this **mean**?
**Can you explain** this finding?
entries.k: **mean** 是實義動詞，問句用助動詞 **does**——What **does** this mean?（同第 78 條 what is this mean，**第二次出現**）；這次多加了 -t 變成 **is meant**（被動），意思會跑成「這是被拿來做什麼用的」（what is this meant **for**），不是「這是什麼意思」；要對方解說一段 review 意見，也可直接說 **Can you walk me through this finding?**。

entries.o: should query-input rename to something that says it's transform transition
nat: Should `query-input` **be renamed** to something that says it's **a converter**?
Shouldn't the name of `query-input` say that **it transforms** the text into a DSL?
entries.k: 檔案是「被改名」的一方，要用被動 **be renamed**（should X rename 是 X 自己去改別人的名字，同第 81 條 suggest rename 少了結構）；「它是一個轉換」名詞要加冠詞且選一個詞——**a converter / a transformation / a parser**，**transform transition** 兩個詞疊在一起不成立（transition 是「過渡、轉場」，跟資料轉換無關）；描述模組做什麼最自然是用動詞句 **it transforms / converts A into B**。

entries.o: query-statement-view there is no view action in custom mode, so it can ignore
nat: `query-statement-view` **is never opened** in custom mode, so that warning can be ignored.
**There's no** "view" action **in custom mode**, so we **can drop** that one.
entries.k: **it can ignore → it can be ignored / we can ignore it**——被忽略的是那條警告，要用被動或把主詞換成 we（同第 61、82、84 條的主被動問題，**第四次**）；檔名開頭孤懸沒有介係詞，用 **for `query-statement-view`, …** 或直接讓它當主詞 **`query-statement-view` is never opened in …**；「沒有這個入口」講 **is never opened / there's no way to open it** 比 there is no view action 更像在講功能流程。

entries.o: any missing can insert [樣本]
nat: Can anything with missing pieces still **be inserted**? Here's the DSL the preview generates from a half-filled form — it should **round-trip** back into the form.
Can anything with missing pieces still **be inserted**? Here's the DSL our own preview generates from a half-filled form — it should **round-trip** back into the form.
Whatever is **missing a field name or value** should still **be inserted** as an empty row, not skipped.
entries.k: **any missing can insert** 三個字各缺一半——主詞要是名詞 **anything (that's) missing a value**，動詞要被動 **be inserted**（主被動問題第五次）；這個樣本的重點是「我們自己預覽產出的、半填表單的 DSL」，講出 **round-trip**（來回轉換後要還原）對方立刻懂目標；「缺欄位名或值」講 **missing a field name or value**。

entries.o: should they name a more identify name?
nat: **Should they have** more **descriptive** **names**?
Would more **specific** file **names** help here?
entries.k: **they name a name** 主詞錯了——檔案不會自己取名，說 **should they have / be given … names**（主被動問題第八次）；**identify** 是動詞，當形容詞要用 **descriptive / specific / distinctive**（同第 139、140 條的詞形混用）；name 當動詞與 name 當名詞不要疊在同一句。

entries.o: could it change to Promise.reject
nat: **Could it be changed** to `Promise.reject` **instead**?
What about rejecting **instead** of resolving with an empty list?
entries.k: **could it change → could it be changed**，那行程式碼是被改的一方（主被動問題第九次，這個模式出現最多次，值得刻意練：主詞是東西、動作是別人做的，就用 be + 過去分詞）；提替代方案句尾加 **instead**；也可以用 **what about -ing** 開頭把兩個選項對照著問。

entries.o: since catch do nothing, maybe these can remove?
nat: Since **the catch does** nothing, can it just be removed?
Since **the catch does** nothing, can we just remove it?
The catch block is **a no-op** — **can it go**?
entries.k: **the catch does**——單數主詞第三人稱要加 -s，且 catch 當名詞指那個區塊要加 **the**；**can remove → can be removed**，程式碼是被移除的一方要用被動（同第 61 條 should X rename 的主被動問題）；**these** 指的只有一個 catch，用 **it**；口語問「能不能拿掉」母語者常說 **can it go? / can we drop it?**；「什麼都不做的程式碼」有專門說法 **a no-op**。

entries.o: should it rename FOO_* to BAR_*? and rename BAZ_*?
nat: **Should `FOO_*` be renamed to `BAR_*`**? And what would be a better name for `BAZ_*`?
**Should we rename `FOO_*` to `BAR_*`**? And what would you call `BAZ_*`?
**Would** `BAR_*` **be a better name for** `FOO_*`? `BAZ_*` **could use a better name too**.
entries.k: **should it rename** 主詞錯了——常數不會自己改名，問句主詞是我們 **should we rename X to Y?**，或用被動 **should X be renamed?**（同第 61、82 條的主被動問題，**第三次**）；第二問只寫 rename BAZ_* 卻沒給候選名，對方不知道是問「要不要改」還是「改成什麼」，講清楚 **what would you call it? / what should it be renamed to?**。

entries.o: could Foo replace with Bar?
nat: Could `Foo` **be replaced with** `Bar`?
**Could we use** `Bar` **instead of** `Foo`?
entries.k: **replace with → be replaced with**——元件是被換掉的一方，主詞是東西、動作是別人做的就用 be + 過去分詞（主被動問題**第四次**，同第 61、82、84 條 could it change / can remove / should it rename）；或把主詞換成我們 **could we use B instead of A**，主動句也自然；順帶：**replace A with B** 的介係詞是 with，不是 to（見 Could you・replace 系列）。

entries.o: after this issue merge into dev, add a comment to the new ticket you created
nat: **Once** **this ticket is merged** into dev, **leave** a comment on the new ticket.
**Once** **this ticket is merged** into dev, **leave** a comment on the new ticket you created.
After this one **lands in dev**, drop a **note** on SOCMSSPP-2237.
entries.k: **this issue merge → this ticket is merged**：工單／分支是被合併的一方要用被動 be + 過去分詞（主被動問題**第五次**，同第 61、82、84、138 條），且第三人稱單數也不能用原形 merge；「在工單留言」慣用 **leave / drop a comment (note) on the ticket**（介係詞 on，同 Git・review 系列 leave a comment）；「等某事發生後」用 **once** 比 after 更有「一旦…就」的觸發意味；「合併進 dev」口語也說 **lands in dev**。

entries.o: when using Foo with query button always needs card-head-con, it is easy forget to add card-head-con
nat: **Whenever** `Foo` sits next **to** **the** query button, **it has to be wrapped in** `card-head-con`, **and that's** **easy to forget**.
`Foo` only lines up with **the** query button inside a `card-head-con`, **which is easy to miss**.
entries.k: **when using … always needs 整句沒有主詞**——分詞 using 不能當主詞，主句 needs 也找不到誰 need：補主詞 **when you use X …, you always need Y**，或改被動 **whenever X is used with …, it has to be wrapped in Y**（when 子句缺主詞同第 143 條，**第七次出現**）；**easy forget → easy to forget**：easy + **to** V 固定搭配；**the** query button 補冠詞；兩句用逗號相連是 comma splice（同第 4、50、68 條）——改 **and that's …** 或用關係子句 **which is easy to miss** 收尾；「容易漏掉」除了 forget 也常說 **easy to miss / easy to overlook**。

entries.o: save it and it will be review later
nat: Save it **for review later**.
Save it; **I'll review it later**.
**Save it for now** — it'll **be reviewed** later.
entries.k: 被動語態要用過去分詞 be **reviewed**（be review 與第 42 條 are insert、第 63 條 is defined 同型：原形動詞硬塞在 be 後面）；其實主動更自然 **I'll review it later**；「先存起來」= **save it for now**；兩句用分號或破折號，比 and 更能表達「存了之後再說」。

entries.o: suggestion 2: only when statuses are null will not rerequest. it can be ignore
nat: **On suggestion 2**: **it only skips the re-request** when `statuses` is null, so it can be ignored.
**On suggestion 2**: **it only skips the re-request** when `statuses` is null, so we can ignore it.
Suggestion 2 **only bites when** `statuses` is null — ignore it.
entries.k: **will not rerequest 沒有主詞**——誰不重送？補 **it won't re-request / it only skips the re-request**（缺主詞同第 143 條）；**can be ignore → can be ignored**（被動漏過去分詞，與第 105 條同型、同一天連犯兩次）；**re-request** 要連字號（re- 接 r 開頭的字），refetch 則不用；回應某條建議的開頭用 **On suggestion 2:**；「只在某情況才會發生」口語 **only bites when**。

entries.o: take a look at file-a.md / could you request api when select table fileters
nat: Take a look at file-a.md and make it **call** **the API** when a table filter is selected.
Take a look at file-a.md. Could you make it **call** **the API** when a table filter is selected?
…**when the user picks a filter** in the table?
entries.k: **when select 缺主詞**——when 子句要完整：**when a filter is selected**（被動）或 **when the user picks a filter**（主動），同第 84、109 條 if/when 子句缺動詞主詞型；**request 當動詞是「向人要求」**，呼叫 API 一律 **call / hit the API**（request 當名詞 an API request 才對）；**the API** 要冠詞；fileters 是 filters 的拼字誤植（打字滑掉，不另記拼字節）。

entries.o: why not answer me?
nat: Why **is there** no answer?
Why **aren't you** answering me?
Why **didn't you** reply?
entries.k: 疑問句要有助動詞；進行中用 aren't you ...ing，指過去那次用 didn't you。

entries.o: which is better? 5xx or server error
nat: **Which is better**, `5xx` **or** "server error"?
Which **reads better** as the option name — `5xx` or "server error"?
entries.k: 選項接在問句後面是**同一句**，中間用逗號或破折號，問號放最後（which is better? 5xx or ... 把句子切成兩半）；問「哪個名字比較好」可具體說 **reads better / is clearer**，並點明比的是什麼（as the option name）。

entries.o: does these need to be moving into foo?
nat: Do these **need to move** into `foo`?
**Should these move** into `foo`?
entries.k: 主詞 these 是複數，助動詞要用 **do** 不是 does；**need to move**（接原形不定詞）——need to be moving 是進行式，語意變成「需要正在移動中」；若要強調「該被搬過去」用被動 **need to be moved**；徵詢意見時 **Should these move ...?** 最自然（同第 2、3 條「疑問句要有助動詞」）。

entries.o: what is the suggestion mean
nat: What **do** **the suggestions** **mean**?
**What do you mean by those suggestions**?
**Can you explain what** **those suggestions** actually **mean**?
entries.k: **mean** 是一般動詞，疑問句的助動詞要用 **do/does**，不能用 is——`is ... mean` 兩個動詞疊在一起不成立（同第 2、3、64 條「疑問句要有助動詞」，本錯型第四次出現）；指對方剛列的那幾項是複數，用 **the suggestions / those suggestions**；請對方進一步解釋，母語者最常用 **What do you mean by X?**（問意圖）或 **Can you explain X?**（問細節），比單問 What does X mean? 更貼近「我沒看懂你的意思」。

entries.o: this not disappear
nat: This one **doesn't go away**.
This clause **is still showing** — **it should have been removed**.
entries.k: **否定句要有助動詞**——this **doesn't** disappear（同第 2、3、64、78 條「疑問句要有助動詞」的同一家族，否定句也一樣不能把 not 直接貼在原形動詞前）；口語講「沒有消失」最常用 **doesn't go away** 或 **is still showing / is still there**，disappear 偏書面；回報 bug 時補一句期待值 **it should have been removed**，對方才知道你認為正確行為是什麼，省一輪來回。

entries.o: does block.or. equal to block.[FOO].
nat: **Is** `block.or` **the same as** `block[FOO]`?
Does `block.or` **resolve to the same property** as `block[FOO]`?
entries.k: **equal** 當動詞是及物的，後面不加 **to**——A equals B（要用介係詞就寫 **be equal to** B）；問「兩者是不是同一件事」最自然的句型是 **Is A the same as B?**；句尾要用問號不是句號（同第 4、68 條標點系列）；技術語境想更精準可用 **resolve to the same property**（指向同一個屬性）。

entries.o: foo would always be null
nat: `foo` **is always null**, **isn't it**?
**Wouldn't** `foo` **always come out null**?
entries.k: **would 需要一個條件才成立**——沒有 if 子句或假設情境時，陳述觀察到的事實要用現在式 **is always null**（單寫 would 會讓對方找不到前提，不知道你在假設什麼）；要保留「我可能看錯」的語氣，就補成問句 —— **isn't it?** 附加問句，或 **Wouldn't it always …?**（這個「指出對方程式碼有問題時用附加問句」的技巧見拼字與易混字第 24 條，**這次方向抓對了、只差沒寫成問句**）。

entries.o: even this will not greater
nat: **Not even this** makes **either of them** **greater** than 1.
Even this doesn't **push** either length **above** 1.
entries.k: **greater 是形容詞，不能單獨當動詞**——will not **be** greater（同第 42 條 are insert、第 63 條 is defined 的「原形/形容詞硬塞進助動詞後面」）；或乾脆換成動詞 **exceed 1** / **go above 1**，句子更短；「連這個都不會」放句首語氣最強——**Not even this …**；主詞講清楚是那兩個 length（**either of them**），單寫 this 會被讀成「這段 JSON 本身不會變大」。

entries.o: I still cannot understand why didn't you use FOO.forEach(bar => {
nat: It's still **unclear** why `FOO.forEach(bar => …)` **wasn't** used.
I still **don't understand** why **you didn't** use `FOO.forEach(bar => …)`.
**I'm still not following** — **why did you go with** `baz` **instead of a** `FOO.forEach`?
entries.k: **間接問句要還原成直述語序**——why **you didn't** use（why didn't you use 是直接問句的倒裝，嵌在 I don't understand 後面就不能倒裝；這是第 2、3、63、42 條「疑問句要有助動詞」的**反面**——獨立問句要倒裝，嵌套問句反而不能）；**cannot understand 語氣偏重**（像「我無法理解你在想什麼」），日常說 **I don't understand** 或更軟的 **I'm still not following**；想直接要答案可改成獨立問句 **Why did you go with A instead of B?**，比包在 I don't understand 裡更清楚。

entries.o: bool use FOO?
nat: **Should** this `bool` use `FOO`?
**Shouldn't** `node.bool` **be** `node[FOO]`?
entries.k: **問句要有助動詞**——**Should** X use Y?（名詞＋動詞＋問號不成問句，同第 78 條 what is this mean、第 48 條的助動詞問題）；質疑「是不是該改成」用否定問句 **Shouldn't X be Y?** 語氣最貼；指程式碼裡的哪一個要說清楚 **this bool / node.bool**，單寫 bool 對方要猜是 DSL 的 key 還是 bar 的 name。

entries.o: why you added foo
nat: Why **was** `foo` **added**?
Why **did you add** `foo`?
**What's** `foo` **for**?
entries.k: **wh- 疑問句要有助動詞且倒裝**——why **did you add**（why you added 是直述句語序，母語者會覺得像在指責而不是在問）；過去式由 **did** 承擔，主要動詞回原形 **add**；問「這東西幹嘛用」也可直接說 **what's X for?**；疑問句收問號。

entries.o: what's FOO 建議 Object.freeze means
nat: **What does** the `Object.freeze` suggestion for `FOO` **mean**?
**What do you mean by** freezing `FOO`?
entries.k: **what's X means 有兩個動詞**（is + means）——問「什麼意思」固定句型 **what does X mean?**，does 承擔問句、mean 回原形（同第 9 條 what is the suggestion mean，**第二次**）；問對方「你那句是什麼意思」更口語的是 **what do you mean by …?**；「對某東西的建議」= **the suggestion for / about X**。

entries.o: filled.length 跟 block[filled[0]].length 甚麼情況會>1
nat: **When can** `filled.length` or `block[filled[0]].length` be **greater than 1**?
What input makes **either of those** lengths exceed 1?
entries.k: **中文的「跟」在疑問句裡要翻成 or 不是 and**——問「這兩個哪一個會發生」用 **or**（用 and 會變成問「兩個同時 >1」，是另一個問題）；要強調「任一個」可以更明確說 **either of those**；`>1` 在句子裡要唸出來——**greater than 1** 或 **more than one**，不要直接把符號塞進句子；「什麼情況會」問可能性用 **When can …?**，問觸發條件用 **What makes …?**

entries.o: so there is no need to write const filled = FOO.filter(...) filled.length === 1
nat: So **the** `filled` variable and the `filled.length === 1` check **aren't needed**, **right**?
So **we don't need the** `filled` variable or the `filled.length === 1` check, **right**?
Then `filled` and that first condition are redundant, **aren't they**?
entries.k: **there is no need to 偏書面**，口語討論程式碼用 **we don't need X** 或 **X is redundant**（一個字就講完）；**否定句裡並列兩個東西用 or 不用 and**——don't need A **or** B（同第 82 條問句的 or、第 83 條否定句的 either，**這是同一組「中文的『跟』在否定／疑問句要變 or」的第三次**）；下結論但想讓對方確認時句尾加 **right? / aren't they?**，否則聽起來像直接指示而非討論。

entries.o: this still not working
nat: This **still** **isn't** working.
**Still** broken — **here's the query I used**.
entries.k: **與第 13 條同一個錯（第二次出現）**——否定句少了 be 動詞／助動詞，working 是現在分詞，前面一定要有 **isn't**（this still **isn't** working）；**still 放在 isn't 前面**（this still isn't ≠ this isn't still，後者是「已經不是了」）；貼資料回報問題時補一句它是輸入還是輸出 —— **here's the query I used** / **this is what it saved**，否則對方得猜你指的是哪一端。

entries.o: use FOO, and write a file describe naming usage for later develop
nat: Go with `FOO`, and **write up a doc** **describing** the **naming conventions** for future **development**.
Let's use `FOO` — and **add a doc** on the **naming conventions** for whoever picks this up next.
entries.k: **名詞後面要用分詞才能修飾**——a file **describing** …（a file describe 是兩個動詞疊在一起），或用關係子句 a file **that describes**；**develop 是動詞，名詞是 development**——for future **development**，指人則說 **for future developers**（詞形混用，同拼字節第 24 條 undefine/undefined）；「命名慣例」的固定搭配是 **naming conventions**，naming usage 不是英文說法；「寫一份文件」動詞用 **write up a doc / add a doc**。

entries.o: fix import
nat: Fix the **import** hint text.
Fix the wording in the **import** hints — it **should say** "Import", not "OK".
entries.k: **import** 單獨一個字會被讀成 JS 的 **import** 語句，這裡指的是「匯入功能的提示文案」，要補名詞 **the import hint (text) / the import wording**；短指令若有多種解讀，加一句講清楚要改成什麼（it **should say** X, **not** Y），對方才不用靠游標猜。

entries.o: feedback this pr with backend link to guideline
nat: Feed this back **into** **the** guidelines: PRs with **a** backend dependency should link the backend PR by full URL.
**Based on this PR**, add **a** guideline note about linking backend PRs.
entries.k: **feedback** 是名詞，當動詞要拆成 **feed back**——feed this back **into / to** the guidelines；**the** guidelines、**a** backend link 冠詞；with backend link to guideline 三個名詞疊在一起，對方看不出「準則要新增什麼」——把規則內容講出來（should link the backend PR by full URL）；「依這個案例」= **based on this PR**。

entries.o: this foo will render error
nat: This `foo` will **throw** a **render error**.
Rendering this `foo` **blows up**.
entries.k: **render error** 不能當動詞片語——error 是名詞，要 **throw / cause a render error**，或換成動詞 **fail to render**（render error 讀起來像「把 error 畫出來」）；回報 bug 時附上「什麼資料」會更快——**with this `foo` (ten `{ result: {} }` items), the view throws**；口語「炸掉」= **blows up**。

entries.o: single commit, post the checklist to the ticket and start dev
nat: Single commit. Post the checklist to the ticket, then **start development**.
**Go with one commit**, post the checklist to the ticket, and **kick off the implementation**.
entries.k: **三個指令用逗號串成一句**——第一項 single commit 是名詞片語不是指令，接在後面的祈使句前要斷句或補動詞 **Go with one commit**；多個步驟依序講用 **..., then ...** 或 **A, B, and C**（三項以上最後一個 and 前加逗號，同第 4、50 條 comma splice 系列的「該斷不斷」）；「開始開發」口語 **start dev** 可通，完整講 **start development / start implementing / kick off the implementation**。

entries.o: if the field is overflow, hover to show the full string
nat: If a field name **overflows**, **show the full string on hover**.
When a field tag **gets cut off**, **show** the full name in a tooltip **on hover**.
entries.k: **overflow** 當動詞直接變化 **overflows**，is overflow 把動詞當形容詞用（形容詞是 overflowing / cut off / truncated）；「滑過時顯示」固定講 **show X on hover**，hover to show 讀起來像在叫對方去滑；UI 被截掉口語 **gets cut off / is truncated**。

entries.o: replace all the 貼上/貼 with 輸入 in all the change files
nat: Replace **every** "paste" with "type" across **the changed files**.
In all **the files we touched**, change "paste" to "type".
entries.k: **the changed files**——修飾名詞要用過去分詞 **changed**（change files 是「改檔案」的動詞片語，當形容詞用要 -ed，同文法結構裡 undefine/undefined 那類詞形問題）；「全部」講一次就好，**all the … / every …**，all the X … in all the Y 兩個 all 疊在一起很拗口；「在這批檔案裡」口語也常說 **the files we touched**。

entries.o: only file-a.md
nat: **Just** `file-a.md`.
**I meant only the** `file-a.md` **file**.
entries.k: 單獨的名詞片語當回答可通，但口語起頭用 **Just X** 更自然；完整澄清用 **I meant only X**（同第 28 條 I meant ... / I was referring to ...）；檔名當名詞要補 **the ... file** 句子才站得住。

entries.o: would you suggest rename FOO_* to BAR_* or BAZ_* or others?
nat: Is **renaming** `FOO_*` to `BAR_*` or `BAZ_*` **a good idea**?
Would you **suggest** **renaming** `FOO_*` to `BAR_*` or `BAZ_*`?
Do you think `FOO_*` should be renamed — to `BAR_*`, `BAZ_*`, **or something else**?
entries.k: **suggest 後面接動名詞**——suggest **renaming**，或改成子句 suggest that we rename；suggest 不能直接接原形動詞（同組還有 recommend / consider / avoid，都接 -ing）；**「或其他選項」是 or something else**，or **others** 指「其他人／其他東西（複數個體）」，用在這裡會被讀成「還是其他人？」；選項多時用破折號帶出 **— to `BAR_*`, `BAZ_*`, or something else?** 最好讀；**rename A to B** 沿用第 68 條的正確用法（已內化）。

entries.o: 用常數
nat: **Use** **the constants**.
**Let's use** **the constants**.
**Go with** **the constants**.
entries.k: 中文可以只丟一個動賓片語，英文要成句——最省字的兩種是 **Let's use X**（一起做的語氣）與 **Go with X**（在兩個選項中拍板）；複數 **the constants** 指剛才列的那批 `FOO_*`，單數 the constant 會像在講某一個；若要更明確可補範圍 **everywhere the key is an op**。

entries.o: in FOO mode paste query would not overwrite the aggregation
nat: In **custom mode**, **pasting** a query **shouldn't** overwrite the aggregation settings.
When editing a custom statement, an imported query should **leave the aggregations alone**.
entries.k: **動作當主詞要用動名詞**——**pasting** a query（paste query 是動詞原形直接當主詞，同第 51 條 click … can paste；可數名詞 query 也要冠詞 a）；講「應該如何」用 **shouldn't / should not**，**would not** 是在預測「不會發生」，不是在下規格；FOO mode 的 mode 重複了，講 **custom mode** 即可；「不動某東西」口語也可說 **leave X alone / leave X untouched**。

entries.o: where would you suggest button position
nat: Where **should** **the** buttons **go**?
Where would you **suggest** putting **the** buttons?
Where do you think **the** buttons should go?
entries.k: **suggest 後面接動名詞 suggest doing**——suggest putting / placing the buttons（suggest button position 是把名詞片語直接塞給 suggest，少了動作；同第 81 條 suggest rename 少了 -ing）；the buttons 要加 **the** 且用複數（指的是那三顆）；「該放哪」口語最自然是 **where should X go?**。

entries.o: does it necessary split file-a.js and file-b.js two files, or just merge to one file?
nat: **Is it necessary to** **split** `file-a.js` and `file-b.js` **into two files**, or should they just be **merged** **into one**?
**Do these really need to be two files**, or can we **merge** them?
entries.k: **does it necessary → is it necessary to + 動詞**（necessary 是形容詞，要配 be 動詞，後面接不定詞）；「拆成兩個檔」是 **split … into two files**，介係詞 into 不能省；「合併成一個」是 **merge … into one**（同 merge / fold into 系列，to 又錯成 into 的反向）；口語最簡短是 **do these really need to be two files?**。

entries.o: 在 API 層改回傳 Promise.resolve({ data: [] })
nat: **Go with the** API-side **fix**: **have** `foo` **return** `Promise.resolve({ data: [] })` for a blank id.
Let's **fix** it **in the API layer** — return an empty resolved promise instead.
entries.k: 從兩個選項挑一個時開頭說 **go with the … fix** 或 **let's fix it in …**（同第 80、64 條 go with）；「讓某函式回傳 X」是 **have X return Y**（have + 受詞 + 原形動詞）；「在 API 層」是 **in the API layer / on the API side**。

entries.o: how about move this into a share module
nat: What about **pulling** this **out into** `file-a.js`?
entries.k: **how about** 後面一律接動名詞 **moving**（how about + 原形是典型中式英文，同本節 how about refactoring、how about splicing、慣用說法 how about reusing，**第四次**）；**share module → shared**（第 140、142 條之後**第三次**，這個字請刻意練：名詞前永遠是 shared）；抽的是一段運算，用 **helper** 比 module 貼切；「拉出來」口語 **pull X out into …**（同第 142 條）。

entries.o: why didn't you save the phrasing notes? do you need more prompt?
nat: Why weren't the phrasing notes saved? Is more **prompting** needed?
Why didn't you save the phrasing notes? Do you need more **prompting**?
entries.k: 第一句全對；**prompt 是可數名詞**，要說 more prompt**ing**（動名詞）或 **a** stronger/more explicit prompt。

entries.o: Foo cannot show label and save key
nat: Foo can't show **the** label while saving the key.
Foo can't **display one thing and store another**.
entries.k: 可數名詞要冠詞——**the** label、**the** key；「一邊 A 一邊 B」用 **while ＋ V-ing**（and 只是並列，看不出「同時卻做不到」的對比）；「顯示 A 存 B」口語 = **display one thing and store another**。

entries.o: (how about) share t('key') with file-a.vue
nat: **Reuse** `t('key')` **in** `file-a.vue`.
Let's **reuse** `t('key')` **in** `file-a.vue`.
**How about** **reusing** the same `foo_key` text **in** `file-a.vue`?
entries.k: 共用同一份程式／文案用 **reuse ... in ...**（share ... with ... 多指「把東西分享給某人」，對檔案講會怪）；**how about** 後面一定接動名詞 —— how about **reusing**，不能 how about share；也可說 **have `file-a.vue` use the same ...**（同慣用說法第 66 條 single source of truth 的情境）。

entries.o: how about this, is this better?
nat: How about this**?** **Is this better?**
What about **this version** — **any better**?
entries.k: 兩個獨立問句不能用逗號連（comma splice），各自加問號或用破折號（同第 4 條標點問題，第二次出現）；口語追問「有沒有比較好」可縮成 **any better?**；「這一版」= **this version**。

entries.o: why did you use KIND_xxx, what does kind mean, could you replace it with CODE_xxx?
nat: Why `FOO_*`? What does "kind" mean **here**? **Rename it to `BAR_*`**.
Why did you use `FOO_*`? What does "kind" mean **here**? Could you **rename it to `BAR_*`**?
entries.k: **三個獨立問句不能用逗號串**（comma splice，同第 4、175、202 條與 Git 系列，這是你最頻繁的標點錯型）——各自收問號分成三句最清楚，讀的人也知道要回答三件事；文法本身全對，**what does kind mean** 的助動詞用對了（對照第 78 條 what is this mean 的錯型，已內化）；改名字用 **rename A to B** 比 replace A with B 精準——replace 常被理解成「換成另一個東西」，rename 才是「同一個東西改叫別的名字」；問術語意思時補 **here**（What does "kind" mean here?）能把問題限定在這段程式碼，不會被當成問英文單字。

entries.o: use foo, you can read the file
nat: **Go with** `foo`. **Feel free to** read the file.
**Let's go with** `foo`. **Feel free to** read the file.
**Go with** `foo` — and **yes, you can** read the file.
entries.k: 兩個獨立的指令用逗號連是 **comma splice**（同第 4、50 條、拼字與易混字第 26、28 條），斷成兩句或用破折號；「決定採用某個選項」慣用 **go with X** 或 **let's go with X**，比光頭的 use 更像在做決定；「准你去做某事」的授權語氣用 **feel free to …** 或 **go ahead and …**，you can 偏中性陳述能力，回答前一則「要我讀嗎」的請求時 **yes, you can / go ahead** 更像在回應。

entries.o: I test this UI seems what I expected
nat: **Tested** **in the UI** — **it looks as expected**.
I **tested** this **in the UI** and **it looks the way I expected**.
I **tried** it **in the UI** — the cards come out the way I expected.
entries.k: **講剛做完的測試要用過去式**——I **tested** / I **tried**（I test 是習慣性動作「我都會測」，同第 42 條時態誤用）；**兩個子句不能直接黏在一起**，要有連接詞——I tested this **and** it looks …，或用破折號分開（同第 50、68 條 comma splice 系列，這次是完全沒有標點的 run-on）；**seem** 後面接 **what** 子句要補 to be——it seems **to be** what I expected，不過母語者更常直接說 **it looks the way I expected** / **it works as expected**；「在畫面上測」是 **in the UI**（test this UI 會變成「我在測這個 UI 本身」，語意不同）。

entries.o: Foo and Bar didn't contain this, do they also have this bug? then baz should be put into a share module
nat: `Foo` and `Bar` **don't have** this. Do they have the same problem? **If so**, `baz` should **go into** a **shared** module.
Neither drawer sets this — do they have the same bug? **If they do**, let's **move** `baz` **into a shared module**.
entries.k: **didn't contain → don't have**：描述程式碼現在的樣子用現在式，didn't 會被讀成「過去某次沒有」（同第 137 條 has supported 的時態問題）；**share module → shared module**：名詞前的修飾要用過去分詞 **shared**（a shared component / a shared helper），share 是動詞；三個子句用逗號黏成一句是 comma splice（同第 136、137 條）——拆成三句，條件用 **if so / if they do** 承接前一句；「放進共用模組」口語 **go into / move X into a shared module**，比 be put into 精簡。

entries.o: what is the better way to ask like a english native speaker
nat: **How would** a native English speaker **phrase this**?
**What's a more natural way to** ask this?
entries.k: 「怎麼問比較道地」用 How would ... phrase this；a → **an** English。

entries.o: what will clearAllMocks 不清 once 佇列 happen
nat: **What happens if** `clearAllMocks` **doesn't** clear the once queue?
**What's the actual consequence** of that?
entries.k: **what will** … **happen** 把受詞夾在中間不成句——happen 是不及物動詞，前面只能是主詞 what：**What happens if/when X?**（條件放 if 子句，用現在式）；要對方講後果也可直接問 **What's the consequence?** 或 **So what breaks?**（口語）；與第 33、34、110 條同源：中文「X 會怎樣」直翻成 what + X 的習慣。

entries.o: still cannot select after hard refresh
nat: Still can't **select text** after **a** **hard refresh**.
**A hard refresh didn't help** — text selection is still broken.
entries.k: **hard refresh** 是可數單數，要冠詞——after **a** hard refresh（同第 13、19、16 條的冠詞漏字）；select 是及物動詞，要補受詞 **select text**（同文法結構・動詞與受詞系列第 6 條 add 缺受詞，本輪第二次出現，見慣用說法第 80 條）；回報「試了但沒用」母語者常說 **X didn't help** 或 **that didn't fix it**，比只說 still cannot 更明確地告訴對方「你的建議我試過了」。

entries.o: what if foo and bar share with the same consants?
nat: What if `foo` and `bar` just used **the same constants**?
Could `foo` and `bar` **share** **the same constants**?
entries.k: **share** 是及物動詞，共用某物後面不接 **with**——share **the same constants**；with 只用在「跟某人共享」(share it **with** me)（介係詞多餘，同第 14 條 put X to、第 23 條 remind me X 的介係詞誤用）；拼字 **constants**（consants 漏了 t）；假設語氣「如果改成…會怎樣」可用 **What if we just used ...**（同文法結構第 1 條 would 的假設句）。

entries.o: should foo rename like bar? ／ should foo rename to a better name? ／ should it rename to foo?
nat: Should `foo` **be renamed** **to** **something like** `bar`?
Should **we** **rename** `foo` **to** **something like** `bar`?
**Would** `bar` **be a better name for** `foo`?
Should `foo` be renamed to **something clearer**?
entries.k:
**rename 是及物動詞，要有人去改**——should **we** rename X（原句讓函式自己改名，像第 106 條 will not rerequest 缺主詞的反向：主詞放錯對象）；改名目標的介係詞是 **to**：rename X **to** Y，不確定名字時加 **something like**；只放 like 會變成「像 bar 那樣改名」的比較句。
**與第 115 條同一錯誤、連續兩句**——rename 的主詞是 **we**，函式不會自己改名；介係詞 to 這次對了；「更好的名字」口語 **something clearer / a better name for X**，第二種問法把焦點放在「有沒有」而不是「該不該」，更開放。
**與第 115、116 條同一錯誤，同一天第三次**——rename 的主詞是 **we**，it 是受詞要放在 rename 後面：should **we** rename **it** to Y；這次 to 與受詞 it 都對了，只差把人補回去。可改用不需主詞的句型避開：**Would Y be a better name?**

entries.o: 1, official suggest styles instead of class
nat: **Option 1**. **The official docs** **recommend** `styles` **over a class**.
**Go with 1** — the View UI docs suggest using `styles` rather than **a class**.
entries.k: **official 是形容詞，不能單獨當主詞**——要補名詞 **the official docs / the docs**；主詞單數，動詞要加 s：**suggests / recommends**（第三人稱單數，同第 82 條 the catch does）；**a class** 補冠詞（同介係詞與冠詞第 39 條，**第二次**）；「建議 A 而非 B」母語者常用 **recommend A over B**；選項編號回答用 **Option 1. / Go with 1.**，數字後接逗號直接黏下一句是 comma splice。
