entries.o: spec 以欄位定義直接呼叫 foo query-statement-page.spec.
nat: **What about** the "spec calls `foo` directly from the column definition" point?
**Can you expand on** that `foo` point in the spec review?
entries.k: 追問 review 裡的某一條，把條目標題當引號內的名詞片語，外面套 **What about "…"?**（要說法）或 **Can you expand on "…"?**（要解釋）；只貼標題＋檔名對方得猜你是要解釋、要修、還是不同意——加一個動詞就解決（與第 44 條「fix ＋ 條目標題」是同一個習慣的兩面）。

series.title: Verb & Object
notes: Would this be a better way to do it?
What if I did it like this instead?

entries.o: reply me how the native speaker will phrase first, after that then start think of real question
nat: Native phrasing first, then **get started on** the actual task.
Give me the native phrasing first, then **get started on** the actual task.
entries.k: reply 要說 **reply to me**（或直接 give me）；「開始做」用 get started on；start 後接 think**ing** about。

entries.o: why didn't you add to phrasing note
nat: Why wasn't **that** added to the phrasing **notes**?
Why didn't you add **that** to the phrasing **notes**?
entries.k: add 是及物動詞，後面要有受詞 —— add **that/it** to ...；筆記慣用複數 **notes**（或 the notes file）。（同類：every time 系列第 2 條的 add 缺受詞）

entries.o: you can get user's boss list in foo customer.userSignLevel, which spec is [{ id,name }]
nat: The user's boss list **comes from** `foo` — `customer.userSignLevel`, **whose** **shape** is `[{ id, name }]`.
You can get the user's boss list **from** `foo` — `customer.userSignLevel`, **whose** **shape** is `[{ id, name }]`.
entries.k: 「它的規格」關係代名詞用 **whose**（which 不能直接接名詞當所有格）；資料長相口語常說 **shape**；來源用 get ... **from**，不用 in。

entries.o: can I change to this?
nat: **Can it be changed to** this?
**Can I change it to** this?
entries.k: change 缺受詞**第三次出現**（同慣用說法・instead 系列第 45 條、Could you 系列第 15 條）——change **it/these** to ...；及物動詞後面一定要有東西被改。

entries.o: this foo need to share with Bar
nat: **These** `foo` need to **be shared** with `Bar`.
entries.k: 「需要被共用」是被動——need to **be shared**（need to share 是「需要去分享別人的東西」）；this＋複數名詞不合——**these** `foo` 或 this `foo` **array**。

entries.o: I've confirmed the backend use nest foo. bar will never equal to data.id
nat: Confirmed: the backend **uses** a **nested** `foo`, and `bar` will never equal `data.id`.
I've confirmed the backend **uses** a **nested** `foo`, and `bar` will never equal `data.id`.
entries.k: 第三人稱單數——the backend **uses**；「巢狀的」形容詞是 **nested**（nest 是名詞/動詞）；equal 當動詞是**及物**、不加 to（equals X），要用 to 就說 be equal **to** X；I've confirmed 用對了（Git 系列第 11 條的修正活用）。

entries.o: do I need to add more clearly description?
nat: Does the comment need to be **clearer**?
Do I need to make the comment **clearer**?
Should I add **a** **clearer** description?
entries.k: 修飾名詞用**形容詞**——a **clearer** description（clearly 是副詞，修飾動詞才對：describe it more **clearly**）；description 是可數名詞要冠詞 **a**。

entries.o: why you didn't give me and save (1) 回覆開頭先附範例 (2) 立刻把該句寫進筆記檔
nat: **Why wasn't** the native phrasing given and saved to the notes this time?
**Why didn't you** give me the native phrasing and save it to the notes this time?
entries.k: 直接問句助動詞要**前置**——**Why didn't you** ...（why you didn't 是間接問句語序，只能包在句中：I don't know why you didn't ...）；兩個動詞共用受詞要補齊——give me **X** and save **it**（同第 2、124 條的 why 問句與缺受詞）。

entries.o: whenever you create file, you need to create as CRLF file
nat: Create every new file as a CRLF file.
Whenever you create **a** file, create it as a CRLF file.
Always create files with CRLF **line endings**.
entries.k: file 可數要冠詞——create **a** file、a CRLF file；create 及物要受詞——create **it** as ...（缺受詞問題同動詞與受詞系列）；「換行格式」慣用 **line endings**（with CRLF line endings）。

entries.o: foo_key show wrong number when click the risk
nat: The show-more count **shows** **the** wrong number **when** **a risk level** is clicked.
The show-more count **shows** **the** wrong number **when** **I** click **a risk level**.
entries.k: 第三人稱單數——the count **shows**（同第 129 條 the backend uses）；**the** wrong number 要冠詞；**when 子句要主詞**——when **I** click（同第 1 條 if 子句缺主詞）；「風險等級」說完整 **a risk level**。

entries.o: switch 「全單位」與單一單位的即時事件列表 didn't reset
nat: The filter **doesn't** reset when **switching between the cross-department and single-department calendar views**.
The filter **doesn't** reset when I **switch between the cross-department and single-department calendar views**.
entries.k: 回報 bug 要說出**主詞**——是「篩選」沒重置（the filter doesn't reset）；「在 A 與 B 之間切換」= **switch between A and B**；描述慣常行為用**現在式 doesn't**（didn't 是指過去那一次）。

entries.o: this request only affect feedback to AI, so if error while saving is not a big deal
nat: This request only affects the AI feedback, so **an** error while saving isn't a big deal.
entries.k: 第三人稱單數——only affect**s**（同拼字與易混字第 6 條 doesn't affect 系列）；後半句的 **if 是冗贅**——直接說 so **an** error ... isn't a big deal（error 可數要冠詞）；**not a big deal** 用得很道地。

entries.o: why you call it 伴侶模組
nat: Why **is** it called **a** companion module?
Why **do** you call it **a** companion module?
entries.k: 疑問句要**助動詞**——why **do** you call（同第 2 條 why not answer me 的助動詞缺失）；call it **a** companion module 要冠詞。

entries.o: is it better move filter to uniqBy?
nat: **Would it be better to** move **the** filter into the `uniqBy` step?
entries.k: better 後接**不定詞**——better **to move**（is it better move 缺 to）；提案式問句慣用 **Would it be better to ...**（比 is it better 婉轉）；filter 要冠詞 **the**。

entries.o: would it be better if I write like this?
nat: Would it be better **written** like this?
Would it be better if I **wrote** it like this?
**Is** this way **better**?
entries.k: would 開頭的假設問句，if 子句用**過去式**——if I **wrote**（與 would 呼應的假設語氣）；write 及物要受詞——wrote **it**。

entries.o: and I haven't ready to commit
nat: And it's **not** **ready** to commit **yet**.
And I'**m not** **ready** to commit **yet**.
entries.k: **ready 是形容詞**要搭 be 動詞——I'**m not** ready（haven't 後面須接過去分詞：I haven't **finished**）；「還沒～」句尾補 **yet**。

entries.o: what would it look like 僅提醒未來新增呼叫端必須帶 selected
nat: **What would it look like** to remind future callers **to include** `selected`?
How would you **enforce that** future callers must pass `selected`?
entries.k: **What would it look like** 句型正確（第 1 條的修正內化）；後面接做法用 **to + 動詞**——to remind callers **to include** ...；「強制」= **enforce that ...**。

entries.o: where is it define foo="mdr"
nat: Where is `foo="mdr"` **defined**?
Where does the `foo` prop get **defined**?
entries.k: **被動**要過去分詞——where is it **defined**（同第 2 條 be written、第 199 條 be optimized 的被動缺失，**第三次出現**）；**it** 與後面的名詞重複，直接讓名詞當主詞：Where is X defined?

entries.o: move const FOO = 'mdr' to file-a.js?
nat: **Should** `const FOO = 'mdr'` **be moved into** `file-a.js`?
**Should we** move `const FOO = 'mdr'` **into** `file-a.js`?
**How about** moving `FOO` **to** `file-a.js`?
entries.k: 提案問句要有**句型**——**Should we ...?** 或 **How about + V-ing**（祈使句直接掛問號是便條式寫法，同第 137 條 is it better move 的提案句型問題）；move ... **into/to** a file。

entries.o: would you suggest to move it to a new js file?
nat: Would **moving** it to a new JS file **be better**?
Would you **suggest** **moving** it to a new JS file?
entries.k: **suggest / recommend** 後接動名詞——suggest **moving**（同第 125 條 worth **simplifying**：這類動詞不接 to 不定詞）；Would you suggest ...? 問句本身很道地。

entries.o: if foo include 'mdr', bar use BAZ, would it be too complicate to set and easy to forget setting?
nat: If `foo` **contains** 'mdr', should `bar` just default to `BAZ`? Having to set it separately feels **fiddly** and easy to forget.
entries.k: 形容詞 **complicated**（complicate 是動詞，同第 130 條 clearly/clearer 的詞性混用）；**forget to set**（forget + to V ＝忘了去做；forget + V-ing ＝忘了曾做過）；第三人稱單數 foo **contains** / bar **uses**；「太麻煩」= **fiddly / cumbersome**。

entries.o: can file-a.js ticket type define share with other function like file-b.vue ?
nat: Could the ticket type **constants** in `file-c.js` **be shared** with other **components**, like `file-d.vue`?
entries.k: **define 是動詞**，要名詞 **definitions / constants**（詞性混用同第 130、144 條）；「被共用」要被動 **be shared**（同第 128 條）；Vue 檔叫 **component**，function 是函式；長路徑放句中會很難讀，口語只講檔名。

entries.o: would it be better if always cut down too long word foo 截斷過長文字
nat: Would it be better if `foo` always **truncated** **overly long** **text**?
Should `foo` **truncate** by default?
entries.k: would ... if 假設句的 if 子句用**過去式**——if it always **truncated**（同第 138 條 if I wrote，第二次出現），且 if 子句要有主詞；「截斷」= **truncate / cut off**（cut down 是「減少數量」）；「文字」= **text**，word 是單字；「過長」= **overly long / too-long**。

entries.o: foo has reset bar
nat: `foo` **already** **resets** `bar`.
`bar` is **already** cleared in `foo`.
entries.k: 描述**程式碼固定行為**用現在簡單式 **resets**（has reset 是完成式，指「某次已經做過」）；「已經有處理」加 **already**；被動說法 is already cleared / handled in ...。

entries.o: go ahead with both, add index to FOO too
nat: Go ahead with both, and add `index` to `FOO` **as well**.
entries.k: 兩個祈使句只用逗號相連是 **comma splice**（同 Git 系列第 8 條），補 **and** 或用句號／破折號分開；go ahead with both、... too 都用得對，too 在正式一點的語境可換 **as well**。

entries.o: but current foo's key always equals to label
nat: But **right now**, `foo`' key is always the same as its label.
But **currently** every `foo` entry has key equal to label.
entries.k: **equals 是及物動詞，後面直接接受詞**——equals the label；要用 to 就得是 **is equal to**（兩者別混成 equals to）；「目前」當副詞說 **currently / right now**，current 是形容詞要接名詞（the current list）；以 s 結尾的名詞所有格寫 **foo'**。

entries.o: I have set file-a.json allow git add
nat: `git add` **is** now **allowed** **in** `file-a.json`.
**I've** **allowed** `git add` **in** `file-a.json`.
**I've** **updated** `file-a.json` **to allow** `git add`.
entries.k: 兩個動詞不能直接相連（set ... allow）——**set/update X to allow Y**（不定詞表目的），或直接說 **allowed Y in X**；口語完成式縮寫 **I've**。

entries.o: I've allowed `git add` in `file-a.json`, why you keep asking
nat: `git add` is already allowed in `file-a.json` — why **does** it keep asking?
I've allowed `git add` in `file-a.json` — why **do** you keep asking?
entries.k: 前半句全對（第 150 條的修正立刻活用）；直接問句要**助動詞**——why **do** you keep asking（why you keep asking 是間接問句語序；同第 2、131、136 條，**第四次出現**）；兩個獨立子句用破折號或句號分開（comma splice）。

entries.o: any branches which is the existing 既有長期整合分支 will not follow the issue-number convention
nat: **None of** the **existing long-lived integration branches** **will** follow the issue-number convention.
**Existing long-lived integration branches** don't follow the issue-number convention.
entries.k: 主詞動詞一致——branches **are**（which is 單複數不合）；「任何…都不會」英文用 **none of ... will** 或直接複數否定，不說 any ... will not；「既有長期整合分支」= **existing long-lived integration branches**（long-lived 比 long-term 更常用來形容分支）；the issue-number convention 用對了（Git 系列第 29 條內化）。

entries.o: foo do not valid bar
nat: `foo` **doesn't** **validate** `bar`.
entries.k: 第三人稱單數否定——**doesn't**（同第 129、133、135 條的 -s 系列）；**valid 是形容詞**，動詞是 **validate**（詞性混用同第 130 條 clearly/clearer、第 144 條 complicate/complicated）。

entries.o: change to only `foo` doesn't need to validate `bar`
nat: **Change it so** that only `foo` skips the `bar` validation.
**Make** `bar` validation **apply** everywhere **except** `foo`.
entries.k: change 及物要受詞，後接子句用 **change it so (that) ...**（change to 後面只能接名詞；缺受詞同第 127 條 change 系列，**第四次出現**）；「不需要驗證」= **skip the validation / make it optional**。

entries.o: it will match the wrong column if there is new line in column when export csv
nat: The CSV export **misaligns** the columns **when** a **cell** value contains a **newline**.
If a **cell** has a **newline** in it, the exported CSV puts values in the wrong columns.
entries.k: 「錯位」= **misalign / end up in the wrong columns**（match the wrong column 像在說比對邏輯）；**newline** 一個字；儲存格是 **cell**（column 是整欄）；**when 子句要主詞或動名詞**——when **exporting** the CSV（同第 133 條 when click，**第三次出現**）；描述固定行為用現在式，不用 will（同第 134 條）。

entries.o: what would matter if I remove table-container
nat: **What would break** if `table-container` **were removed**?
**What would break** if I **removed** `table-container`?
**What's affected** by removing the `table-container` class?
entries.k: 「會有什麼影響」慣用 **what would break / what's affected / what's the impact**（what would matter 是「什麼才重要」）；would 假設句 if 子句用**過去式**——if I **removed**（同第 138、146 條，**第三次出現**）。

entries.o: but there is no horizontal scroll if I leave the table-container class, even I add the style "overflow-x: auto" still
nat: But there's no horizontal **scrollbar** **even if** the `table-container` class **is kept** — adding `overflow-x: auto` manually **still doesn't help**.
But there's no horizontal **scrollbar** **even if** I **keep** the `table-container` class — adding `overflow-x: auto` manually **still doesn't help**.
entries.k: **even 不能直接接子句**——要 **even if / even though / even when** I add；句尾孤立的 still 放到動詞前（**still doesn't help / still doesn't show up**）；「保留」class 用 **keep**；捲軸是 **scrollbar**（scroll 是動作）。

entries.o: could it set width depends on the cell content?
nat: Could the column widths be **based on** the cell content?
Can it **size** each column **to fit its content**?
entries.k: **兩個動詞不能直接相連**——set width depends ✗，要 set the width **depending on / based on** ...（同第 149 條 set...allow、慣用說法第 34 條 fix...prevent）；「依內容自動調寬」慣用 **size ... to fit its content / auto-size columns**。

entries.o: if type equal SIEM, match the foo key to bar(indexes, state.app.elkSiemFieldMap)
nat: If `type` **equals** SIEM, **match** the `foo` **keys** **against** `bar(indexes, state.app.elkSiemFieldMap)`.
entries.k: 第三人稱單數——type **equals**（equal 缺 -s；equals 的及物用法同第 129、149 條）；「拿 A 與 B 比對」= **match A against B**（match ... to 偏「把 A 配給 B」）；多個 key 用複數 **keys**。

entries.o: if the base mode change type, clear the index
nat: **In base mode**, when the type **changes**, clear the index.
When the user **changes** the type **in base mode**, clear the index.
entries.k: 第三人稱單數——the type **changes**（-s 系列，同第 11、16、19、39 條）；「base 模式下」是情境，放句首 **In base mode,**——讓真正做動作的（the type／the user）當主詞；clear the index 用得對。

entries.o: there will be a duplicate code in either file-a.js or the consumer such as file-b.vue or file-c.vue, what will you suggest / also foo or bar param
nat: **Either way** there's **duplicated code** — in `file-a.js` or in consumers like `file-b.vue` and `file-c.vue`. **What's the better option**? Also, **which param name is better:** `foo` **or** `bar`?

**Either way** we end up with **duplicated code** — in `file-a.js` or in the consumers like `file-b.vue` and `file-c.vue`. **What would you suggest**? Also, **which param name do you prefer:** `foo` **or** `bar`?
entries.k: **duplicate code 不可數**，不加 a——用 **duplicated code / duplication**（冠詞問題同介係詞與冠詞節）；徵詢建議用假設語氣 **What would you suggest?**（同第 1、157 條 would，**第三次出現**）；逗號接 what ... 是 comma splice，要斷句或用破折號（同第 156、160 條）；**名詞片語不能單獨當問句**——要 **which param name do you prefer: A or B?**（同第 3 條 Should we use A or B?）；「不管走哪條路」= **Either way ...**。

entries.o: foo disappear
nat: **So** `foo` **disappears** from `file-a.vue`?
**So** `foo` **is no longer used** in the consumer, **right**?
entries.k: 第三人稱單數——**disappears**（-s 系列，同第 11、16、19、39、49 條，**第六次出現**）；名詞＋原形動詞不成句，口語確認句補 **So ... ?** 或句尾 **, right?**；「某個東西不再被用到／從檔案裡消失」慣用 **is no longer used / is gone from ...**。

entries.o: foo and bar are different, if go bar, sometimes it will never go through foo
nat: `foo` and `bar` **are separate flows** — **a request** that goes through `bar` **may never** **hit** `foo` at all.
`foo` and `bar` **are separate flows** — **if** **you** go through `bar`, you **may never** **hit** `foo` at all.
entries.k: **if 子句要有主詞**——if **you** go through / if **the user** goes through（同第 1 條 if we split）；**sometimes ... never 語意打架**，「不一定會走到」用 **may never / doesn't necessarily**；逗號接 if ... 是 comma splice，用破折號或句號斷開（同第 156、160、50 條）；are different 後面最好給名詞——**are separate flows / are two different paths**；「走到某個函式」= **hit / reach**（go through 偏「從頭跑完」）。

entries.o: if there is uncessary to add this prompt, then why did you mention in the previous commit?
nat: If **it's** **unnecessary** to add this rule, why **is it mentioned** in the commit message **in the first place**?
If **it's** **unnecessary** to add this rule, why did you **mention it** in the commit message **in the first place**?
entries.k: **there is 不能接形容詞**——虛主詞要用 **it's**：if **it's** unnecessary to ...；**拼字** uncessary → **unnecessary**（un + necessary，雙 n）；mention 及物要有受詞 **mention it**（同慣用說法第 62 條，第二次出現）；質問「當初為什麼要…」句尾加 **in the first place** 語氣才完整；then 在 if 子句後可省略（英文不像中文需要「就」）。

entries.o: commit-rules or commit-content-rules
nat: **Which is better** — `commit-rules` or `commit-content-rules`?
**Should it be** `commit-rules` or `commit-content-rules`?
entries.k: 與第 3 條**完全相同**的問題（選擇題丟兩個選項、沒有問句框架）——補 **Which is better —** 或 **Should it be ...?**；口語也可用 **Go with `commit-rules` or `commit-content-rules`?**，但至少要有動詞。

entries.o: skip the loop, open a PR
nat: **Skip** the loop **and** open **a PR**.
Skip the review loop — just open **the PR**.
entries.k: 兩個祈使句只用逗號相連是 comma splice（**第六次**，同第 156、160、50、165 條與慣用說法第 64 條）——補 **and** 或改破折號；指前面提過的那個 PR 用定冠詞 **the PR** 更自然（a PR 像在講「隨便開一個」）。

entries.o: when not base, Foo show Tables, close modal will not clear bar
nat: **When it's not the base group**, `Foo` **renders** `Tables`, and **closing the modal** doesn't clear `bar`.
**In non-base mode** `Foo` uses `Tables`, **so** `bar` isn't cleared when the modal closes.
entries.k: 三個點——(1) 第三人稱單數要加 s：**shows / renders**；(2) 動作當主詞要用動名詞＋冠詞：**closing the modal**，不能寫 close modal；(3) 三個子句用逗號串起來是 comma splice（**第七次**，同第 170 條），補 **and / so** 或拆句。「非 base 的情況」= **in non-base mode / when it's not the base group**。

entries.o: what is 存檔後重載列表會少筆數 mean ／ what is this mean?
nat: **What does** "the list loses rows after saving and reloading" **mean**?
**What do you mean by** "the list loses rows after saving and reloading"?
What **does** this **mean**?
**What do you mean by this**?
entries.k:
`what is ... mean` 把 be 動詞與原形動詞混在一起——問語意固定用助動詞 **What does X mean?**（同第 2、3 條「疑問句要有助動詞」，第三次出現）；問「你這句想表達什麼」用 **What do you mean by ...?**；針對註解／訊息也可說 **Can you explain what that comment means?**。
**mean** 是實義動詞，疑問句要用助動詞 **do/does**，不能用 be 動詞——What **does** this mean?（what is this 是另一個完整問句「這是什麼」，後面不能再接原形動詞 mean）；想問「你這句話什麼意思」用 **What do you mean by this?**；要對方展開說明還可以說 **Can you walk me through this?**（請對方逐步解釋，工作情境很常用）。

entries.o: add insert heading with tag h3 / and align center
nat: **Add an insert option for** an `<h3>` heading, and **center-align it**.
Add an `<h3>` heading option **with the text centered**.
entries.k: 三個點——(1) `add insert heading` 少了名詞核心與冠詞，要說 **add an insert option for ...** 或 **add an `<h3>` heading option**；(2) 「用 h3 標籤」用關係子句 **that inserts an `<h3>` tag** 比 with tag h3 自然；(3) align 是動詞、center 不能直接當受詞——**center-align it** / **align it to the center** / **with the text centered**。

entries.o: backend determine it by code / replace it with const foo = ...
nat: **The backend determines** it by **the** code.
It's **the** code the backend keys off, not the tag.
entries.k: 第三人稱單數要加 s——**The backend determines**（同慣用說法系列的 determine 用法）；backend 指「我們的後端」要冠詞 **the**，by **the** code 同理。後半 **replace it with** 完全正確——replace 系列七次修正後首次一次到位（受詞 it ＋ 介係詞 with 都對）。

entries.o: if has NOT, then remove NOT button / init AND hide NOT button
nat: If a NOT block already exists, **hide** the NOT button.
**The initial AND card** should **hide** the NOT button. (＝ Hide the NOT button on **the top-level AND card**.)
entries.k: 四個點——(1) 條件句要有主詞：**If a NOT block exists** / **If it already has a NOT block**；(2) 英文 if 句不接 **then**（同慣用說法・instead 系列第 29 條，第二次出現）；(3) 名詞要冠詞與完整詞：**the initial AND card** / **the top-level AND card**（init 是縮寫，正式寫 initial）；(4) 條件渲染的按鈕用 **hide** 而非 remove（remove 讀起來像把元件刪掉）。兩句都是「主詞＋動詞」缺一半的電報式寫法，補上主詞與冠詞即可。

entries.o: add foo?
nat: **Should** `foo` **be added**?
**Should we add** `foo`?
**Would** `foo` **be the right fix here**?
entries.k: 疑問句要有主詞＋助動詞——**Should we add ...?**（同第 3 條「選擇題問句要有主詞＋助動詞」，動詞開頭只有祈使句語氣、沒有徵詢意味）；若想問的是「這是不是對的解法」而非「要不要做」，用 **Would X be the right fix here?** / **Is X the right tool for this?** 更精準。

entries.o: also add a quick link for current customer
nat: Also add a **quick filter** for **the** current customer.
Add one for **the** current customer too.
entries.k: 句型與 also 的位置都對；兩個小點——**the** current customer（特定那個客戶要冠詞）；這裡做的是條件篩選鈕，英文會說 **quick filter**，**quick link** 指的是跳到別頁的捷徑（前一個需求的角色頁連結才是 link）。

entries.o: move the i18n keys near to foo_key
nat: Move the i18n keys **next to** `foo_key`.
Put them **right after** `foo_key`.
entries.k: **near to 不自然**——「緊鄰、放在旁邊」用 **next to**（near 可單獨用：near `card_...`，但不接 to）；要強調就在某行之後說 **right after X**。

entries.o: add quick search myself
nat: The quick search **will be added separately**.
**I'll** add the quick search **myself**.
Add a quick search **for my own account**.
entries.k: 第一句＝自己要做；第二句＝要我做。句尾的 myself 有兩種讀法——反身強調「我自己來」必須有主詞與動詞（**I'll do it myself**），當受詞講「找我自己的資料」要說 **for myself / for my own account**；祈使句 + myself 兩種意思都像，對方只能猜。**功能名稱要冠詞**：a quick search。

entries.o: drag end click edit not working
nat: **Confirmed** — **after a drag, clicking Edit doesn't work** the first time.
**I tested it**: once you've dragged a row, the first click on the Edit button **doesn't register**.
entries.k: 電報式短句缺主詞與動詞，讀者得自己補——完整講法是 **after a drag, clicking Edit doesn't work**；「拖曳結束後」用 **after a drag / after dragging**（drag end 是 DOM 事件名 `dragend`，不能當時間副詞用）；回報按鈕沒反應母語者常說 **doesn't register / does nothing / isn't responding**；確認別人的推測開頭加 **Confirmed —** 或 **I tested it:** 對方才知道這是實測結果而非新問題。

entries.o: it works now, but render late than before
nat: It works now, but **it renders** **more slowly** than before.
It works, but the table **takes longer** to show up now.
entries.k: 後半子句要有主詞並與動詞一致——**it renders**；比較級是 **later**（late 沒有 -er 不能接 than）；但這裡的語意是「花比較久」，要用 **more slowly / takes longer**——**late = 時間點晚**，**slow = 速度慢**，中文都說「慢」所以容易混；回報效能變化時補上對象（the table）會更明確。

entries.o: over 100 will slower
nat: **It gets** slower **once there are more than 100 rows**.
**Anything over 100 rows** **starts to lag**.
entries.k: 句子缺主詞，形容詞比較級前也要有動詞——**it gets/becomes slower**（will slower 不成句，同第 71 條的 render late）；門檻條件用 **once there are more than N ...** 或把門檻名詞化當主詞 **anything over 100 rows**；「開始變卡」口語說 **starts to lag**。

entries.o: add maybe. maybe it would gets slower once there are more than 100 rows
nat: **Add a "maybe**" — it **might** **get** slower once there are more than 100 rows.
**Hedge it**: it **may** start to lag past 100 rows **or so**.
entries.k: **would/might/may** 後面一律接原形——would **get**，不能 would gets（助動詞後不加 -s，這是第 72 條修正句的延伸錯誤）；表不確定用 **might / may** 比 would 更準（would 偏假設語氣）；請對方「加上保留語氣」英文說 **hedge it / soften it / add a "maybe"**；「大約」可用句尾的 **or so**（past 100 rows or so）。

entries.o: reply to the reviewer comment
nat: **Reply to** **the reviewer's comment**.
**Post a reply** to **the review comment**.
entries.k: **人**當修飾語要用所有格——**the reviewer's comment**；若想避開所有格就換成事件名詞 **the review comment**（reviewer comment 這種人＋物的複合名詞英文不自然）；「在某處回覆」動詞用 **reply to / respond to**，貼上去則是 **post a reply**。

entries.o: user who has A must has B permission
nat: **Any user** **with** `A` must also **have** `B`.
**Users** who **have** `A` **always have** `B` too.
entries.k: **情態動詞後一律接原形**——must **have**，不是 must has（has 只接在第三人稱單數主詞後，時態已經被情態動詞吃掉了）；主詞要有限定詞——**A user / Any user / Users**，英文可數名詞不能裸用單數；「有某權限的人」用 **with** 片語比 who has 子句精簡；若在陳述既定事實而非規定，**always have** 比 must 更精準（must 帶「應該要」的規範語氣）。

entries.o: user who has foo_key must has bar_key view role permission, but only who has baz_key can edit
nat: Any user with `foo_key` also **has** `bar_key`, so they can view roles — **but only** those with `baz_key` can **edit them**.
entries.k: must **has** → must **have**（同第 76 條，**第二次出現**）；**only who has** 缺先行詞——關係子句前要有被修飾的名詞：**only those who have** / **only users with**；主詞換成複數 those/users 後動詞是 **have** 不是 has；句尾 can edit 要補受詞 **edit them**；用 **but only ...** 對比兩種權限很自然，語意清楚。

entries.o: how about splice when finish dragging?
nat: **How about** **splicing** only **when** **the drag** ends?
**What if we** **do the splice** once **the drag** finishes?
entries.k: **How about** 後面一律接動名詞——how about **splicing**（how about + 原形動詞不成立，同類句型 what about / think about 也都接 -ing）；**when 子句要有主詞**——when **the drag** finishes / when **dragging** finishes（同 Could you 系列第 40 條、第 27 條「when click the HEADING」，**第四次出現**）；提替代方案還可用 **What if we ...?**，語氣比 how about 更像在一起想辦法；技術動詞 splice 當名詞用要說 **do the splice**。

entries.o: find it - slow is because minWidth: foo(value), would it be better save the width?
nat: **Found it** — **the slowness comes from** `minWidth: foo(value)`. **Would it be better** **to** **cache** the width?
entries.k: 查到原因是已發生的事，用過去式 **Found it**（find it 是現在式／祈使句，讀起來像叫對方去找）；**slow is because 不成立**——形容詞不能當主詞，要說 **the slowness comes from X** / **it's slow because of X**（同慣用說法第 79 條 the slower problem → the slowness）；**would it be better 後面接不定詞**——better **to** save（少了 to 就變成兩個動詞連用）；程式裡「算一次存起來重複用」慣用 **cache**，save 偏「寫進儲存體」（同第 202 條）；兩個獨立句用逗號連是 comma splice，用句號或破折號分開。

entries.o: ignore the reset when delete a row
nat: Skip the **recalculation** **when** **a row is** deleted.
Don't **refresh** the widths **on delete**.
entries.k: **when 子句要有主詞**——when **a row is** deleted，或改成動名詞 when **deleting** a row（同 Could you 系列第 40 條、第 27 條、文法結構第 82 條，**第五次出現**，這是你最常漏的一點）；名詞挑對：這裡做的是「重新計算」= **recalculation / refresh**，**reset** 是「歸零、還原成初始值」，語意不同；「某個動作發生時」也可縮寫成 **on delete / on save**（介係詞 + 動作名詞，工程對話很常用）。

entries.o: apply to all the NOT
nat: **Apply** it to all **the NOT** **blocks**.
This should **apply** to **every NOT** card, **not just the top-level one**.
entries.k: **apply 當「套用」是及物動詞，要有受詞**——apply **it** to X（本節的主題錯型；不加受詞時 apply to 變成「申請、適用於」，語意會反過來變成「這件事適用於……」）；**the NOT 後面要接名詞**——the NOT **blocks / cards**，裸的 NOT 只是運算子名稱；範圍講清楚更好：**every NOT**, **not just the top-level one**，一句話就免掉來回確認。

entries.o: why not rename foo instead?
nat: Why not **rename it to** `foo` instead?
**Why not just call it** `foo`?
entries.k: **rename 是及物動詞，要有受詞**——rename **it** to X（本節主題錯型，同第 86 條 apply）；「改名成」固定搭配 **rename A to B**（replace 才是 with，見 Could you・replace 系列）；提替代名稱最口語的是 **Why not just call it X?**；why not 反問句本身用得對。

entries.o: need to save like file-a.json
nat: **The saved output** needs to **match** `file-a.json`.
**It** needs to serialize into the same shape as `file-a.json`.
entries.k: 英文句子要有主詞——**It / The output needs to ...**（中文可以省，英文不行）；「長得要像某個檔案」用 **match** 或 **be in the same shape as**，**like** 太模糊（like 只表示「類似」，不表示「一致」）；這裡的 save 指存檔後的結果，講成 **the saved output / what gets saved** 比動詞 save 清楚。

entries.o: OR need 兩個並列的 bool
nat: OR **needs** to produce two **sibling** bool nodes.
Two OR blocks should **stay as** two **separate** bools.
entries.k: **主詞第三人稱單數要加 s**——OR **needs**（同本節第 80 條的缺主詞問題，這次主詞有了但動詞沒配合）；「並列」依語境選 **sibling**（同層兄弟節點）、**separate**（各自獨立）或 **parallel**（平行結構），程式結構最常用前兩個；要強調「維持原樣不要被合併」用 **stay as / remain as**。

entries.o: if the same, need 並列的 bool, like OR,OR  AND,AND
nat: **If the op repeats**, **they should** stay as separate bools — OR, OR or AND, AND.
**When the same op appears twice**, give each one its own bool node.
entries.k: **if 子句要有完整主詞動詞**——the same 單獨不成句，要講明「什麼一樣」：**if the op repeats / when the same op appears twice**；主句也要主詞 **they should ...**（同第 76、78 條的缺主詞，第三次出現）；舉例用破折號帶出比用 like 清楚，**like** 在技術討論裡容易被讀成「類似但不完全是」。

entries.o: 入口數量=「能不能併寫」, not flatten determine
nat: The **number of entry points is what decides** **whether they can be merged** — not `flatten`.
**It's the entry count that determines** this, not `flatten`.
entries.k: **not X determine 不成立**——否定對比只接名詞片語就好：**not `flatten`**；要保留動詞就得寫完整子句 **not what `flatten` decides**；強調「是 A 而非 B 決定」母語者用分裂句 **It's A that determines ...**，或 **A is what decides ...**；「併寫」= **merge / combine**，「能不能」用 **whether they can be merged** 帶出間接問句（同本節第 82 條的完整子句問題）。

entries.o: 子區塊要不要併寫在同一個 bool 節點, 由父層的 foo number decide
nat: **Whether** the sub-blocks are merged into one bool node **is decided by** the parent's foo count.
The **parent's number of foo decides** **whether** the sub-blocks get merged.
entries.k: **「由 A 決定」是被動**——decide 要變 **is decided by**，主動寫法要把 A 提到主詞前面（**A decides ...**）；名詞疊用要調序或補 of——**the foo count / the number of foo**，不是 foo number（同介係詞與冠詞第 26 條的名詞堆疊）；句首「要不要」用 **Whether ...** 起頭當主詞子句。

entries.o: 頂層卡片與按鈕順序為 NOT → AND → OR is intend
nat: **The NOT → AND → OR order for the top-level cards and** buttons **is intentional**.
That order **is intended** — leave it as is.
entries.k: **intend** 是動詞，不能直接接在 be 後面——要嘛用形容詞 **is intentional**，要嘛用被動分詞 **is intended**（by design 也很常用：**that's by design**）；「A 的順序」英文是 **the A → B → C order for X**，順序放前面當修飾語；回覆 review 說「這是刻意的」最短就是 **That's intentional.** 或 **That's by design.**

entries.o: the top-level cards AND #1 / NOT #1 is ok
nat: **The** `AND #1`
`NOT #1` **titles** on the top-level **cards** **are** **fine**.
Those card **titles** **are** **fine as they are**.
entries.k: 主詞是複數 **cards/titles**，動詞要用 are（is ok 的主詞單複數不一致）；講的其實是「卡片上的標題」，補 **titles** 才精準——**the titles on the top-level cards**；**fine** 比 ok 稍正式一點，review 回覆用 **fine as they are**（維持現狀）最清楚。

entries.o: foo and bar name are ambious
nat: **The names** `foo` and `bar` **are** **ambiguous**.
`foo` and `bar` **are** **too similar** — **the names** **don't tell them apart**.
entries.k: 兩個東西的名字是複數——**the names ... are**（name are 主謂不一致，同第 82 條）；拼字 **ambiguous**（ambious 漏了 gu）；指「兩個名字太像分不出誰是誰」母語者常說 **too similar** 或 **don't tell them apart**（同 Could you 請求句第 46 條的 too easy to mix up）。

entries.o: should foo fold into bar?
nat: Should `foo` **be folded into** `bar`?
**Should we fold** `foo` **into** `bar`?
entries.k: **fold into 這裡要被動**——被合併的是 `foo`，所以 **be folded into**；要用主動就補上動作者 **should we fold X into Y**（同第 79 條「由 A 決定」的主被動問題）；**fold X into Y**（把 X 併進 Y）用得很道地，同義的還有 **inline X into Y**（特別指把只有一個呼叫端的函式展開回去）。

entries.o: remove group drag, only enable drag in the same group
nat: Remove **cross-group dragging** — only allow **reordering** **within** the same group.
Drop the cross-**group drag**; keep **drag-to-reorder** inside a single group.
entries.k: **group drag 太含糊**（是「拖整組」還是「跨組拖」？）——跨群組要講明 **cross-group dragging**；「在同一組**內**、不超出範圍」用 **within**，in 只表示「在裡面」語氣弱；同組內拖曳的目的是排序，說 **reordering / drag-to-reorder** 比 drag 精準；兩個祈使句用逗號相連是 comma splice（同介係詞與冠詞第 16-18 條的老問題）——改破折號或分號。

entries.o: which is better - foo or bar
nat: **Which is better**, `foo` **or** `bar`?
entries.k: **句型已經對了**——選項接在問句後面同一句、用逗號帶出（第 4 條的修正內化，這次沒再把句子切成兩半）；只剩標點：疑問句要收**問號**，要用破折號的話是 ` — `（前後留空格的 em dash），不是連字號 `-`。

entries.o: show dragging icon when more then 1 row
nat: Show the **drag handle** only **when there's** more **than** **one** row.
Only show the handle if the card has more **than** **one** row.
entries.k: **then / than 混用**——比較一律 **than**，then 是「然後、那時」；那個可以抓著拖的圖示英文是 **drag handle**（handle = 把手，icon 只是圖案，dragging icon 不是慣用說法）；條件句要有主詞動詞 **when there's ...**；句中的 1 習慣寫成 **one**。（原分類：拼字與易混字）

entries.o: commit all files SOCMSSPP-1897
nat: Commit **everything** **under** SOCMSSPP-1897.
Commit **all the changes** and reference SOCMSSPP-1897.
entries.k: 工單號要有介係詞帶出來——**under / for** SOCMSSPP-1897（單號直接黏在句尾會讀成另一個受詞）；「所有變更」用 **everything** 或 **all the changes** 比 all files 自然（commit 的對象是變更，不是檔案本身）；要講明寫進 Refs 就說 **reference the ticket**。

entries.o: you already created https://claude.ai/artifact/...
nat: **It's already been created**: <link>.
**You've already created** it: <link>.
**That doc** **already** exists — here's the link.
entries.k: 「已經做了」接 **already** 時母語者多用現在完成式 **You've already created**（簡單過去式 you already created 在美式口語可通，但偏隨便）；貼連結前先給受詞 **it / that doc**，再用冒號或破折號帶出網址，不要讓 URL 直接當受詞。

series.title: Would it be worth -ing / Is this worth -ing

entries.o: would it be worth to simply foo usage?
nat: Would it be **worth** **simplifying** the `foo` usage?
entries.k: **worth 後接動名詞**，不加 to（worth **simplifying**，同筆記首條的 "Would it be worth splitting..."）；**simply**（副詞「僅僅」）≠ **simplify**（動詞「簡化」）。

entries.o: would it be worth adding filter title?
nat: Would it be worth **filtering the title** here **too**?
Should **the** helper filter the title **as well**?
entries.k: worth + V-ing 的句型本身正確（同第 167 條）；問題在動作被名詞化後又堆名詞——直接寫 **filtering the title**，不要 adding filter title（中文語序的名詞堆疊，同介係詞與冠詞第 25 條）；特定那個參數要冠詞 **the** title；「也一起做」用句尾 **too / as well**。

entries.o: would it be worth moving foo to share function in file-a.js? ／ would it be worth moving foo to share function like file-a.js?
nat: Would it be worth moving `foo` **into** **a** **shared** helper in `file-a.js`?
Is it worth pulling `foo` out **into** `file-a.js` as a **shared** function?
Would it be worth moving `foo` **into** **a shared** module like `file-a.js`?
entries.k:
**Would it be worth -ing** 句型正確（文法結構第 18 條已內化）；「共用函式」是形容詞 **shared** function／helper——share 是動詞，同慣用說法第 93 條的 share function，**第二次出現**；可數名詞要冠詞 **a** shared helper；「搬進某個檔案」用 **into**（to 只表方向，into 才有「放進去」的意思，同 merge / fold into 系列）。
Would it be worth + V-ing 用得對（文法結構第 7 條內化）；**shared** 是形容詞——**a shared** module/helper（share 是動詞，同第 1、91 條與文法結構第 22 條，**第四次出現**）；移進模組用 **into**、要冠詞 **a**。

entries.o: MFA didn't change, so there is no need to add MFA description in commit message / is it necessary to add prompt to guidelines?
nat: MFA didn't change, so there's no need to **mention it** in **the** commit message.
**Should we** add **this rule** to **the** guidelines?
**Is it worth** adding this to the guidelines?
entries.k: 第二次提到同一個東西改用代名詞——**mention it**，不要重複 add MFA description（英文避免同詞重複）；**冠詞不能少**——in **the** commit message、to **the** guidelines；「有必要嗎」直譯 is it necessary 偏生硬，慣用 **Should we ...? / Is it worth ...?**（同文法結構第 48、52 條 worth 系列）；prompt 指的是規則就直接說 **this rule / this convention**。

entries.o: would it be worth moving status 5xx foo_key to bar?
nat: **Would it be worth** moving the 5xx "system busy" handling **into** `bar`?
Should the 5xx → `foo_key` mapping **live in** `bar` instead?
entries.k: **Would it be worth + V-ing** 用得對（同第 75 條，已內化）；「status 5xx foo_key」是名詞疊放，要補一個核心名詞——**the 5xx handling / the 5xx mapping**（把 status code 對到訊息的「處理／對應」）；搬進函式用 **into**（同第 75 條 moving ... into）；「某邏輯該放在哪」慣用 **live in**（Should X live in Y?）。

entries.o: would it be worth optimizing? ／ would it be worth optimizing this whole section?
nat: **Is this worth** optimizing?
Would it be worth **consolidating** these two lines?
Would it be worth **cleaning up** this whole section?
Is this whole block worth **refactoring**?
entries.k:
worth + V-ing 用得對（第 128 條內化）；optimize 及物要有對象——最自然是把受詞提為主詞 **Is this worth ...**（缺受詞問題同動詞與受詞系列）；「整併／簡化」用 **clean up / consolidate / simplify**（optimize 偏效能調校）。
文法全對（受詞 this whole section 補上了，第 137 條的修正內化）；剩下詞彙選擇——為了可讀性重寫是 **clean up / tidy up / refactor**，**optimize** 讀者會以為在談效能（同第 137 條，第二次出現）；「這一段程式」= **this block / this section**。

entries.o: would it be worth replacing style to class?
nat: Would it be worth **replacing** **the inline styles** with **classes**?
Would it be worth **switching from** inline styles to CSS **classes**?
entries.k: **replace A with B**（介係詞又寫成 to，**第七次出現**，同第 8、25、10、11、12、13 條）；想用 to 就換動詞——**switch from A to B** / **move from A to B**；受詞要具體並加冠詞／複數——**the inline styles** → **classes**（不是抽象的 style / class）。would it be worth + V-ing 用得對（文法結構第 7、48、52 條已內化）。

sub: in / on / to / into, a / the

entries.o: write the native phrase before and after to file where I can learn
nat: Save the **before-and-after** phrasings to **a file** for later review.
Could you save the **before-and-after** phrasings to **a file** so I can review them later?
entries.k: file 要加冠詞 **a file**；「讓我可以學」= so I can review/learn from them；「修正前後」= before-and-after。

entries.o: also show boss's boss from foo
nat: Also show **the** boss's boss, **using** `foo`.
Could you also show **the** boss's boss, **using** `foo`?
entries.k: 所有格前要冠詞——**the** boss's boss；「用某 API 取得」說 **using**/via，from 是指資料「來自」某處（get X **from**）不是「透過」。

entries.o: what is logging 準則
nat: What's **the** logging guideline **being referred to**?
What's **the** logging guideline **you keep referring to**?
entries.k: 特定那份準則要冠詞 **the**——the logging guideline；「你（前面）一直提的」= **you keep referring to / you mentioned**。

entries.o: only add description, no need to add validator
nat: Just add **the** description — **no need for** **a** validator.
entries.k: 可數名詞要冠詞——**the** description、**a** validator；「不需要～」後接名詞用 **no need for** ＋名詞（接動詞才是 no need to）；兩個短句用破折號連（逗號相連同 Git 系列的 comma splice）。

entries.o: change FOO to [{key,label}] shape
nat: Change `FOO` **to** **an array of** `{ key, label }` **objects**.
Make `FOO` use **the** `{ key, label }` shape.
entries.k: shape 是可數名詞要冠詞——**the** `{ key, label }` shape；描述資料結構更常說 **an array of X objects**；change A **to** B 用得對。

entries.o: also save this to phrasing notes
nat: Also save this to **the** phrasing notes.
entries.k: 特定那份筆記要冠詞 **the**——**the** phrasing notes（同第 5 條 the logging guideline）；save ... to the notes 與 also 的句中位置都用得對。

entries.o: backend has fixed this bug
nat: **The backend has fixed** this bug.
This is fixed on **the** backend now.
entries.k: **the** backend 要冠詞（同慣用說法第 13 條 the backend）；has fixed 完成式用得對；「後端那邊修好了」也常說 **fixed on the backend side**。

entries.o: Users who have `foo_key` always have `bar_key` is set by manual. ... can open page / cannot open page
nat: **That rule** — users with `foo_key` always having `bar_key` — **is enforced manually**, not by the system. **Both cases tested: with** `bar_key` the page opens fine; **without it**, the form renders blank.

**That rule** — users with `foo_key` always having `bar_key` — **is enforced manually**, not by the system. **I tested both: with** `bar_key` the page opens fine; **without it**, the form renders blank.
entries.k: **by manual 不成立**——「人工設定的」用副詞 **manually**（set manually / by hand），或名詞說法 **it's a manual convention / it's enforced manually**（manual 是形容詞，不能接在 by 後面當名詞）；**open page → open the page**（可數單數一定要冠詞，同第 13、19 條）；把「規則本身」當主詞時要用同位語或 that 子句包起來——**That rule — ... — is enforced manually** 或 **The fact that users ... is only a convention**，直接把一個完整句子塞進主詞位置文法不成立；對照實驗的寫法 **I tested both: with X ...; without it ...** 很清楚，比並列兩個長句好讀。

entries.o: take a look at memory
nat: Check **the memory** **first**.
Take a look at **your memory** **first**.
Check **your memory** **before you carry on**.
entries.k: **memory 前面要限定詞**——裸的 memory 在技術語境會被讀成「記憶體」，指「你存的記憶」要說 **your memory / your notes / your saved memory**（同第 13、19、16、17 條的冠詞／限定詞漏字）；祈使句本身沒問題，但工作對話補一個 **first / before you carry on** 才表達出「先看再做」的先後順序。

entries.o: update wording
nat: Update **the** **wording**.
Can you **reword** that comment?
entries.k: **wording 前面要冠詞 the**（指剛才那段文字，同第 13、19、16、17、19 條的冠詞漏字）；只改文字不改語意，動詞用 **reword**（reword the comment）最精準；要對方順句子則說 **tidy up the wording**。

entries.o: add Guard
nat: Add **the** guard.
Add **the** visible guard **to the text computed**.
entries.k: 指的是剛才 review 提到的那一個 guard，**可數名詞要冠詞 the**（同第 23、24、25 條的冠詞漏字）；簡短指令若對方可能不確定是哪一項，補上位置 **to the text computed** 一句話就定位；guard 是普通名詞不必大寫。

entries.o: go ahead, also move the buttons to footer
nat: Go ahead. Also, move **the** buttons to **the footer**.
Go ahead — and move **the** buttons into **the footer** **while you're at it**.
entries.k: **the footer 要冠詞**——Modal 只有一個 footer，是特定位置，move X to **the** footer（同第 33 到 37 條的冠詞漏字，這次漏在受詞之後的位置名詞）；「順便也…」口語可用 **while you're at it**；兩個指令用逗號連是 comma splice（同文法結構第 51、53 條），Also 起頭另起一句或用破折號。

entries.o: why did you use constants instead of class
nat: Why **a** constant instead of a **class**?
Why did you use **a** constant instead of a **class**?
**Why a JS constant rather than a CSS class**?
entries.k: **class** 是可數名詞單數，要冠詞 a（同第 33 到 38 條的冠詞漏字，這次漏在 instead of 之後）；對比的兩樣東西數量對齊，一個常數對一個 class，**constants → a constant**；疑問句語序這次全對（why did you use，文法結構第 148 條已內化）；口語問「為什麼選 A 不選 B」也可省略動詞 **why A rather than B?**。

entries.o: go to next step
nat: **Move on** to **the next step**.
**Let's move on**.
entries.k: **the next step 要冠詞**（next 修飾的單數可數名詞，同第 33 至 39 條的冠詞漏字，這類最常漏在 next / first / last 後面）；流程「進下一站」母語者用 **move on (to …)**，go to 偏「前往某地」；只想說「繼續」就 **let's move on / go ahead**。

entries.o: convert foo_key to must clause
nat: Convert `foo_key` to **a must clause**.
**Map** `foo_key` **to a** `terms` condition **instead of skipping it**.
entries.k: **a must clause 要不定冠詞**——單數可數名詞第一次提到用 **a**（同第 33 到 38 條的冠詞漏字，這次是不定冠詞）；「把 A 對應成 B」在解析器情境常用 **map A to B**，convert 也可以；想講清楚「不要再略過」補 **instead of skipping it**，對方就知道是改行為不是加功能。

entries.o: remove hn in BASE
nat: **Don't pass** **the hn** **in base mode**.
**Drop** **the hn** **for base statements**.
entries.k: **the hn 要冠詞**（同第 33 到 39 條的冠詞漏字，這次是代碼名詞當一般名詞用時也要 the）；**in BASE** 缺了名詞，講 **in base mode / for base statements**，BASE 單獨大寫會被讀成常數名；「拿掉某個傳入值」比 remove 更貼切的是 **don't pass / drop**，remove 聽起來像刪掉那個變數本身。

entries.o: link it to backend pr soc-tms/pull/115
nat: **Link** it to **the backend PR**, soc-tms/pull/115.
Add a **link** to **the backend PR** (soc-tms #115).
entries.k: **the backend PR** 冠詞（特指那一個，同第 39、36 條漏 the 的型）；PR 路徑接在後面當同位語要用逗號或括號隔開；「連結到」**link X to Y** 用對了。

entries.o: use current branch
nat: Use **the current branch**.
Just do it **on the current branch**.
entries.k: **the current branch** 冠詞（同第 39、36、38 條）；「在目前分支上做」也可說 **on the current branch**；三個字的指令沒錯，補 the 就是母語者的版本。

entries.o: can Tooltip scroll?
nat: Can **the Tooltip** scroll?
Can we **make the Tooltip content scrollable**?
entries.k: 元件名當一般名詞用時要冠詞 **the Tooltip**（同第 38、40 條漏 the 的型；當程式識別字寫在反引號裡 `Tooltip` 才可省）；問「能不能做成可捲動」用 **make X scrollable**，比 can X scroll 更能表達「我們要不要加這個功能」而非「它天生會不會」。

entries.o: add test for foo
nat: Add **a test** for `foo`.
**Cover** the `foo` guard with **a test**.
entries.k: 可數名詞單數要冠詞——**a test**（同第 38、40、41 條漏冠詞型，這類短指令最常漏）；要測的是某段邏輯時可點名 **the `foo` guard**，對方才知道範圍；「補測試覆蓋」口語 **cover X with a test**。

entries.o: add reset all button
nat: Add **a "reset all filters" button**.
Add **a button that clears all the filters**.
entries.k: **button 可數單數要 a**（同第 45-49 條漏冠詞的短指令型）；**reset all** 是動詞片語缺受詞，當按鈕名稱要整個加引號變名詞 **a "reset all filters" button**，或改用關係子句 **a button that clears all the filters** 把動作講完整；「重設」在 UI 語境 reset / clear 都可，clear 偏「清空條件」，reset 偏「回到預設值」。

entries.o: if button is NOT, set the button color as { op: FOO, name: t('key'), [BAR]: '...' }
nat: If **the button** is **the NOT one**, **give it the same colour as the top-level NOT button**.
**Reuse the** `BAR` **style** from `BAZ` for the nested NOT button.
entries.k: **set** A to B，不是 **set** A as B（as 只用在 treat / regard / describe as 這類「視為」的動詞）；可數單數要冠詞 **the button**，指「那一顆」可用 **the NOT one**；把整段設定貼上來當受詞，讀者得自己找重點——講 **give it the same colour as X** 或 **reuse the X style** 一句話就講完。

entries.o: only colour NOT button
nat: Only colour **the NOT button**.
Leave the others **unstyled** — **just the NOT button** gets a colour.
entries.k: 可數單數要冠詞 **the NOT button**（同第 85 條，同一回合內第二次）；only 放句首修飾整句沒問題，但要讓範圍更明確可改成 **just the NOT button**；補一句「其他維持原樣」**leave the others as they are / unstyled**，對方才不用回頭問是不是要把其他顆的顏色拿掉（這次就因為沒講清楚，我把頂層 AND / OR 的顏色也一併拿掉了）。

entries.o: replace the backup footnote with texts you recommend
nat: Replace that commented-out backup block with **the suggested wording**.
Replace that commented-out backup block with **the wording** **you suggested**.
Rewrite those backup-colour comments the way **you recommended**.
entries.k: **text 當「文字內容」時不可數**——用 **the wording / the text**，複數 texts 會被讀成「好幾則簡訊」；**footnote 是文件底部的註腳**，程式碼裡被註解起來的區塊要說 **the commented-out block / those comments**；關係子句用過去式 **you suggested / you recommended**（指我剛才提過的那版），現在式 you recommend 會像「你平常都推薦的那種寫法」。

entries.o: I meant FOO in BAR nest
nat: **The intended case is** **a** `baz` **nested inside** a `qux`.
I meant **a** `baz` **nested inside** a `qux`.
**I meant the case where** `FOO` **sits inside** `BAR`.
entries.k: **nest 不能當名詞掛在片語尾巴**（英文的 nest 是「鳥巢」或動詞「築巢」）——「巢狀在⋯裡面」要用過去分詞 **nested inside / nested in**，或乾脆說 **a X inside a Y**、**X sits inside Y**；可數名詞要冠詞——**a** `baz` nested inside **a** `qux`；「我指的是⋯這種情況」固定說法是 **I meant the case where …**（接完整子句，同第 44 條的 I meant）。

entries.o: also rename pasted that mean 輸入string
nat: **Also** **rename** `pasted` **to something that says it's** **the input string**.
Rename `pasted` **too** — the name should read as "input string".
entries.k: **rename X that mean … 缺了改成什麼**——rename 的完整結構是 **rename X to Y**，「改成一個表達 Z 意思的名字」是 **rename X to something that means / says Z**（that 子句要有先行詞 something，直接接在 pasted 後面會變成在形容 pasted）；關係子句動詞第三人稱單數 **means**；「輸入字串」直接講 **the input string**（中英夾雜的 輸入string 在英文句裡要整句換掉）；「也一起改」放句尾用 **too** 或句首 **Also**。

entries.o: remove all the test-query*.json comment
nat: Remove every **comment** that mentions `test-query*.json`.
Drop all the **references to `test-query*.json` **from the** comments**.
entries.k: **comment 要複數 comments**（all the 後面接可數複數，同第 148 條）；「提到某檔的註解」說 **comments that mention X** 或 **references to X**，直接把檔名當形容詞放在 comment 前面會讀成「叫這個名字的註解」。

entries.o: render size often less than 50, some of them are 1000, maybe 0.5s
nat: **Most** tables have **fewer than** 50 **rows**, but **some have around 1**,000 — the delay is maybe half a second.
**Usually** under 50 **rows**; a few go up to 1,000, and it lags about half a second.
entries.k: **render size 不是英文說法**，筆數就講 **row count / rows**（size 會被讀成檔案大小或尺寸）；可數名詞的「少於」用 **fewer than**，less than 留給不可數（時間、金額）；**some of them are 1000** 少了名詞——**some have around 1,000 rows**；純數值要接回主題才完整——**the delay is about half a second**，口語也常說 **it lags half a second**；「大部分情況」用 **most / usually**，別用 often（often 指頻率不是比例）。

entries.o: I cannot select the words right now
nat: **Text** **in the cells** **can't** be selected right now.
I **can't** select **text** **in the cells** right now.
**Text selection isn't working** at the moment.
entries.k: 文法完全正確，差在詞彙——畫面上「可選取的內容」是 **text**（不可數、不加冠詞），**the words** 指的是「那幾個特定字詞」，聽起來像在講某段指定文字；回報功能失效的慣用句型是 **X isn't working**（Text selection isn't working），比敘述自己做不到更像 bug report；**can't** 在口語與工作訊息中比 cannot 自然，cannot 偏正式書面；補上範圍 **in the cells / in the table** 能讓對方少猜一輪。

entries.o: don't remind me html-editor again
nat: Don't **bring up** `html-editor` again.
Stop **flagging** `html-editor` — I don't need reminders about it.
entries.k: remind 後面要介係詞——**remind me about / of X**，remind me X 不成立（介係詞缺漏，同第 14 條 put X **to** 的錯型）；日常更常用的是 **bring up X**（提起某事）或 **flag X**（在審查中標記出來），語氣比 remind 直接；「不用再提醒我這件事」= I don't need reminders about it。

entries.o: I cannot select text cross line
nat: Text **can't** be selected **across lines**.
I can't select text **across lines**.
Selection stops at the end of a line — I can't drag it **across rows**.
entries.k: **cross 是動詞、不能當介係詞**——「橫跨」的介係詞是 **across**（cross lines 只能當動詞片語「穿越那些線」）；複數 **lines / rows** 才表達「多行之間」；補上受詞 text 這次寫對了（同第 17 條）；描述失效範圍時說清楚是「跨行」還是「跨列」——**across lines**（同一格內的換行）與 **across rows**（不同列）在表格情境是兩件事。

entries.o: but I think [FOO] is key, i18n is label
nat: **But isn't** `[FOO]` **the** key and the **i18n** **string** the label?
**The way I see it**, `[FOO]` is **the** key and the **i18n** **value** is the label.
entries.k: **單數可數名詞一定要冠詞**——is **the** key、is **the** label（同第 13、19、16、17 條的冠詞漏字；本節第 31 條為同一輪的介係詞錯型）；**i18n 是形容詞性的縮寫，不能單獨當主詞**——要說 **the i18n key / value / string**；提出不同看法時 **But isn't X …?** 或 **The way I see it, …** 比直述句更像在討論而非糾正；兩個並列子句共用一個動詞時可省略第二個 is（… is the key and the i18n string the label）。

entries.o: show me the diff about const FOO = { ... }
nat: Show **the diff for that** `FOO` **version**.
Show me **the diff for that** `FOO` **version**.
Can you show me what **that** `FOO` refactor would look like as a diff?
entries.k: **the diff for X**（about 是「關於某主題」，用在文章或討論；diff / patch / test 講的是「針對哪段程式碼」一律用 **for**）；指剛才提過的那個版本說 **that … version**，對方才知道不是要新的；想看「改完長怎樣」可用 **what it would look like as a diff**（同文法結構第 1、25 條的 what would it look like 句型）。

entries.o: there is no extra space in country, ignore this suggestion
nat: There's no extra space **on the "country" line**, **so** ignore **that suggestion**.
**The country line** has no extra space — **drop that one**.
entries.k: 表格／清單的某一行用 **on** the X **line / row**——in country 會被讀成「在國家裡面」；指對方剛提出的建議用 **that suggestion**（已經講完的東西），this 偏「我接下來要說的」；兩句用逗號連是 comma splice（同文法結構第 51、53 條）——加 **so** 或拆句；打回某一條 review 口語 **drop that one**（同文法結構第 156 條 ignore / drop this one）。

entries.o: update pr #566 wording
nat: Update **the wording in** PR #566.
**Tweak** the wording **of PR #566**.
entries.k: 「某 PR 的措辭」用 **the wording in / of PR #566**——pr wording 兩個名詞直接疊會少掉冠詞與介係詞；小幅調整用字口語 **tweak**；要改哪一段最好點出來（**the backend-dependency callout**），否則對方要猜。

entries.o: stay in the same branch
nat: Stay **on** the same branch.
Keep working **on** `enhance-auto-report`.
entries.k: Git 分支一律用 **on**——on a branch、on `dev`、switch to / check out a branch；in 會讓人以為是「在某個資料夾／檔案裡」；要阻止對方換分支也可說 **Don't switch branches.**（Git 節的 merge dev 系列可一併複習介係詞）。

entries.o: apply it, and reset max as 20
nat: Apply it, and **set the max to 20**.
Go ahead, with **the cap** at 20.
entries.k: 把值設成某數是 **set** X **to** Y，介係詞是 **to**；reset 是「回到預設／歸零」，指定一個新數值用 set；as 接的是「身分、角色」（treat X as Y），不是數值；「上限」口語 **the cap / the max**。

entries.o: foo add BAR
nat: **Add** `BAR` **to** `foo`.
`foo` **should include** `BAR` **too**.
entries.k: 英文是 **動詞 ＋ 受詞 ＋ 介係詞片語**——**Add B to A**，把容器放句首再接動詞（foo add …）會變成「foo 這個東西去 add」，主詞語意相反（同第 67、71 條祈使句缺主詞／語序的家族）；要以容器當主詞就改成 **`foo` should include `BAR`** 或 **`foo` needs `BAR` as well**；短指令要再自然一點可補目的 **so the OR button shows up again**，對方就知道你要的是畫面上的按鈕而不只是陣列值。

entries.o: would it be better move FOO to the share js?
nat: **Would it be better** **to move** `FOO` into the **shared** module?
**Should** `FOO` **live in** `file-a.js` **instead**?
entries.k: **Would it be better 後面要接 to V**（better **to move**）——這個句型你先前用對過（慣用說法・「would it be better to rename mode-strategies」），這次漏掉 to；**share** 是動詞／名詞，當形容詞要用 **shared**（the shared module，同 nested/nest 的錯型）；口語可以講 the shared file，但指某支檔案時直接寫檔名 **`file-a.js`** 最不會誤會；換個說法問「該放哪」用 **Should X live in Y instead?**，工作討論裡很常見。

entries.o: also colour the AND button, but only on the top-level
nat: Also colour the AND button, but only **the top-level one**.
…, but only **at the top level** — leave the one inside the cards plain.
entries.k: 句子幾乎全對（冠詞、but 轉折都對，比第 85、88 條進步）；差在 **top-level 是形容詞，不能單獨當名詞**——要嘛補名詞 **the top-level one / the top-level button**，要嘛改成介係詞片語 **at the top level**（當名詞時兩個字分開、不加連字號）；`on` 也要換成 **at**（層級用 at: at the top level / at this level）。

entries.o: would it be better naming foo instead of bar, bar is ambigous
nat: **Wouldn't** `foo` **be a better name**? `bar` feels **ambiguous** **on its own**.
**Would it be better** **to name it** `foo`? `bar` is **ambiguous** **out of context**.
entries.k: **Would it be better 後面接 to V**——better **to name it** X（better naming X 不成立）；把名字本身當主詞更自然——**Wouldn't X be a better name?**；理由要獨立成句，逗號連兩個完整句是 comma splice（同第 4、50、37 條）；拼字 **ambiguous**（ambigous 漏了 u）；補一句 **on its own / out of context** 才說清楚是「單看名字」時有歧義。

entries.o: foo if (clause.op === BAR) there is no NOT in it
nat: In `foo`, the `clause.op === BAR` **branch** **can never contain** a NOT.
**The top-level AND group** **never has** a NOT block, **so that branch doesn't need** the `not` half.
entries.k: 指出「某個檔案／函式裡的某一段」要用介係詞開頭——**In `foo`, the … branch**（直接把函式名丟句首會變成沒有關係的兩塊）；**it 指涉不明**時改講具體的東西 **the AND branch / the top-level AND group**；「不可能有」用 **can never contain / never has**，比 there is no 更能表達「依設計就不會有」而非「這次剛好沒有」；反駁對方的結論時補上結論 **so that branch doesn't need …**，對方才知道你要他改什麼。

entries.o: remove foo in query-statement-view
nat: **Remove** `foo` **from** `query-statement-view`.
Drop the `foo` wiring in `query-statement-view` — **it's always empty there**.
entries.k: **remove X from Y**——「從某處拿掉」介係詞是 **from**，in 是「在裡面」的位置描述（同介係詞系列第 33 到 40 條的介係詞／冠詞問題）；補一句理由 **it's always empty there** 對方就知道你接受了前面的分析，不用再確認。

entries.o: fix foo BAR, set elk-dev-tools-button maxWidth
nat: **Fix** `foo` **so it resets** `baz` to `BAR` first, and set a `maxWidth` on the Dev Tools modal.
**Two things**: reset `baz` before fetching in `foo`, and give the modal a max width.
entries.k: **fix A B** 兩個名詞疊在一起看不出關係——要說 **fix A so (that) it does B** 或 **fix A by doing B**；「給某元件設一個屬性」是 **set a `maxWidth` on X**（介係詞 on，且 a 冠詞）；一句裡兩件事，開頭先講 **Two things:** 再分項，比逗號硬接清楚。

entries.o: move dayjs(value, { foo: true }).format(BAR) to a share module
nat: Move `dayjs(value, { foo: true }).format(BAR)` **into** a **shared** **helper**.
**Pull** that dayjs formatting out **into** a **shared** **helper** in `file-a.js`.
entries.k: **share module → shared module**：名詞前要用過去分詞 **shared**（同第 140 條，**第二次**；更早的 share function 見慣用說法第 93 條、介係詞與冠詞第 36 條——這個字值得刻意練）；「搬進某個模組」用 **into**（同介係詞與冠詞第 36 條、merge / fold into 系列）；把一段重複的運算抽出來，母語者常說 **pull X out into a helper / extract X into a helper**，而且抽出的是「函式」時講 **helper** 比 module 貼切（module 是整個檔案）。

entries.o: apply it and add 1, 4, 5 diffs
nat: **Go ahead and** apply it, **then** **show** the diffs **for 1, 4, and 5**.
**Go ahead and** apply it, **then** **show me** the diffs **for 1, 4, and 5**.
Apply that one, and **post the diffs** for suggestions 1, 4, **and 5**.
entries.k: 要對方「把 diff 貼出來看」用 **show me / post the diffs**——**add** 會被理解成「把 diff 加進某個檔案」；編號清單用 **for 1, 4, and 5**（介係詞 for ＋最後一項前的 and，不能像中文直接把數字貼在名詞前當修飾語）；兩個指令之間用 **then / and** 串成一句，請人動手做的 **go ahead and ...** 同 Could you・其他請求句第 6 條。

entries.o: if you name foo, that should find bar from baz instead of qux
nat: **If it's going to be called** `foo`, it should **look the customer up in** `baz`, not `qux`.
**If you're going to call it** `foo`, it should **look the customer up in** `baz`, not `qux`.
A getter named `foo` should **search** `baz` rather than `qux`.
entries.k: 「在清單裡找某筆」的動詞是 **look X up in Y** 或 **search Y for X**，**find X from Y** 介係詞不對（find 搭 **in**）；找的對象是 **the customer**，不是 bar（id 是拿來比對的鍵）；「既然取這個名字」用 **if you're going to call it X**，name 當動詞要接受詞與名字兩個（name it X）；指回主詞用 **it**，**that** 會被讀成在指前面整件事。

series.title: merge / fold into
series.desc: same phrase, collected together; "merging into something that already exists" is merge／fold X **into** Y — the preposition was mistaken as "to" 3 times; Git's merge dev／merge conflicts are also filed here

entries.o: merge file-a.js to file-b.js
nat: **Merge** `file-a.js` **into** `file-b.js`.
**Fold** the tests for this feature **into** `file-b.js`.
**Fold** scattered tests back **into** the main file.
entries.k: **merge A into B**（介係詞是 into，不是 to；同 Git 系列 merge dev **into** 的用法）。

entries.o: or 整合 with FOO
nat: **Or should** it be **merged** into `FOO`?
Or **fold it into** `FOO`?
entries.k: 接在前一個問句後面的「或者…？」要補成完整問句 **Or should …?**，只留 or ＋ 名詞片語會斷句；「整合／合併進去」母語者用 **merge X into Y**、**fold X into Y**、**combine X with Y**——merge 常搭 into（併入某個既有的東西），combine 才搭 with（兩者對等合併）；提案兩種做法時直接標 **Option A / Option B** 或用 **or …, instead?** 收尾，對方比較好回答。（原分類：文法結構）

entries.o: 回貼 has merge into guideline, remove duplicate file
nat: The posting workaround has **been merged** into **the** guidelines, so remove the duplicate file.
entries.k: 完成式被動——has **been merged**（has merge 缺 been＋過去分詞；同 Git 系列第 7 條、YouTrack 系列第 4 條的被動缺 be/過去分詞）；名詞要冠詞——**the** guidelines、**the** duplicate file。（原分類：文法結構・動詞與受詞系列）

entries.o: the reson is I don't want too many constants, so I want to merge FOO and BAR
nat: The **reason** is to avoid too many constants **floating around** — **better to** **merge** `FOO` into `BAR`.
The **reason** is I don't **want** too many constants **floating around** — **I'd rather** **merge** `FOO` into `BAR`.
**My goal is fewer constants**, **so I want** to **fold** `FOO` **into** `BAR`.
entries.k: 拼字 **reason**（reson 漏了 a，同拼字與易混字第 19、22、23 條的手滑）；句子文法沒問題，但 **I want … so I want …** 重複，第二個換成 **I'd rather …** 或把目的講成名詞 **My goal is fewer constants**；「散落一堆常數」母語者會加 **floating around**；「併進某個既有的東西」用 **merge / fold X into Y**（同介係詞與冠詞第 31 條）。（原分類：拼字與易混字・其他拼字）

entries.o: could you fix the conflicts
nat: **Resolve** the merge conflicts.
Could you **resolve** the merge conflicts?
Could you **resolve** the conflicts in `file-a.js`?
entries.k: 句子文法沒問題；Git 情境「解衝突」慣用動詞是 **resolve**（resolve merge conflicts），fix 聽得懂但不是慣用搭配；若只剩一個檔可直接點名。（原分類：Git・review）

entries.o: I have merge dev
nat: Dev **has been merged** in.
I've **merged** dev.
entries.k: 完成式 have＋**過去分詞**——have **merged**（have merge 是 have＋原形的混用，同 Git 第 2 條 I had checkout、文法結構第 11 條 I had confirm，**第三次出現**——這個模式要特別留意）。（原分類：Git）

entries.o: could you rename it to a general branch name, as I have feedbacked "docs/exclude-wip-from-commits" before, these seem like a similar issue, but I cannot reuse the same branch
nat: Rename it to **something more general**. `docs/exclude-wip-from-commits` **raised** **the same kind of issue**, but that branch can't be reused **since it's already merged**.

Could you rename it to **something more general**? I **raised** `docs/exclude-wip-from-commits` before and this feels like **the same kind of issue**, but I can't reuse that branch **since it's already merged**.
entries.k: **feedback 不當動詞**——用 **give feedback / raise / bring up**（feedbacked 是常見中式英文）；**a general branch name → something more general**（英文避免堆形容詞在名詞前，用 something + 比較級更自然）；「同一類問題」= **the same kind of issue**（a similar issue 指「另一個相似的個案」，語意較弱）；補上不能重用的理由 **since it's already merged**，對方才不用猜。（原分類：Could you 請求句・其他請求句）

entries.o: 1 skip and warn, 2 yes, 3 只覆蓋條件與統計參數，index 留給使用者自己選, 5 ok
nat: 1: skip and warn. 2: yes. 3: **only overwrite the conditions and aggregation settings**, and **leave the index for the user to pick**. 5: OK.
entries.k: 逐點回答用 **編號＋冒號** 分隔，每點自成一句；「只覆蓋 A 與 B」= **only overwrite A and B**（覆蓋既有設定用 overwrite，不用 cover）；「留給使用者自己選」慣用 **leave X for the user to pick / choose**，或 **let the user pick X themselves**；「統計參數」在 ES 語境直接說 **aggregation settings / aggs**。

entries.o: hn use foo for BASE, otherwise custom hn
nat: **For the hn, use** `foo` in base mode; **in custom mode**, use **the custom statement's hn**.
**The hn should come from** `foo` for base queries and from the selected customer for custom ones.
entries.k: 主題先行的「**hn** 用 X」要補成 **For the hn**, **use** X 或改以 hn 當主詞 **the hn should come from X**；「否則」在兩種情境對照時，點名情境 **in custom mode** 比 otherwise 清楚，讀的人不用回頭推 otherwise 涵蓋哪些狀況；「custom 的 hn」要說出來源是誰的——**the custom statement's hn / the selected customer's hn**，custom hn 兩個名詞疊著會被讀成「自訂的 hn」。

series.title: every time
series.desc: same error, collected together; occurred 3 times, the third is in the "Could you" series #8

entries.o: give me the example ... when I send anything everytime
nat: **Every time** a message is sent, also show how a native speaker would phrase it.
**Every time** I send you a message, could you also show me how a native speaker would phrase it?
entries.k: **every time** 是兩個字；時間子句放句首；請求用 could you。

entries.o: everytime I send you a message, give me the native phrasing first, add to notes, then get started on the actual task
nat: **Every time** a message is sent, give **the** native phrasing first, add it to the notes, and then get started on the actual task.
**Every time** I send you a message, give me **the** native phrasing first, add it to the notes, and then get started on the actual task.
entries.k: **every time** 兩個字（同第 1 條）；add 要有受詞 —— add **it** to **the** notes（同文法結構第 6 條的缺受詞）。

entries.o: I don't think this split is better then what I wrote before. they are too similar
nat: This split isn't **an improvement over** the previous version — the two files are **too similar**.
I don't think this split is **an improvement over** what I had before — the two files are **too similar**.
entries.k: 比較級 better **than**（不是 then）；「我原本寫的」常說 what I had before。

entries.o: it is unnecessary to save phrasing if it is correct
nat: **It's unnecessary to** save the phrasing if it's correct.
**There's no need to** save a phrase if it's already correct.
entries.k: 「不需要做～」更口語的說法是 **There's no need to ...**。

entries.o: only 保留 meaning
nat: Only **the** ones where *leave* **means** "keep".
Just **the** "leave as is" **sense**, not "leave a comment".
entries.k: 指定「哪一個意思」說 **the ones where X means Y** / **the "..." sense**；排除另一義用 **not ...** 收尾。

entries.o: I've comfirmed the backend(1) ESQL 端點接受 index；(2) 空字串視同未設定
nat: **Confirmed** **with** the backend team: (1) the ESQL endpoint accepts `index`; (2) an empty string **is treated as unset**.
I've **confirmed** **with** the backend team: (1) the ESQL endpoint accepts `index`; (2) an empty string **is treated as unset**.
entries.k: 拼字 **confirmed**（comfirmed 是常見手滑）；「向後端確認」= confirm **with** the backend (team)——confirm the backend 是「確認後端本身」；「視同未設定」= **is treated as unset / not set**；I've confirmed 完成式用對了（同 Git 系列第 11 條）。

entries.o: there is no japanese or Korean in this project
nat: There's no Japanese or Korean **text** in this project.
entries.k: 語言／國籍形容詞是**專有形容詞要大寫**——**J**apanese（同句的 Korean 寫對了）；指語言內容補 **text / data** 更明確。

entries.o: agree with 模糊 comparsion
nat: The **fuzzy matching** **is fine**.
**I'm fine with** the **fuzzy matching**.
**Agreed** — **partial matching** on the account field is acceptable.
entries.k: 拼字 **comparison**（comparsion 少了一個 i，與第 19 條 comfirmed 同類的手滑）；「模糊比對」英文慣用 **fuzzy matching / partial match**，comparison 偏「比較兩者的差異」；單獨表示同意時用 **Agreed.** 或補主詞的 **I'm fine with ...**，agree with 開頭的殘句缺主詞。

entries.o: save it to memory, let me reivew tomorrow
nat: Save it to memory **for review tomorrow**.
Save it to memory — **I'll review it tomorrow**.
Stash this in memory; I'll **go over it** tomorrow.
entries.k: 拼字 **review**（reivew 字母對調，與第 19、9 條同類的手滑）；**let me review tomorrow 是在請求許可**（「讓我明天看」），要表達「我明天會看」用 **I'll review it tomorrow**；review 及物要補受詞 **it**；兩個獨立句用逗號連是 comma splice，用破折號或分號分開；「之後再細看」口語常說 **go over** it / take a look at it。

entries.o: existing is always undefine
nat: **Isn't** `existing` **always** **undefined** here?
`existing` is **always** **undefined**, **isn't** it?
entries.k: 詞形要用形容詞 **undefined**（先讀第 26 條的同類錯型）——undefine 是動詞「取消定義」（與第 19、9、23 條同類的手滑）；指出別人程式碼可能有問題時，用**附加問句** isn't it? 或 **Isn't X always …?** 開頭，語氣是提問而非斷定，若結論不成立也不尷尬；補上範圍 **in the init path / on load** 能讓對方直接知道你觀察的是哪條路徑。

entries.o: what's the different between these meaning
nat: What's the **difference** in meaning **between these**?
**How do these four names differ?**
entries.k: **different** 是形容詞、**difference** 才是名詞——What's the **difference**（與第 24 條 undefine / undefined 同類的詞形混用）；「差在意思上」用 **the difference in meaning between A and B**，不是 between ... meaning；these 後面接名詞要複數 **these names**，或乾脆省略只說 **between these**；比較多個命名候選，母語者更常直接說 **How do these differ?** 或 **What does each one imply?**

entries.o: you need to answer my question first, I'm confuse
nat: **Please** answer the question **first** — **it's confusing**.
**Can you** answer my question **first**? **I'm confused**.
**Hold on** — answer my question **first**, I'm getting **confused**.
entries.k: **confuse** 是動詞，說自己「感到困惑」要用 -ed 形容詞 **I'm confused**（同第 24 條 undefine/undefined、第 25 條 different/difference 的詞形混用；I'm confusing 是「我讓別人困惑」）；兩個獨立句用逗號連是 comma splice，分號、句號或破折號擇一；**you need to ...** 在工作對話偏命令，同樣意思用 **Can you ... first?** 或 **Hold on —** 起頭更自然，也更容易讓對方停下來。

entries.o: is this ; ponctuation necessary?
nat: **Is this semicolon necessary**?
**Do we actually need** that leading **semicolon**?
entries.k: 拼字 **punctuation**（ponctuation 是法／西語系的拼法，英文第一個母音是 u，同第 19、9、23 條的手滑類型）；**標點符號各有專名**，`;` 直接說 **semicolon** 比「this ; punctuation」精準，行首那一顆英文叫 **a leading semicolon**（順帶：`,` comma、`:` colon、`.` period、`—` em dash、`` ` `` backtick）；句型 **Is this X necessary?** 完全正確，想把語氣放軟、暗示「是不是其實不用」可用 **Do we actually need ...?**

entries.o: this text cannot be changed, name text would make me confusing
nat: This value is **read-only**, **so** **calling** it `text` **is confusing**.
This text **can't be edited** — the name `text` **confuses me**.
entries.k: **confuse 系列第四種變化**——「某個東西讓我困惑」是 **X confuses me** 或 **X is confusing**，**make me confusing** 是「把我變成一個會讓別人困惑的人」（-ed 給感到困惑的人 I'm confused、-ing 給引起困惑的東西，見第 26 條與 Could you 系列第 1604 行附近的 foo 條）；「把它命名為 text」講 **calling / naming it `text`**，name text 少了 -ing 與代名詞；程式裡「不能改」用 **read-only** 或 **can't be edited**，比 cannot be changed 更貼合前端情境；兩個完整句用逗號連是 comma splice（同第 26 條），改 **so** 連接或破折號。

entries.o: dsl prase sample like [貼上內容] reference file-a.html
nat: **Here's a sample** the DSL parser **should handle** — see `file-a.html` for how it's done there.
The parser needs to accept input **like this**; `file-a.html` already handles it, so **use that as a reference**.
entries.k: 拼字 **parse**（prase 是字母順序手滑，同第 19、9、23、27 條的手滑類型）；整句沒有動詞，貼樣本給對方時開頭用 **Here's a sample (that) X should handle** 把意圖講出來，不然對方得猜是「要支援這個」還是「這個壞了」；「參考某檔」的動詞是 **see X for reference / use X as a reference**，reference 單獨當動詞（reference X）在口語裡少見；like 後面接樣本要說 **like this / like the following**，不能直接接貼上的內容。

entries.o: are thesee foo the same? const foo = ref({}) strategy.devToolsQueryInfo()
nat: Are **these two** `foo` **the same thing** — the `ref({})` and `strategy.devToolsQueryInfo()`?
**Is** `strategy.devToolsQueryInfo()` **just returning that** `foo` ref, or is it something different?
entries.k: 拼字 **these**（thesee 多打一個 e，同第 19、9、23、27、16 條的手滑類型）；比較兩個同名東西時說 **these two X**，並把兩者用破折號接在問句後面，不要把程式碼直接黏在問號後；問「是不是同一個」可用 **the same thing**，或更精確地問 **is A just returning B?**，對方就知道你在問關係而不是相等。

entries.o: should foo rename to like vaild hn?
nat: Should `foo` **be renamed** **to something like** `bar`?
Would a name like `bar` fit `foo` better, **since it's blank for** the general customer?
entries.k: 拼字 **valid**（vaild 是 i、l 對調，同第 19、9、23、27、16、17 條的手滑類型）；**rename to like X** 少了名詞，要 **to something like X**（同文法結構第 132 條）；被改名的是變數，用被動 **be renamed**（主被動問題第六次）；問命名時把理由帶上 **since it's blank for …**，對方能針對理由給建議。

entries.o: could you descirbe what is foo use for
nat: What **is** `foo` **used for**?
Could you **describe** what `foo` **is used for**?
**What's** `foo` **for**, exactly?
entries.k: 拼字 **describe**（descirbe 是 r、i 對調，同第 19、9、23、27、16、17、18 條的手滑類型）；**間接問句不倒裝**——what **is X** use for → what **X is used** for（同文法結構第 70 條 what is the suggestion mean 的間接問句問題）；「被用來做什麼」是被動 **is used for**，use 要加 -d；口語最短的問法是 **what's X for?**。

entries.o: add this to the code comment
nat: Add **this** to **the code comments**.
Put **that explanation** **in a comment next to the declaration**.
entries.k: 文法正確，差在單複數與位置——程式碼裡的註解泛指時用複數 **the code comments**，或直接講位置 **in a comment next to the declaration**；**this** 指上一則的說明，口語用 **that explanation** 更明確。

entries.o: remove select all, use multi selecter for status is fine
nat: **Drop** the select-all; **a multi-select** for status **is fine**.
No need for select-all — **using** **a multi-select** for status **is fine**.
entries.k: **動作當主詞要用動名詞**——**using** a multi-select … is fine，或乾脆用名詞當主詞 **a multi-select … is fine**（use … is fine 是動詞原形直接當主詞，同第 51、54 條 click … / paste … 當主詞的問題）；**selecter → selector** 拼字，且 UI 上的多選下拉母語者直接叫 **a multi-select**（名詞）；「拿掉某功能」口語 **drop / ditch the select-all**；兩個祈使句用逗號相連是 comma splice，改分號或破折號。

entries.o: how about the version 4.7.0
nat: **How about version 4.7.0?**
**What about version 4.7.0?**
entries.k: **「名詞＋編號」當專名不加 the**——version 4.7.0（同 Git 系列第 21 條 on PR 511、拼字系列 issue 8 的規則）。

entries.o: ignore the upper/lower case of phrasing note
nat: Ignore **capitalization** **in** the phrasing **notes**.
Don't flag **capitalization** **in** the **notes**.
entries.k: 「大小寫」的單字就是 **capitalization**（upper/lower case 是在描述字母本身，指「該不該大寫」這件事要用 capitalization）；範圍用 **in** 不用 of——in the notes；筆記檔是複數 **notes**（同本檔名 phrasing notes），且要冠詞 the。

entries.o: 驗證：新增角色，擁有 foo_key 但無權限請求 系統使用者列表API: 403 無法存取此客戶資源。與後端確認 -> 像 bug
nat: **Verified**: a role with `foo_key` but no **cross-customer access** gets a 403 "Cannot access this customer's resources" from the users list API. **Checked** with the backend **team** — **it looks like a bug** **on their side**.

**Verified**: I created a role with `foo_key` but no **cross-customer access**, and the users list API returns 403 "Cannot access this customer's resources". I **checked** with the backend **team** — **it looks like a bug** **on their side**.
entries.k: 回報驗證結果開頭用 **Verified:** 或 **I tested this:**（中文「驗證：」直譯成 Verification: 偏書面報告的語氣）；「向後端確認」是 **check / confirm with the backend (team)**（同拼字與易混字第 19 條，confirm the backend 會變成「確認後端這個東西本身」）；「像 bug」= **it looks like a bug / seems to be a bug**，要指出是哪一邊的問題就補 **on their side / on the backend side**；「跨客戶權限」= **cross-customer access / permission**；「強制檢查某參數」= **it forces a check on the `bar` param** 或 **it enforces the `bar` check**。

entries.o: why not just save the source 節點, would it also fix the solwer problem?
nat: **Why not just** **keep** a reference to the source node? Would that also fix **the slowness**?
entries.k: 拼字 **slower**（solwer 是字母對調的手滑，同拼字與易混字第 19 條 comfirmed）；**the slower problem 不自然**——名詞化說 **the slowness** / **the performance problem**（形容詞比較級不當名詞修飾語用）；程式裡「留住某個物件」是 **keep / hold a reference to X**，**save** 偏「存檔、寫進儲存體」，語意會被讀成把節點存起來；兩個問句用逗號連是 comma splice（同文法結構第 51、66 條），各自收問號；**Why not just ...?** 質疑做法的用法正確（同文法結構第 69 條，第二次出現）。

entries.o: A 暫不使用，待有需求再啟用
nat: **Go with A**. Leave the OR entry commented out **for now** — it can be turned back on when it's **actually** needed.
**Go with A**. Leave the OR entry commented out **for now** — we can turn it back on when we **actually** need it.
entries.k: 回覆選項別只丟一個字母，講 **Go with A** / **Let's go with A** 對方才確定你在選哪個；「暫不使用」= **leave it commented out for now** / **keep it disabled for now**（**for now** 就是「暫時」，不要直譯成 temporarily not use）；「待有需求再啟用」= **turn it on / enable it when we actually need it**（when there's a need 太生硬，用 when we need it 即可，加 **actually** 帶出「真的需要時才」的語氣）。

entries.o: I want to use these new props in new project, so the reviewer said 5 個既有呼叫端沒有任何一個使用這些新 props, is not affect the existed one
nat: These new props are planned for **a** new project, so the reviewer's point — that none of the five **existing** callers use them — just means the existing **ones** aren't affected.
I'm planning to use these new props in **a** new project, so the reviewer's point — that none of the five **existing** callers use them — just means the existing **ones** aren't affected.
entries.k: 「既有的」形容詞是 **existing** 不是 existed（同第 7 條）；否定要有助動詞——**doesn't affect**（is not affect 是 be 動詞＋原形動詞的混用）；**a** new project 要冠詞；受影響的是複數 the existing **ones**。（原分類：文法結構）

entries.o: 未來的 start 會被靜默改成今日開始 is 既有行為
nat: **Silently clamping** a future start back to the start of today is **pre-existing behavior** — **it predates this PR**.
entries.k: 「既有行為」審查回覆慣用 **pre-existing behavior**，或動詞說法 **it predates this PR**（早於本 PR 就存在）；「靜默改掉」= **silently clamping/overwriting**。（原分類：Git）

entries.o: exclude user itself
nat: Exclude **the** user **themselves**.
Exclude **the** current user from the list.
entries.k: **itself** 指物，人的反身代名詞用 **themselves**（單數中性）或 himself/herself；user 要冠詞 **the**。

entries.o: what's the different between (t) and 把 text 寫成 getter
nat: What's the **difference** between passing `(t)` in and making `text` a getter?
entries.k: **difference** 是名詞、different 是形容詞——固定句型 **What's the difference between A and B?**；「把 X 寫成 Y」= **make X a Y / turn X into a Y**。

entries.o: why not move foo to the existing ones like file-a.js
nat: Why not move `foo` **into** **an existing module** like `file-a.js`?
entries.k: 「現有的某個檔案」= **an existing module/file**——**the ... ones** 需要前文有複數先行詞，此處沒有（existing 用法正確，同 existing 系列第 6、7 條的修正內化）；move **into** a module。

series.title: leave
series.desc: the "keep / leave alone" sense, collected together; "leave a comment" is in Git · review #14, #15

entries.o: ignore passed commit, go ahead
nat: **Leave** the already-pushed commits **as they are** — go ahead.
Don't rebase the **past** commits; go ahead.
entries.k: **passed**（pass 的過去式/分詞）≠ **past**（形容詞「過去的」）——the **past** commits；「不動既有 commit」更道地說 **leave ... as they are / don't touch ...**（同本系列第 16 條 keep ... as is）；commit 要複數。

entries.o: remain old file
nat: **Keep** the old file.
**Leave** the old file **as is**.
entries.k: remain 是**不及物動詞**不能接受詞；「保留」用 keep / leave ... as is。（原分類：文法結構・動詞與受詞系列 第 4 條）

entries.o: no year limit in csv, keep b148bfab as is, go ahead
nat: **There's no** one-year limit for the CSV import — **leave** `b148bfab` **as is**, and **go ahead**.
entries.k: 陳述「沒有～」開頭補 **There's no ...**（名詞片語單獨當句子只適合便條）；多個子句用破折號或 **and** 串（comma splice 同 Git 系列第 8、20 條，第三次出現）；**keep/leave ... as is** 與 **go ahead** 都很道地。（原分類：Git・review 第 22 條）

entries.o: go ahead with plan B, keep the tmp block uncommitted
nat: Go ahead with plan B, and **keep** the tmp block **uncommitted**.
Go ahead with plan B — **leave** the tmp block **out of the commit**.
entries.k: 兩個祈使句不能只用逗號相連（comma splice **第四次出現**，同 Git 系列第 8、20 條與本系列第 16 條）——補 **and** 或改破折號；**keep ... uncommitted** 與 **leave ... out of the commit** 都很道地，go ahead with 也用得對。（原分類：Git・review 第 25 條）

entries.o: update the yt ticket's content, ignore the stage
nat: Update the YouTrack ticket's **description** — **leave** the stage **as is**.
entries.k: 兩個祈使句只用逗號相連是 comma splice（**第五次**，同 Git 系列第 8、20 條與本系列第 16、17 條）——改破折號或 and；工單「內容」慣用 **description**；「不動」= **leave ... as is**。（原分類：YouTrack 工單 第 10 條，更早為 Git）

entries.o: leave the bug fixing file-a.vue in the new issue that you have created
nat: Leave **the** `file-a.vue` **fix** to the new ticket.
Leave **the** `file-a.vue` **fix** to the new ticket **you created**.
Don't fix `file-a.vue` here — **put it in the new ticket**.
entries.k: 「留給某張單處理」是 **leave X to / for Y**（leave ... in 會被讀成「放在裡面」，同本系列「不動／留著」的 leave 用法但介係詞不同）；「修某檔案的 bug」名詞化用 **the fix for X / the X fix**，**bug fixing** 是動名詞片語，後面不能直接黏受詞；**that you have created → you created**：特定的一次過去動作用簡單過去式，關係代名詞 that 可省略（同文法結構第 146 條的時態選擇）。（原分類：介係詞與冠詞）

entries.o: leave 8 issue as it is
nat: **Leave** **issue 8** **as is**.
**Leave** #8 alone — **no ticket for it**.
entries.k: **leave ... as is** 用對了（本系列第 12、16、18 條的修正內化）；編號放在名詞**後面**——**issue 8 / item 8 / #8**（8 issue 是中文語序）；不開單可直接說 **no ticket for it**。

entries.o: keep it as is, and review
nat: **Keep it as is**, and **go ahead with the review**.
Leave it as is and review **the changes**.
entries.k: **keep it as is** 用得對（本系列修正內化）；review 及物補受詞——review **the changes/it**，或名詞化 **go ahead with the review**；這次有 and、沒犯 comma splice。

entries.o: refactor it, ignore dragging first, leave it to later fix
nat: Go ahead with the refactor — **ignore dragging for now**; **it'll be fixed later**.
Go ahead with the refactor — **ignore dragging for now**, **I'll fix it later**.
Refactor it; skip the drag-and-drop **for now** and leave that for later.
entries.k: **leave it to later fix 不成立**——「留待之後處理」是 **leave it for later** / **leave that until later**，要講明誰修就說 **I'll fix it later**（to 後面接原形才是目的，later fix 是名詞片語，接不上）；「先不管」用 **for now** 不用 first——**ignore dragging for now / skip it for now**（first 是「先做 A 再做 B」的順序，這裡是「暫時擱著」）；三個子句用逗號串是 comma splice（本系列第 16、17、18 條的老問題）——改破折號或分號。

entries.o: show me the diff about 工作區那三處序列化錯誤
nat: Show **the diff for** **those three serialization bugs** in **the working tree**.
Show me **the diff for** **those three serialization bugs** in **the working tree**.
Show me the diff of **those three spots**.
entries.k: **diff about X 不自然**——diff 指向具體的程式碼位置，用 **the diff for / of X**（about 是「關於某個主題」，適合 a question about、a doc about，不適合 diff）；「那三處」= **those three spots / those three places**，指出是什麼問題就說 **those three serialization bugs**；「工作區」= **the working tree**（git 用語，不是 workspace）。

entries.o: show me the third error diff first
nat: Show **the diff for the third bug** first.
Show me **the diff for the third bug** first.
**Start with** the third one — show me that diff.
entries.k: **the third error diff 名詞疊了三層**，英文習慣用介係詞拆開——**the diff for the third bug**（延續第 25 條的 diff **for** X）；要強調順序也可把 first 換成動詞開頭的 **Start with ...**，語氣更自然。

entries.o: fix
nat: Fix **that**.
**Go ahead and** **fix** it.
entries.k: **fix 是及物動詞，單獨用缺受詞**（同本系列第 23 條 review 的老問題）——指著剛討論的東西至少補 **that / it**；要更明確就點名 **Fix the ternary.**；口語同意對方提議並請他動手，母語者常用 **Go ahead and ...**，比單一動詞客氣也更清楚。

entries.o: ok, apply the memory update / also updade all the title
nat: OK, apply the memory **update**. **Also**, update **all the headings**.
Go ahead with the memory **update**, and translate the rest of the **headings** too.
entries.k: 拼字 **update**（updade 手滑，同 Other Spelling 系列多條）；「全部標題」是複數 **all the headings**（all the ＋ 可數名詞要加 s）；Markdown 的 `##` / `###` 節標題叫 **headings**，**title** 多指整份文件或頁面的標題（同 "Could you" 請求句第 52 條）；兩個指令用句號分開或以 **Also,** 起頭接第二句，不要用斜線或換行硬接。

series.title: too / as well / same for · like / as / the same way
series.titleZh: 也一樣：too / as well / same for · like / as / the same way
series.keys: too / as well / same for / like / as / the same way
aliases: also → too / as well / same for
series.desc: Sentence-initial "also X" reads as a note; natives end with too / as well, or say "same for X".

entries.o: also width
nat: **Do the same for the width**.
**Make the width follow the** viewport **too**.
entries.k: **also + 名詞**沒有動詞，對方得猜「寬度怎樣」；接續上一個動作的講法是 **do the same for X** 或把動作講出來 **make X … too**；**also** 放句首時後面要有完整子句，句尾用 **too** 比較口語。

entries.o: if dsl gt then insert as gte, also lt->lte
nat: **If the DSL uses** `gt`, insert it as `gte`; **same for** `lt` → `lte`.
**Map** `gt` **to** `gte` and `lt` to `lte` on import — **the form only has inclusive bounds**.
entries.k: **if dsl gt** 少動詞，**if the DSL uses / has `gt`**；「A 對成 B」用 **map A to B**（同第 153 條）；「另一個也一樣」口語是 **same for X**，比 also X->Y 完整；補一句理由 **the form only has inclusive bounds** 讓對方知道這是刻意的近似。

entries.o: also SOC side, keep Target
nat: **Include the SOC side too**, and **keep "Target" as is**.
**The SOC side as well**; **leave the existing "Target" wording alone**.
entries.k: **also SOC side** 沒有動詞與冠詞——回答「範圍也要含 X」用 **include X too / X as well**，補上 **the** SOC side；「維持不動」= **keep X as is / leave X alone**（同 leave 系列）；兩個決定用 **and** 或分號連接，逗號直接黏是 comma splice（同第 136、137、140 條）；答覆兩個問題時，對應到題號更清楚：**Q1: include the SOC side. Q2: keep "Target".**

entries.o: when data is invalid, foo also need to reset
nat: When `data` is invalid, `foo` **needs to be reset** **too**.
Reset `foo` **as well** **in the null-data branch**.
entries.k: **need → needs**（單數主詞第三人稱，同拼字與易混字第 28 條 the catch does）；**need to reset → needs to be reset**，被重設的是那個 flag（主被動問題第七次）；**also** 放句尾改 **too / as well** 比較口語；「那個分支」可以直接點名 **in the null-data branch**，比 when data is invalid 更貼近程式碼。

entries.o: also put Button into the component?
nat: **Should the button go into** the component **too**?
**Could you move the button into** the component **as well**?
entries.k: 可數名詞要冠詞——the **button**（指畫面上那顆，同第 23 條 the wording 與第 13、19、16、17、19 條的冠詞漏字）；動詞片語直接加問號不成問句，提議做法用 **Should X go into … ?**，請對方做用 **Could you move X into … as well?**；「也」接在句尾 **too / as well** 比句首 also 口語。

entries.o: apply (b), also FOO
nat: Apply (b), **and do the same for** `FOO`.
Go with (b), and **give** `FOO` **the same treatment**.
entries.k: **also ＋ 名詞不能單獨接在句子後面**（同第 72 條，第二次出現）——要補動詞片語 **and do the same for X** 或 **and apply it to X as well**；**as well 放句尾**、also 放動詞前，兩者不要混用；「照同一個模式處理」母語者常說 **give X the same treatment**。

entries.o: go ahead, also add the test ／ go ahead, also add the tests
nat: Go ahead, and add the test **as well**.
Go ahead**, and** add the tests **as well**.
entries.k:
兩個祈使句只用逗號相連是 comma splice（同第 148、35 條）——補 **and**；also 放動詞前（and **also** add）或句尾改 **as well / too**；the test 指前面提議的那條測試，冠詞用得對。
與第 156 條完全相同的 comma splice（go ahead, also ...）——補 **and**；複數 the tests 用得對。

entries.o: status >= 500 && status < 600 also duplicate
nat: `status >= 500 && status < 600` **is duplicated** **too**.
That 5xx check **is duplicated** **as well**.
entries.k: **缺 be 動詞＋被動**——duplicate 當動詞是「複製」，「被重複」要用 **is duplicated**（同第 50 條 duplicated code，第二次出現；被動缺失同第 2、199 條）；**also 放句中、too/as well 放句尾**——`... is duplicated too` ✓ / `... is also duplicated` ✓，`also duplicate` 掛句尾不成句；口語也常說 **that check shows up twice**。

entries.o: also apply dragging in here
nat: **Enable** dragging **here** **too**.
Let the nested blocks reorder their own rows **as well**.
entries.k: **in here 的 in 多餘**——指「這個地方、這個檔案裡」用 **here** 就夠（in here 通常指實體空間內部，如 it's cold in here）；**apply 是「套用某個既有的東西」**（apply a patch / a style），開啟一個功能要用 **enable / add**；also 放句首偏正式，口語把 **too / as well** 放句尾更自然。

entries.o: also replace others
nat: Replace **the other ones** **too**.
**Do the same for the rest**.
entries.k: 指「同一處其餘那些」要 **the others / the other ones**（others 不加 the 是泛指「別的」，同第 33 至 40 條的冠詞漏字）；「比照辦理」最口語是 **do the same for the rest**；also 放句首偏正式，口語把 **too / as well** 放句尾。

entries.o: also here
nat: **Here too**.
**Same here**.
Apply it here **as well**.
