entries.k: 「這裡也要」最口語是 **Here too** / **Same here**；完整句用 **as well** 收尾（apply it here as well），also 要放動詞前（*also apply it here*）而不是句首孤立。

entries.o: rename foo_key to bar_key, and also img
nat: **Rename** `foo_key` **to** `bar_key`, and do the same for `baz_key`. / ... **and the img one too**.
entries.k: 前半 **rename A to B** 用得完全正確（replace 系列第 16 條的修正內化）；後半 and also img 同第 72 條「also X」的省略問題（**第二次**）——補動詞與受詞 **do the same for `baz_key`**，或口語 **and the img one too**。

entries.o: but I want to allow all the actions same as this project
nat: But **it should have** **the same permissions as this project**.
But **I want it to have** **the same permissions as this project**.
I want every action allowed there, **just like in this project**.
entries.k: **the same A as B** 是固定搭配，same 前不能沒有 the、後面不能少 as（all the actions same as ✗）；主詞要講清楚是「那個目錄」而不是我——**I want it to have ...**；權限語境用 **permissions**（allow all the actions 偏中式直譯）；「跟這個專案一樣」也可說 **just like in this project**。

entries.o: use the same logic like file-a.js
nat: Use **the same approach as** `file-a.js`.
Make it work **the same** way `file-a.js` does.
entries.k: **the same X as**，不能用 like——same 的比較對象一律接 **as**（like 只用在「像……那樣」的鬆散比喻，不接在 same 後面，同第 60 條 the same way **as in** file-b.vue）；講程式的寫法慣用 **approach / pattern**，**logic** 偏指「運算邏輯本身」，說 the same logic 會被理解成「同一段運算」而不是「同一種寫法」；要表達「照它的做法做」也可說 **follow the same pattern as X**。（原分類：介係詞與冠詞 第 29 條）

entries.o: fix login-modal catch the same way as file-a.vue, and save it to the notes
nat: Fix **the catch in login-modal the same way** **as in** file-a.vue, and save **this** to the notes.
entries.k: 特定那個 catch 要冠詞——**the** catch（同第 58 條 an index prop 的可數名詞補冠詞）；「在 X 檔裡的 catch」用 **the catch in X** 比名詞疊在一起（login-modal catch）自然；對比句 the same way **as in** file-a.vue 補 in 才對稱（比較的是「在 file-a.vue 裡怎麼做」）；「存這件事」指整句話用 **this** 比 it 清楚。（原分類：介係詞與冠詞 第 20 條）

entries.o: could Foo write like ai-summary-form?
nat: Could `Foo` **be written** the same way as `ai-summary-form`?
Could we **structure it like** `ai-summary-form`?
entries.k: 元件是「被寫」，要用被動 **be written**；「照～的寫法」= the same way as ... / structure it like ...。（原分類：文法結構 第 2 條）

entries.o: would it be better to rename mode-strategies to fit this demand, like file-a.js include the share function?
nat: **Would it be better to** rename `file-b.js` to fit this **need** — **the way** `file-a.js` also hosts the **shared** functions?
entries.k: **Would it be better to ...** 正確使用（第 59 條內化）；like 後接完整子句要改 **the way / just as ... does**，且動詞第三人稱 include**s**；「共用函式」= **shared** function（share 是動詞）；「這個需求」= this **need/purpose**（demand 偏索求，同 Git 系列第 6 條）。（原分類：文法結構 第 22 條）

entries.o: could you add a drag-over class when dragging like Foo
nat: Add a **drag-over class** **while** dragging, **the way** `Foo` **does**.
Could you add a **drag-over class** **while** dragging, **the way** `Foo` **does**?
entries.k: **like + 名詞不能拿來比「做法」**——比較兩邊的行為要用 **the way X does** 或 **like X does**（補上 does），否則 like Foo 會黏到最近的 dragging，讀起來像「拖曳得像 Foo 一樣」；持續中的狀態用 **while** 比 when 精準（when 偏「在～的時候／一旦」，while 強調整段過程）；**drag-over class**（連字號）寫法正確，CSS class 名當名詞用就這樣寫；請求句記得收問號。（原分類：Could you 請求句 第 42 條）

entries.o: design it likes these buttons
nat: **Style it like these buttons**.
**Make it look like these buttons**.
entries.k: **like** 是介係詞、不加 s——likes 是動詞「喜歡」，寫 it likes 會變成「它喜歡」；「做成跟～一樣的樣式」動詞用 **style it like X** 或 **make it look like X**（design 當動詞時受詞是「設計本身」，指定樣式不用 design it like）。（原分類：文法結構 第 70 條）

entries.o: fix foo 未防 selected 為 undefined
nat: **Guard** `foo` **against** `selected` **being undefined**.
**Fix the case** in `foo` **where** `selected` **can be undefined**.
entries.k: 「防呆／加防護」母語者用 **guard X against Y**（或 **add a guard for …**），比 protect / prevent 更貼近程式語境；「某某情況」= **the case where …**（where 引導條件，不用 when）；「為 undefined」講成 **being undefined**（動名詞接在 against 後面）；點名要修的東西時，函式名後面直接接受詞即可，不用先寫檔名。

entries.o: 且正常情況不會出現此情境
nat: And it doesn't **come up** **in normal usage** **anyway**.
This case doesn't **occur** **in practice**.
entries.k: 「正常情況／實務上」用 **in practice** 或 **in normal usage**，不要直譯 in normal situation；「不會出現」動詞選 **come up**（自然浮現）或 **occur**，比 appear 更貼近「遇到這種情況」；句首的「且」是補充理由，英文放句尾 **anyway** 比句首 And 更自然。

entries.o: click the button to show elk dev tools query, transform foo and bar to dsl format json like test-query*.json also reference file-a.html
nat: **When the button is clicked**, show the ELK Dev Tools query: **convert** `foo` and `bar` into Elasticsearch DSL, **in the same JSON shape** as the `test-query*.json` files. **See** `file-a.html` **for reference** too.
entries.k: **「格式像 X」要說 in the same JSON shape / format as X**——json like X 又是 like 拿來比做法（同第 143 條 the same logic like，same 的比較對象一律接 as）；把資料「轉成」某格式用 **convert X into Y**，transform 偏數學／資料管線語感；「也參考 X」不說 also reference X（reference 當動詞是「引用／指涉」），用 **see X for reference / use X as a reference**；交代開發任務時觸發條件講成 **when the button is clicked / so clicking it shows ...**，原句 click the button to show 讀起來像在教使用者操作而不是在描述要做的功能。

entries.o: 執行順位 1. 新儀錶板使用新架構 2. 集團式儀表板：客戶有多間子公司掛在不同 profile，希望能看到所有子公司 3. 可以用自然語言產生 UI 畫面，不同 profile 客製化 4. BI 移轉有空再做
nat: **Priority order**: 1. Build new dashboards on the new architecture first. 2. Group-level dashboard: a customer with several subsidiaries **under different profiles** wants to see all of them **in one view**. 3. **Generate** the UI **from natural language**, with per-profile customization. 4. Migrate the BI dashboards **when time allows**.
entries.k: 「執行順位」= **priority order / order of execution**；「有空再做」口語用 **when time allows** 或 **as a lower priority**，不說 do it when free；「掛在不同 profile」= **under different profiles**；「看到所有子公司」補 **in one view** 才傳達「集中在一個畫面」的意思；「用 X 產生」= **generate ... from X**。

entries.o: write this to memory
nat: **Save** this to memory.
**Add this to memory**.
entries.k: 「寫入記憶／存檔」慣用 **save/add to**。

entries.o: 抽成純版面的 Foo，行為全由外面餵
nat: **Go with** the pure-layout `Foo` — keep the behavior fed in from the outside.
**Let's go with** the pure-layout `Foo` — keep the behavior fed in from the outside.
entries.k: 採納方案說 **Let's go with...**；「由外部餵入」= fed in from the outside / driven by the parent。

entries.o: 請彙整 昨天~今天 工作摘要，區分各模組功能，一個分支一句話
nat: **Put together** a summary of the work from yesterday **through** today, **grouped by** module, **one sentence per branch**.
Could you **put together** a summary of my work from yesterday **through** today, **grouped by** module, **one sentence per branch**?
entries.k: 「彙整」= **put together / compile** a summary；「昨天到今天」= from yesterday **through** today；「區分各模組」= **grouped by** module；「一個分支一句話」= **one sentence per branch**。

entries.o: 大部分情境要回應 foo = bar.response.data.message ...，部分情境 5xx 才提早回應
nat: **In most cases** the backend message should still be returned — only for 5xx **does it** **return early** with the fixed one.
**In most cases** we still want to return the backend message — only for 5xx **do we** **return early** with the fixed one.
entries.k: 「大部分情境」= **in most cases / for the most part**；「只有…才」用 only 開頭要**倒裝**——only for 5xx **do we** return early；程式語境的「提早回應／回傳」是 **return early**（respond 是「回覆對方」，用在 API/人）；「固定文案」= **the fixed message**（同文法結構第 50 條）。

entries.o: 部分頁面 5xx 顯示預設訊息，部分頁面顯示「系統忙碌中」
nat: **On a 5xx**, **some** pages show **their own default message** **while others** show "System is busy".
entries.k: 「部分…部分…」= **some ... while others ...**（不說 part of the pages）；「各自的預設訊息」= **their own default message**（強調各頁不同用 their own）；狀態碼前面加介係詞——**on a 5xx / for 5xx responses**。

entries.o: 但有時候 5xx 後端會有 axios 原文要顯示
nat: But sometimes **on a 5xx** the raw axios message **does** need to be shown.
But sometimes **on a 5xx** we **do** want to show the raw axios message.
entries.k: 「有時候…是要顯示的」強調語氣用助動詞 **do**——we **do** want to show（中文的「會有…要顯示」直譯成 there will be ... to show 很不自然）；「原文」= **the raw message / the raw axios text**（不是 original text）；狀態碼前一樣要 **on a 5xx**（同第 6 條）。

entries.o: but maybe it will contain a PR issue in the future, would it fit both rules?
nat: But it **might** end up **covering PR rules** too — would that name **still** fit both?
entries.k: **contain a PR issue → cover PR rules**（contain 用於容器裝東西；規則類用 **cover**；issue 在這裡不是「議題」而是規則本身）；不確定的未來用 **might** 比 maybe ... will 精簡；「還適用嗎」= **would it still fit**（**still** 不能少，否則問句失去「原本適用、之後呢」的對比）；逗號接問句是 comma splice，用破折號斷開（同第 76、98、106、87 條）。

entries.o: Button 單選
nat: Make the buttons **single-select**.
The buttons should be **mutually exclusive** — **only one active at a time**.
entries.k: UI 上「單選」= **single-select**（元件層面）或 **mutually exclusive**（描述行為）；要講清楚可補 **only one active at a time**；「複選」對應 **multi-select**，「可疊加」= **stackable / can be combined**。

entries.o: the fixed one is not copy action 固定區is not複製, just remove that description
nat: **The fixed column** isn't **a copy** of the row — just **drop** **that wording**.
**The fixed column** isn't **a duplicate**; remove **that bit** from the comment.
entries.k: **copy action 不成立**——「複製品」名詞直接說 **a copy / a duplicate**，action 是多餘的贅字（同第 78 條的詞彙選擇問題）；主詞寫明 **the fixed column**，**the fixed one** 要有前文才知道指哪一個；講程式碼註解裡的那段文字，母語者多說 **that wording / that bit / that line**，**description** 偏指 PR、工單那種「說明欄位」；「把那段刪掉」用 **drop / remove that bit (about X)**（同第 18 條 drop the part about X，第二次出現）；否定判斷後面接指令，用破折號或分號分開兩個子句比逗號好（逗號會成 comma splice，同文法結構第 51、66、79 條）。

entries.o: 以上in是錯誤設定，需轉換為 out
nat: All the inputs above are **malformed** — each one **should be normalized to** **the output next to it**.
These input shapes are wrong; convert each to the `out` shape I **listed**.
entries.k: 「（資料）格式錯誤／結構不對」的專門字是 **malformed**（wrong setting 會被讀成「設定值填錯」，指的是 config 而非資料形狀）；「轉換為正規形式」在解析器的情境固定用 **normalize X to Y**，一般的轉換才用 convert；規格句的主詞是資料，所以用**被動＋should**——**should be normalized to …**（需 = should，不是 need to，need to 帶「有此必要」的語氣，規格陳述用 should）；指「旁邊那個對照」說 **the output next to it** 或 **the shape I listed**，不要只寫 out。

entries.o: foo if (block.rules.length) return null 甚麼情況下不成立?
nat: In `foo`, **when** does that **guard clause** not fire?
**Under what conditions** is `block.rules` empty, so execution gets past the early return?
entries.k: 提前返回的那一行專名叫 **guard clause**（`if (...) return` 的固定說法），講「那個 early return」也通；「條件不成立」對 if 而言是 **doesn't fire / doesn't hit / evaluates to false**，不要直譯成 isn't established；「在什麼情況下」= **when / under what conditions / in what cases**；指明是哪個函式裡的哪一行，句首用 **In `foo`, …**（同文法結構第 110 條，把函式名丟句首會變成沒關係的兩塊）。

entries.o: please describe what these mean
nat: **Walk through** what **these two lines** do.
**Could you** **walk me through** what **these two lines** do?
Can you **explain** what **these two lines** are doing?
entries.k: **describe** 是「描述外觀／特徵」，要人解釋邏輯用 **explain** 或 **walk me through**（walk sb through 帶「一步步帶我看過」的意思，問程式碼最常用）；程式碼是「做什麼」不是「意思是什麼」——**what these lines do**，不要用 what these mean；裸 these 指涉不清，補上數量與單位 **these two lines**；同事之間 **Could you …?** 比 please＋祈使句自然（please 開頭偏指示語氣，同 Could you 請求句系列的通則）。

entries.o: backend would also never create this, so this case will never happen
nat: The **backend** wouldn't produce this **either**, so that case **can't happen**.
**Neither the UI nor the backend produces this** shape, so **it's unreachable**.
entries.k: 否定句裡的「也」是 **either** 不是 **also**——wouldn't produce this **either**（also 只用在肯定句；要放句首則用 **Neither A nor B …**）；**backend 指系統或團隊時要冠詞**——**the** backend（同介係詞與冠詞節冠詞漏字的通則）；「這種情況不可能發生」用 **can't happen**（邏輯上的不可能）比 will never happen（預測未來）貼切，程式碼情境也常說 **it's unreachable**；produce / emit 比 create 更貼近「程式輸出某個形狀」。

entries.o: this should exist
nat: This shape **has to keep working**.
**This is a real query we have** — it needs to survive the round-trip.
entries.k: **exist 只說「存在」，講不出「要被支援／不能被改壞」**——要對方保住某個形狀，說 **has to keep working / needs to be supported / must round-trip unchanged**；貼一段真實資料當反例時，先點明它是反例 —— **This is a real query we have** 一句就讓對方知道你在推翻前面的規則，而不是又給一個新需求（同第 83 條「講清楚前提」的通則）。

entries.o: add a description for card-head-con
nat: Add a **comment** describing `card-head-con`.
**Document what** `card-head-con` does.
entries.k: 程式碼裡的說明文字是 **comment**（CSS 也一樣），**description** 會被讀成某個欄位／工單的描述文字（同慣用說法先前「add a description」被讀成新增欄位的提醒，**第二次**）；「說明某個東西」也可直接用動詞 **document X**；補在哪就說 **above the rule / next to the declaration**。

entries.o: ok, and return foo(res) immediately
nat: OK, and just **return** `foo(res)` **directly**.
OK — **drop the wrapper** and return `foo(res)` as is.
entries.k: 「不要多包一層、直接回傳」是 **return X directly / just return X**；**immediately** 是時間上的「立刻」（例如 immediately after mount），用在這裡會被讀成時序而不是「省掉包裝」；也可以把要拿掉的東西講出來 **drop the wrapper**，對方更清楚。

entries.o: why didn't you update english phrasing in this session
nat: Why weren't any English **phrasing** notes added **this session**?
Why didn't you add any English **phrasing** notes **this session**?
Why **haven't you been doing** the English **phrasing** **this session**?
entries.k: **update → add / do**：筆記是「新增條目」，update 會讓人以為已有某條要改；**phrasing 單獨當受詞語意不完整**，補成 **the English phrasing notes**（或直接說 the phrasing block）；「這次 session」直接說 **this session**，不用 in（同 this week / this time 的用法）；整個 session 都沒做的「持續性遺漏」用現在完成進行式 **haven't you been doing**，didn't 偏單次。

entries.o: if you write #114, it will point at this project pr, not the exact one
nat: Writing #114 **points to** **this repo's PR** 114, not **the one in soc-tms**.
If you write #114, it'll **point to** **this repo's PR** 114, not **the one in soc-tms**.
**Writing #114 links to** **this repo's PR** 114, not **the one I meant**.
entries.k: 連結「指向」用 **point to**——point at 是用手指著東西；「這個專案的 PR」= **this repo's PR**（repo 比 project 貼切，且要所有格）；「正確的那個」不是 the exact one——用 **the right one / the one I meant / the one in soc-tms**，exact 是「精確無誤」不是「對的那個」；條件句也可改動名詞主詞 **Writing #114 links to …** 更簡潔。

entries.o: increase foo maxlength, and add a hover to display total string if it was truncated
nat: **Raise** the `foo` **max length**, and **show** **the full string** **on hover** **when it's** been **truncated**.
Bump the truncation limit and **put the full text in a tooltip** for **truncated** cells.
entries.k: 「完整字串」是 **the full string / the full text**——total 是「總計、加總」，不用來形容「沒被截斷的整段」；「滑過顯示」母語者說 **show X on hover** 或 **put X in a tooltip**，add a hover 把 hover 當名詞不自然；「被截斷時」用現在式或現在完成式 **when it's (been) truncated**，was 會變成在講過去某次；「調高上限」口語 **raise / bump the limit**；**max length** 兩個字。

entries.o: maybe there is no need to calculate foo in bar, only need to limit max width?
nat: Maybe `bar` **doesn't need** to run `foo` **at all** — just **clamp** to the max width?
**Do we even need** `foo` in `bar`? Capping the width should be enough.
entries.k: 函式是「呼叫」不是「計算」——**call / run `foo`**，calculate 是算數值；**only need to limit 缺主詞**——**we only need to cap the width**（同第 165 條缺主詞型）；「限制在上限」程式語境常用 **clamp / cap**，limit 偏「禁止超過」；提出「也許不必」的質疑，母語者愛用 **Do we even need …?** 或 **doesn't need … at all**，語氣比 maybe there is no need 自然。

entries.o: what is 單一共用 Tooltip、hover 時換內容
nat: **What does** a single **shared** Tooltip that **swaps** its content on hover **mean**?
**What do you mean by** a single **shared** Tooltip that **swaps** its content on hover?
**Can you explain** the "one **shared** Tooltip" idea?
entries.k: 追問對方某個說法的意思用 **What do you mean by …?**，比 what is X 更像在要解釋而非要定義；「共用」= **shared**（a shared tooltip / a shared helper，同文法結構 share module → shared 系列）；「hover 時換內容」= **swaps / updates its content on hover**；要對方展開說明也可直接說 **Can you explain …?**。

entries.o: what is 全文會被兩端對齊、字距不均
nat: **What does** "the text is justified with **uneven word spacing**" **mean**?
**What do you mean by** "justified with **uneven word spacing**"?
entries.k: **與第 40 條同一錯誤**（同一天再犯）——問一段話的意思用 **What does X mean?** 或 **What do you mean by X?**，what is X 是在問定義；順帶記術語：兩端對齊 = **justified text / `text-align: justify`**，字距不均 = **uneven word spacing**。

entries.o: I don't see 兩端對齊、字距不均
nat: **The justified text** / uneven spacing **isn't showing up**.
**I'm not seeing the justified text** / uneven spacing.
I can't see any uneven spacing **on my end**.
entries.k: 回報「預期的效果沒出現」用進行式 **I'm not seeing X**——隱含「我看了、也在找，但它沒出現」，I don't see 偏平鋪直敘的「我沒看到」；加 **on my end** 表示「在我這邊的環境」，是對方說有、你說沒有時最常用的收尾；要對方確認可接 **Are you sure that's happening? / Can you point me to where it shows up?**

entries.o: reorder foo
nat: **Move** the `foo` helper up **next to the other helpers**.
**Move** `foo` **up**.
entries.k: **reorder 是重排「一組」東西的順序**（reorder the columns / the test cases），只搬一個宣告的位置用 **move X up / down / next to Y**；講清楚搬到哪裡——**next to the other helpers**，對方不用回去翻 review 找你指的是哪一條建議。

entries.o: fix mock 多於所需
nat: **Trim** the **unused mocks**.
**Remove the mocks** we don't actually need.
entries.k: **fix** 的受詞要是「東西」，不是 review 條目的標題——「mock 多於所需」是對問題的描述，母語者會直接講動作＋對象：**trim / remove the unused mocks**（trim 帶「修掉多餘的、留必要的」語氣，正合這個情境）；指 review 某條時可說 **the "unused mocks" point**，但指令本身還是要用動詞開頭（與第 132 條 reorder → move 同型：挑對動詞比翻譯中文更重要）。

entries.o: 超過就拒絕整次選取、保留原值而不是截
nat: If it goes **over the limit**, **reject the whole selection** and **keep the previous value** **instead of truncating**.
**Over the limit**, **drop the change entirely** **rather than trimming** it to 100.
entries.k: 「超過」要講超過什麼——**over the limit / past the cap**；「拒絕整次選取」= **reject the whole selection / drop the change entirely**；「保留原值」= **keep the previous value**；「而不是截」= **instead of truncating / rather than trimming**（instead 系列）；兩個做法對比用 **A rather than B** 最順。

entries.o: foo 超過上限若沒截斷會無限增加，但設定後 foo 更新還是會觸發 API
nat: Without truncation, `foo` **keeps growing** past the limit, and updating it still **triggers** the API call **afterwards**.
**Two problems**: the model **grows unbounded** if we don't trim it, and re-syncing it still fires the API.
entries.k: 回報兩個 bug 時先點出數量 **Two problems:**，讀者好對照；「無限增加」= **grows unbounded / keeps growing**；「觸發 API」= **triggers / fires the API call**（call 補上更精準，API 本身是介面不是動作）；「設定後」= **afterwards / after the assignment**，放句尾。

entries.o: why not just remove foo, bar and inline it
nat: **Why not just** inline both of **them** into `baz` and **drop the helpers**?
Why not inline `foo` and `bar` instead of keeping **them** as separate methods?
entries.k: 受詞是兩個函式，代名詞要用 **them** 不是 it（同 mention it／extract this 的受詞系列）；並列兩項要有 **and**——A, B and C 只在三項以上才用逗號；**remove ... and inline it** 邏輯反了（移除後就沒東西可 inline），母語者會說 **inline them into X**（把邏輯搬進去）或 **drop the helpers**；質疑設計的 **Why not just ...?** 用法本身正確，語氣輕鬆自然。

entries.o: fix the FOO loop
nat: **Switch it to a** `FOO` loop.
Go ahead with the `FOO` loop **fix**.
entries.k: **fix 用在「修好已存在的東西」**——那個 loop 還不存在（是我提議要改成的寫法），所以 fix the FOO loop 聽起來像「那個迴圈壞了去修它」；要對方採用某個提案說 **switch it to X / go with X / apply the X fix**；若是指「修掉我剛才列的那一項」也可以講 **Fix that one.**（用 that one 指剛才的建議，不要重述成一個新名詞）。

entries.o: add tests for the lost
nat: Add tests for **the gaps** **listed**.
Add tests for **the gaps** **you listed**.
**Cover** those two missing cases with tests.
entries.k: the **lost** 是「失去的人／物（尤指走失、罹難）」，指「漏掉、還沒覆蓋的部分」要用 **the gaps / the missing cases / what's not covered**；指涉對方剛列的清單補一句 **you listed / you mentioned**，範圍才明確；測試情境的動詞常用 **cover**——cover those cases with tests 比 add tests for… 更像工程師的講法。

entries.o: fix the let foo to const
nat: **Change** `let foo` **to** `const`.
**Switch** that `let` to `const`.
entries.k: **fix 沒有 fix A to B 這個句型**（fix 只接要修的東西），「把 A 改成 B」是 **change A to B** 或 **switch A to B**（同第 90 條 fix 用法，第二次出現）；`let foo` 是一段程式碼，講的時候不用冠詞 the；只改宣告關鍵字時說 **switch that `let` to `const`** 最短。

entries.o: foo and bar are the same, to determine by op.children
nat: `foo` and `bar` are **identical** — **could** **the child key be picked from** `BAZ[op].children` instead?
`foo` and `bar` are **identical** — **could we** **pick the child key from** `BAZ[op].children` instead?
They're the same function; **let's** **drive the child key off** `op.children`.
entries.k: **to V 開頭的片語不能單獨當句子**——提議要成句：**could we …? / let's …**（to determine by 讀起來像上一句的目的，語意接不上）；「一模一樣」用 **identical** 比 the same 更果斷；兩個完整想法用破折號或分號分開（comma splice，同第 4、50、37、39 條）；「由某個設定決定」母語者說 **drive X off / pick X from** Y，比 determine by 自然。

entries.o: if foo equal to BAR, dsl add must terms baz_key
nat: **If** `foo` **is SIEM**, add a must `terms` clause on `baz_key` **to the DSL**.
**When the type is** SIEM, the generated DSL should also **filter on** `baz_key` with **a must clause**.
entries.k: **equal to 少了 be 動詞**，口語直接 **if X is Y**（同第 64 條，**第二次出現**）；「幫 DSL 加東西」主詞是人或程式，結構是 **add A to the DSL**，dsl add 是把受詞放到主詞位置；「針對某欄位的條件」用 **a clause on `baz_key`**；一串名詞 must terms baz_key 要用介係詞串起來——**a must `terms` clause on `baz_key`**。

entries.o: replace it with FOO_*
nat: Replace **these string literals** with **the** `FOO_*` **constants**.
Use **the** `FOO_*` **constants** instead of the hard-coded `'terms'`.
entries.k: 文法正確，差在指涉——**it** 只靠游標選取對方才知道指哪個，句子裡講出來 **these string literals / the hard-coded `'terms'`** 才完整；一組常數要說 **the … constants**，光寫 `*` 通配對方要自己補名詞；「寫死的字串」叫 **a string literal / a hard-coded string**。

entries.o: 請求帶 page=0, 但底下的分頁元件仍亮在原頁
nat: The request **does** carry `page=0`, **but** **the pager** at the bottom still **highlights the old page**.
The request **goes out with** `page=0`, **yet** **the pagination control** still **shows the old page as active**.
entries.k: 「請求帶某參數」= **the request carries / includes X**，或 **goes out with X**；要強調「確實有帶」用助動詞 **does** 加強；「分頁元件」口語叫 **the pager / the pagination control**；「亮在某頁」= **highlights the old page / shows the old page as active**（active 是 UI 上「被選中」的慣用字）；轉折用 **but / yet** 接第二句。（中文句）

entries.o: accept the delay for foo and add a comment describing 接受此延遲並在規格註記
nat: Accept the `foo` **delay**, add a code comment explaining it, and **note it in the spec**.
**I'm fine with the** `foo` **lag** — leave a comment about it and **note it in the spec**.
entries.k: 三個動作用 **A, B, and C** 並列，最後一個前加 and；「接受某個缺點」口語 **I'm fine with X / I can live with X**（同慣用說法「I'll live with it」）；「在規格註記」= **note it in the spec / add a note to the spec**；「延遲」講 UI 反應慢用 **lag / delay** 都可；中英夾雜的後半句直接換成英文動詞片語即可，不用先翻成名詞。

entries.o: 改了條件但關閉不查詢 使用者 will not 誤以為列表已是重置後的結果。ignore this
nat: **Changing** the filters **and closing** the drawer without querying **won't make users think** **the list already reflects the reset**. **Ignore** this one.
**Users won't assume the list is already** reset just because they changed the filters and closed the drawer — **drop this one**.
entries.k: 「A 不會讓使用者誤以為 B」= **A won't make users think B** 或 **users won't assume B**（誤以為 = mistakenly think / assume，口語 assume 就夠）；「列表已是重置後的結果」= **the list already reflects the reset**；打回 review 的某一條用 **ignore / drop this one**（one 指那一條，比 this 完整）；動作當主詞用動名詞 **Changing … and closing …**（同第 51、54、136 條）。

entries.o: 「匯出」在左、「查詢」在最右 is what I want
nat: Export **on the left** and Query on the **far** right is **the intended layout**.
Export **on the left** and Query on the **far** right is what I **want**.
**That's the order I want**: Export **on the left**, Query at the **far** right.
entries.k: 位置說法 **on the left / on (at) the far right**（最右邊要加 **far**，right 單獨只是「右側」）；「這就是我要的」= **that's what I want**，或更明確 **that's the order I want**；按鈕名稱當專有名詞首字大寫不加引號即可（Export、Query）；中英夾雜的前半句直接改成英文名詞片語當主詞。（中文句）

entries.o: { result: {} } show blank row, do not ignore it
nat: `{ result: {} }` **should render as a blank row**, **not be skipped**.
Don't **skip** `{ result: {} }` rows; show them **as blank rows**.
entries.k: **講規格要有 should**——show blank row 像在描述現況，**should render as a blank row** 才是「我要它這樣」；**a blank row** 可數名詞要冠詞（同介係詞與冠詞第 45-49 條）；「不要略過」用 **skip**，ignore 是「看到但不理」，程式把列丟掉是 skip / drop；兩個要求用 **not be skipped** 或分號接，逗號直接黏是 comma splice（同第 4、50 條）。

entries.o: if names.length larger than max, do not call api
nat: If `names.length` **exceeds** the max, **don't** call **the API**.
**Don't** hit **the API** when there are more than 100 field names.
entries.k: **if** 子句缺 be 動詞——if X **is** larger than（同第 84、109 條 if 子句缺動詞型）；數量超過用 **exceeds / is over / is greater than**，larger 多半講尺寸大小；**the API** 冠詞（同第 114 條）；口語否定指令 **don't** 比 do not 自然。

entries.o: go ahead with minWidth 50
nat: Go ahead with **a** `minWidth` **of** 50.
entries.k: 數值屬性完整說法是 **a ... of**——a minWidth **of** 50（工程聊天縮寫可通，正式說法補 a/of）；go ahead with 用得很道地。

entries.o: index could be the string or the array
nat: `index` could be **a** string or **an** array.
`index` can be **either a string or an array**.
entries.k: 泛指「某一種型別／類別」用 **a/an**——**a** string、**an** array（**the** 是指前文特定那一個）；「兩者其一」句型 **either A or B**。

entries.o: also fix line 120 with this.$t, and put it to errmsg_* entries
nat: Also fix line 120 with `this.$t`, and **move** **the key** **into** the `errmsg_*` group. / ...and **put it with** the other `errmsg_*` entries.
entries.k: **put X to** 不成立——放進某處用 **put X in / into**，放在同類旁邊用 **put X with**（the other entries）；「搬到某群組」更常說 **move X into the group**；it 指的是 key，寫出 **the key** 更明確。

entries.o: json add @timestamp, like
nat: Add an `@timestamp` range to the JSON, **like this**:
Could you add an `@timestamp` range to the JSON, **like this**:
Add an `@timestamp` range **clause** to the generated query, **like the one below**:
entries.k: **「在 X 加 Y」是 add Y to X**——動詞在前、目的地接介係詞 to（json add X 是中文主題先行的語序）；加的是一段條件，名詞講完整 **an @timestamp range (clause)**，並補冠詞 an；句尾要接範例用 **like this:** 或 **like the one below:**，單獨一個 like 會懸空。

entries.o: put this 效能 issue in the code comment
nat: Add **a code comment** about this performance issue.
**Note** this **performance concern** in **a code comment**.
entries.k: 還不存在的註解要用 a **code comment**——the 會讓對方去找「哪一條既有註解」（冠詞定／不定指的差別，與第 45-49 條漏冠詞是同一組問題的另一面）；「寫進註解」動詞用 **note / document X in a comment**，put X in 偏「塞進去」；效能議題口語 **performance concern**（issue 也可，concern 帶「值得留意但未必要立刻修」的語氣，正符合這條建議級的性質）。

entries.o: update code comment
nat: Update **the** code comment.
Update **the** spec's header comment.
entries.k: **已經存在、雙方都知道是哪一條的註解要用 the**（與第 43 條 a code comment 正好是一對：新增用 a、指既有用 the）；指明位置更省事——**the header comment in the spec**，對方不用猜是哪個檔案的哪條。

entries.o: 後端通常 500 回 Internal Server Error，以這種情境下要顯示「系統忙碌中」，還是要改成 'foo_key' + 預設訊息嗎
nat: The backend usually **returns** "Internal Server Error" on a 500, so **in that case** "System is busy" should be shown — **or should it be** `foo_key` **plus the page's default message**?
The backend usually **returns** "Internal Server Error" on a 500, so **in that case** we'd want to show "System is busy" — **or should it be** `foo_key` **plus the page's default message**?
entries.k: 「以這種情境下」中文本身冗贅，英文一個詞就夠——**in that case / when that happens**；「還是要改成 A＋B 嗎」= **or should it be A plus B?**（二選一接在前句後面用 — or ...，不另起 Do you want）；「後端回傳」= the backend **returns**（不用 answers/responds with 也可，但 returns 最貼近 API 語境）。

entries.o: add a url link to backstage/roleMngt
nat: Add **a link to the** `backstage/roleMngt` **page**.
**Link it to** `backstage/roleMngt`.
entries.k: **url link 是重複**——link 本身就是連結，說 **a link to X** 就夠（要強調是網址才說 a URL）；路徑當受詞習慣補 **the ... page**；動詞版更簡潔：**link it to X**。

entries.o: remove the redundant new lines
nat: Remove the **extra** **blank lines**.
Drop the **redundant** **blank lines** flagged by ESLint.
entries.k: 空白行是 **blank line**，不是 **new line**——new line（或 newline）指的是換行字元 `\n` 本身；**redundant 偏「多此一舉、重複」**，講多出來的空行用 **extra** 更自然（redundant 也通，但多用在重複的程式碼／欄位）；要更精準可指明來源 **the ones ESLint flagged**，對方就知道範圍是哪幾行。

entries.o: remove Foo
nat: **Get rid of** `Foo`.
Let's **get rid of** `Foo`.
Remove the `Foo` wrapper and **inline it**.
entries.k: remove 這樣用沒問題；口語常說 **get rid of**；「拆掉包裝、直接展開」= **inline it**。

entries.o: let's get rid of Foo version
nat: Get rid of **the** `Foo` version.
Let's get rid of **the** `Foo` version.
entries.k: 幾乎全對——指「那一版」要加冠詞 **the** ... version；get rid of 用得很道地。

entries.o: let's get rid of Foo wrapper and inline it
nat: Get rid of **the** `Foo` wrapper and inline it.
Let's get rid of **the** `Foo` wrapper and inline it.
entries.k: 句子全對（活用了第 4 條學到的說法）；僅差冠詞 **the** wrapper 更完整。

entries.o: also add the before phrasing to the notes
nat: Also add the **earlier** phrasings **to** the notes.
Could you also add the **earlier** phrasings **to** the notes?
entries.k: 「之前的」當形容詞用 **earlier / previous**（before 是介係詞／副詞，不能直接修飾名詞）；多句要用複數 phrasing**s**；add ... **to** the notes 用對了。

entries.o: keep editable/readonly, for pass-through 補齊
nat: Keep `editable`/`readonly` — they **round out** the pass-through props.
Let's keep `editable`/`readonly` — they **round out** the pass-through props.
entries.k: 「補齊（一組東西）」= **round out / complete the set**；說明保留理由用破折號或 since 帶出，不用孤立的 for。

entries.o: a summary of branch enhance-auto-report from last Friday through today
nat: a summary of **the** `enhance-auto-report` **branch** from last Friday through today
entries.k: 分支名當修飾語放 branch **前面**——**the** `enhance-auto-report` **branch**（同 Could you・group 系列第 2 條「引用片語放名詞前」的規則）；from ... through today 用得很道地。

entries.o: 切語系時本來就會重載頁面
nat: **Switching the locale** **already** **triggers a full** **page** **reload**.
The **page** **reloads** **anyway** when you **switch languages**.
entries.k: 「本來就會」= **already / anyway**（放句尾的 anyway 最口語）；「重載頁面」= **reload the page / trigger a full (page) reload**；「切語系」= **switch the locale / switch languages**。

entries.o: logging-tracing is just for backend, not for this frontend project
nat: The logging-tracing guideline **only applies to** **the** backend, not to this frontend project.
entries.k: 「只適用於」慣用 **only applies to**（is just for 口語可通但較弱）；**the** backend 要冠詞；not to this frontend project 的 to 對齊前面的 applies to。

entries.o: fix 命名與慣例 — file-a.js:21-22
nat: Fix **the** naming-and-convention issue **at** `file-a.js:21-22`.
entries.k: 指審查回報的特定項目要冠詞 **the** ... issue／finding；「檔案第幾行」用 **at** file:line；複合形容詞用連字號 naming-and-convention。

entries.o: it's difficult to understand, you can use English to describe
nat: It's hard to understand — **feel free to** describe it **in English**.
entries.k: describe 及物要受詞——describe **it**；「用英文」= **in English**（use English to describe 是中式直譯）；「你可以～」表允許用 **feel free to / you're welcome to**；兩個完整子句不能只用逗號連（comma splice 同 Git 系列第 8、20、22 條）。

entries.o: I want to add more detail for format .SSSSSS, what else do I need to modify to fit this need
nat: The time format needs more **precision** (`.SSSSSS`) — what else needs to change **to support that**?
I want more **precision** in the time format (`.SSSSSS`) — what else do I need to change **to support that**?
entries.k: 時間精度用 **precision**（detail 是「細節內容」）；「配合這需求」= **to support that / to make that work**；兩句用破折號串（comma splice 同第 57 條）；what else do I need to ... 這半句全對。

entries.o: 在送出點把字串補成六位（only if=.999 結束補 999）
nat: Pad the string **to** six digits **at the submit points** — append `999` **only when** the milliseconds are `.999`, otherwise **zero-pad**.
entries.k: 「補位／補零」= **pad / zero-pad**（pad ... **to** six digits）；「只有～才」= **only when/if ...**；「送出點」= **at the submit points**。

entries.o: deprecate it
nat: **Drop** it.
**Scrap** that.
Let's **skip** that change.
**Deprecate** the `foo` export.
entries.k: 前三句＝放棄提案；最後一句＝真的要標記棄用。**deprecate** 專指「標記為過時、預告未來移除」的 API/功能生命週期術語，不是「放棄／不做」；「這項不做了」說 **drop / scrap / skip**（同 Git 系列 keep ... as is 的口語風格）。

entries.o: do not 擅自 remove the part that I did't meantion
nat: Don't remove anything that **wasn't** **mentioned** — ask first.
Don't remove things I **didn't** **mention** — ask first.
Don't touch anything I **didn't** ask you to change.
entries.k: 「擅自」= **without asking / on your own**（Don't ... without asking）；拼字 **didn't**（did't 漏 n）、**mention**（meantion 多 a）；「沒提到的部分」說 things/parts I didn't mention 或 anything I didn't ask you to change。

entries.o: don't touch title like ## YouTrack 工單系列
nat: Don't touch **the** section **headings**, **like** "## YouTrack Ticket Series".
entries.k: Markdown 的 `##` 叫 **heading**（title 是整份文件／頁面的標題）；泛指要複數 **headings** 並加 **the**；舉例用 **like** 或 **such as** 都可。

entries.o: 你之前已犯過，擅自移除我 Git section heading，導致我找不到，後來才發現
nat: This has happened before — the Git section heading was removed **without asking**, and it went unnoticed until much later.
You've done this before — you removed my Git section heading **without asking**, and I didn't notice until much later.
entries.k: 「之前已犯過」用**現在完成式** You've done this before；「擅自」= **without asking**（同第 62 條）；「後來才發現」= **didn't notice until later** / **only found out later**；「導致我找不到」口語可省，改成 I couldn't find it 亦可。

entries.o: 零散文字 is 重點整理
nat: Those aren't **stray lines** — that's a personal summary of the key points.
Those aren't **stray lines** — that's my own summary of the key points.
That's my **recap**, not **leftover text**.
entries.k: 「重點整理」= **a summary of the key points** / **key-point summary** / **recap**；「零散文字」= **stray lines** / **leftover text**；更正對方誤解的句型 **not X — Y**（或 **Y, not X**）。

entries.o: if the text is blank then return error
nat: If the text is blank, return **an** error.
**Bail out** early if the text is blank.
entries.k: error 可數要冠詞——return **an** error（程式情境更常直接說 return **false** / **bail out**）；if ... then 的 then 冗贅（同第 29 條，第二次出現）。

entries.o: 5 等遇到再說，暫不開單
nat: **Hold off on** #5 — no ticket **for now**; it'll be **dealt with if** it comes up.
Let's **hold off on** #5 — no ticket **for now**; we'll **deal with it if** it comes up.
**Park** #5 **for now** and revisit it when it actually happens.
entries.k: 「暫不處理」= **hold off on X** / **park X for now**；「遇到再說」= **deal with it if/when it comes up**；編號寫 **#5 / item 5**。

entries.o: 目前資料來源選 FOO 一定會出現 Bar，不會殘留baz，待後續有需要再開單
nat: Right now, picking FOO as the data source **always shows** the Bar, **so** `baz` **can't** **linger** unseen — a ticket can be opened later if it ever comes up.
Right now, picking FOO as the data source **always shows** the Bar, **so** `baz` **can't** **linger** unseen — we'll open a ticket later if it ever comes up.
entries.k: 「殘留」= **linger / be left over**（leftover 為名詞）；「一定會出現」= **always shows / always renders**；「有需要再開單」= **open a ticket later if it comes up**（同第 67 條）；反駁審查時用 **so ... can't ...** 把前提與結論串起來。

entries.o: fix the situation about foo prevent multiple
nat: Guard `foo` against the `multiple` **case**.
**Handle** the `multiple` **case** in `foo`.
entries.k: 「處理某個情境」直接說 **handle / guard against the X case**，不用 fix the situation about（situation about 是中式搭配）；「防止」在這裡是「防呆」，用 **guard against** 比 prevent 精確；兩個動詞不能直接相連（fix ... prevent），要有連接詞或改名詞子句。

entries.o: split pr 511 and pr 547
nat: Split **that line** into PR 511 and PR 547.
**List PR 511 and PR 547 separately**.
entries.k: split 要說清楚**拆什麼**——split **that line / the entry** into A and B（split A and B 讀起來像「把 A 和 B 各自拆開」）；「分開列」也可直接說 **list A and B separately**；PR 縮寫大寫。

entries.o: pr 545 修飾成要貼上部門工作摘要的文字
nat: **Polish** the PR 545 entry **into something ready to paste into** **the department work summary**.
**Polish** the PR 545 entry **into something I can paste into** **the department work summary**.
**Rewrite** the PR 545 line for the department **report**.
entries.k: 「修飾文字」= **polish / rewrite**（decorate 是裝飾外觀）；「改成可貼上的文字」= **into something I can paste into ...**；「部門工作摘要」= **the department work summary / report**。

entries.o: also others
nat: **Same for the others**.
**Do the same for** the other entries, please.
entries.k: 「其他的也照做」慣用 **Same for the others** / **Do the same for ...**；also others 少了動詞與指涉，對方得猜「也怎樣」；others 前若指特定那批要加 **the**。

entries.o: only set drag in icon
nat: **Make only the icon draggable**.
**Restrict dragging to the drag handle icon**.
entries.k: 「只讓～可拖曳」= **make only X draggable** / **restrict dragging to X**；拖曳把手慣用 **drag handle**；set drag in 是中式搭配——drag 當名詞要有動詞支撐（**enable/allow dragging from ...**）。

entries.o: width: 140 目視確認OK
nat: `width: 140` **looks good** — verified visually.
`width: 140` **looks good** — I've verified it visually.
**Visually confirmed** the 140px width **is fine**.
entries.k: 「目視確認」= **verify visually**，口語 **eyeball it**（I eyeballed it and it's fine）；回報檢查通過慣用 **looks good / checks out**。

entries.o: does the newest view-ui-plus fix this bug?
nat: Is this bug fixed in the **latest** view-ui-plus?
Does the **latest** view-ui-plus fix this?
entries.k: 軟體版本的「最新版」慣用 **latest**（newest 可通但非慣用語）；問修復狀態更常用被動 **Is it fixed in ...**；句子文法本身沒錯。

entries.o: if type=SIEM, get index option list from foo else use BAR
nat: **If the type is SIEM**, build **the index suggestions** **from the** `foo` **keys**; **otherwise** use `BAR`.
entries.k: 口語的「否則」用 **otherwise**（else 掛句尾是程式語法感）；type=SIEM 寫全 **if the type is SIEM**（同 YouTrack 系列第 13 條、fall back to 系列第 49 條）；「選項／建議清單」= **the index suggestions / suggestion list**，來源用 **from the ... keys**。

entries.o: fix the fixed column issue ／ 跨列選字 some rows 失效
nat: Fix the **fixed-column issue**. Selecting across rows **still** fails on some rows.
entries.k: 前句幾乎正確，只差**複合修飾語要連字號**——名詞前兩個字合起來修飾時寫 **fixed-column issue**（同理 drag-over class、cross-customer permission，本檔已多次出現）；後句「某些情況才失效」的慣用說法是 **it fails on some rows** / **only some rows are affected**，先講現象再限定範圍，比把範圍夾在中間清楚；「還是」用 **still** 放在主詞後動詞前。

entries.o: 編輯完一定會動滑鼠才能選字，無此議題
nat: The mouse **has to** move to select text after editing **anyway**, so **this isn't an issue**.
**You'd have to** move the mouse to select text after editing **anyway**, so **this isn't an issue**.
entries.k: 「本來就會／反正都要」句尾用 **anyway**，一個字就交代了「這個前提本來就成立」；「一定會」用 **you'd have to ...**（假設語氣的必然）比 must 自然，must 偏「規定」；駁回一項疑慮最省力的說法是 **this isn't an issue / that's not a concern here / it can't happen in practice**，比直譯的 there is no such issue 道地。

entries.o: ban 從 outer 拖一個檔案進表格
nat: **Block** **file drops** **from outside** the table.
**Ignore** **drags that didn't start in the table**.
entries.k: **ban 用於對人或行為的禁令**（ban a user, ban smoking），程式要擋掉某種輸入用 **block / reject / ignore**；**outer 是形容詞「外層的」**（outer wrapper），「從外面」要用 **from outside**（介係詞）；「拖檔案進來」名詞化為 **file drops**，動詞則是 **drag files into X**；描述來源更精準的講法是 **drags that didn't start in the table**。

entries.o: remove initial foo
nat: Remove **the** initial `foo()` **call**.
**Drop** **that** first `foo()` **call**.
entries.k: **函式名不能單獨當受詞**——要刪的是「那一次呼叫」，補上名詞 **call**（remove the ... **call**），否則聽起來像要把整個函式刪掉；序數形容詞前要冠詞 **the** initial / **that** first（同介係詞與冠詞第 17、20、25 條的漏冠詞）；口語常用 **drop** 代替 remove，語氣更輕。

entries.o: add the full test
nat: Run **the full test suite**.
**Add tests for the new drag behavior**.
entries.k: 第一句＝要我執行；第二句＝要我新增。**add ≠ run**——「跑測試」是 **run the tests / run the full suite**，add 是「新增測試檔案或案例」，這兩個意思差很多，對方只能猜；「整套測試」慣用 **the full test suite**（test 單獨用是單一測試，測試集合要說 suite 或複數 tests）；要新增時把對象講清楚 **add tests for X**，對方才知道要覆蓋什麼。

entries.o: in real test drag only on icon, not the whole cell 整個儲存格, add a description in both code comment and pr
nat: **In browser testing**, **dragging only works on the icon** itself, not the whole cell. Document that in a code comment and in **the PR description**.
**When I tested it in the browser**, **dragging only works on the icon** itself, not the whole cell. Please document that in a code comment and in **the PR description**.
entries.k: 「實測」講 **when I tested it in the browser** 或 **in real-world testing**（in real test 少了冠詞也不是慣用語）；**drag only on icon → dragging only works on the icon**（動名詞當主詞、補動詞 works、補冠詞 the）；「補個說明」用 **document it** 或 **add a note**，**add a description** 會被讀成要新增某個欄位的描述文字；「PR 上」講完整的 **the PR description**（pr 單獨用指整個 PR，不是它的描述欄位）。

entries.o: remove all the description like 千列約 0.5 秒
nat: Remove **all** **descriptions** **like** "about 0.5s for 1,000 rows".
Drop **the performance numbers** from **the** comments.
entries.k: **all 後面接複數**——all **descriptions**（all the description 文法不成立）；**all 與 the 通常不並用**，指全部同類事物時直接 all + 複數；舉例用 **like** 可以，較正式的寫法是 **such as**；若能點出「是哪一類內容」對方更好判斷範圍——**the performance numbers**（效能數字）比 descriptions 精準。

entries.o: 在 response.data 判斷之後加一個 else if (status >= 500) 回 foo_key
nat: **After the** `response.data` **check**, add an `else if (status >= 500)` branch **that returns** `foo_key`.
entries.k: 「某個判斷」= **the ... check**；「加一個 else if」要補名詞 **an else-if branch**（else if 本身不是名詞）；「回～」= **that returns ...**（關係子句接在 branch 後）；「在～之後」放句首 **After the X check,** 再接指令，語序最自然。

entries.o: 改成可選擇回傳 foo.response.data 或固定訊息?
nat: **What if** `bar` **took** an option to **choose between the backend message and the fixed one**?
Could we **make it configurable** — return `foo.response.data` or the fixed message?
entries.k: 「改成可選擇」= **make it configurable** 或 **take an option**（函式「接受一個選項」用 take）；提案式問句用 **What if ... took ...?**（假設語氣過去式）；「A 或 B 二選一」= **choose between A and B**（between 搭 and 不是 or）。

entries.o: if (foo.request) then ...
nat: **What if** it **just checked** `if (foo.request)`?
**What if we just checked** `if (foo.request)`?
**What happens when** `foo.request` exists but the status isn't 0?
entries.k: 用程式片段當問句時要**把問題問出來**——是想「改成這樣判斷」（What if we just checked ...?）還是想知道「這種情況會怎樣」（What happens when ...?），對方才知道要回什麼；英文條件句不加 then（同 instead 系列第 29 條 if-then 是程式語法感）。

series.title: generic / general
series.desc: same confusable pair, collected together; generic = "general-purpose, not tied to a specific context", general = "roughly, overall"

entries.o: 這裡不能就靜默略過嗎? error 不要寫指名 Foo bar, 若真要寫 error 須給一個通用說明
nat: **Can't it just** **fail silently** here? Don't **name** `Foo` or `bar` in the error — if one is really needed, give it **a generic message**.
**Can't we just** **fail silently** here? Don't **name** `Foo` or `bar` in the error — if we really need one, give it **a generic message**.
entries.k: 「靜默略過／不報錯」= **fail silently / skip silently**；「指名」= **name / reference**；「通用說明」= **a generic message**；「不能就～嗎」的反問 = **Can't we just ...?**。

entries.o: replace it with a general name
nat: **Give it a** **more generic** **name**.
**Rename it to** something **more generic** — it's not login-specific.
entries.k: 「不綁特定情境的、通用的」命名用 **generic**（general 偏「大致、整體上」的意思）；改名慣用 **rename it to / give it a ... name**，replace 是「換掉整個東西」；比較級 **more generic** 帶出「比現在更通用」。

entries.o: there is no need to use i18n in here, so use more general log like 'Response is not an object', or just remove error log
nat: There's no need **for** i18n **here**, so use **a** more general log message like 'Response is not an object' — or just drop **the** error log.
entries.k: **here** 前不加 in（in here 是「在這裡面」的口語強調）；可數名詞補冠詞——**a** more general log message、**the** error log；There's no need **for** ＋名詞（to ＋動詞也對）。（原分類：介係詞與冠詞 第 5 條）

series.title: fall back to
series.desc: same phrase, collected together; "use B when there is no A"; also used in instead Series #29
notes: "Should the t('key') fallback live inside bar?"（點出你搬的其實是「fallback」而不只是那個呼叫）

entries.o: if there is no nested history, Foo 退回本體
nat: If there's no nested history, the audit info **falls back to** **the outer object**.
entries.k: 「退回／回退到～」= **fall back to**（動詞兩個字；名詞 fallback 一個字）；「本體／外層」= **the outer object / the top-level data**；if there is no nested history 全對（nested 用對了，同文法結構第 11 條的修正活用）。

entries.o: if key=xxx, set label to foo_key's label eg. key=bar_key, set label to baz_key's label
nat: If a key has no label of its own, **fall back to** the `foo_key` label — **e.g.** for `bar_key`, use the label of `baz_key`.
entries.k: 縮寫 **e.g.** 要兩個點（eg. 是常見手滑），前面用破折號或括號帶出例子；「退而改用～」= **fall back to**（同本系列第 11 條、instead 系列第 29 條）；key=xxx 是程式寫法，口說寫全 **if the key is xxx**。（原分類：拼字與易混字 第 22 條）

entries.o: if content is null then copy foo
nat: If `content` is null, **fall back to copying** `foo`.
Copy `foo` **instead** when `content` is null.
entries.k: 「沒有 A 就改用 B」慣用 **fall back to B**（名詞形 fallback）或句尾 **instead**；英文條件句不需要 then（if ..., ... 逗號即可，if-then 是程式語法感）。

series.title: instead
series.desc: same phrase, collected together; for **rather than** see #88; also used in fall back to Series #29 and "Could you" · replace Series #28

entries.o: it is the button instead of the drawer
nat: It's the button, **not the drawer**.
That button **isn't in a drawer** — **it's in** the edit card.
entries.k: **糾正對方的描述用 not X**——It's A, **not** B（同第 27 條 not X — Y 的句型）；**instead of** 是「以 A 取代 B 的選擇／動作」（use A instead of B），不用於指正錯誤描述。

entries.o: could you change to 回覆的開頭
nat: Put that at the beginning of the replies **instead**.
Could you put that at the beginning of your replies **instead**?
entries.k: 「改成～」用 **instead** 表達取代原做法；at the beginning of。（原分類：Could you 請求句・其他請求句 第 5 條）

entries.o: could you list the sentence, not in table?
nat: List them as sentences **instead of a table**.
Could you list them as sentences **instead of a table**?
entries.k: 「不要用表格」= **instead of a table**；複數 sentences。（原分類：Could you 請求句・其他請求句 第 7 條）

entries.o: could you leave the cell blank, and do not insert "null" word
nat: **Leave the cell blank** **instead of** inserting **the word "null**".
Could you **leave the cell blank** **instead of** inserting **the word "null**"?
entries.k: **leave the cell blank** 用得對（leave 系列修正內化）；請求句後接「而不要～」用 **instead of + V-ing**（could you ... and do not ... 是問句混祈使句）；「"null" 這個字」語序為 **the word "null"**。（原分類：拼字與易混字・leave 系列 第 20 條）

entries.o: change label to i18n keys
nat: Change **the labels** to i18n keys.
Make **the labels** use i18n keys instead of **hard-coded** strings.
entries.k: 指「那些」label 要冠詞且**單複數對齊**——**the labels** ↔ keys（同介係詞與冠詞第 7 條 the description）；「硬編碼」= **hard-coded**。（原分類：介係詞與冠詞 第 9 條）

entries.o: could you update the last comment instead of adding a new reply?
nat: **Update** the last comment instead of adding a new reply.
Could you **update** the last comment instead of adding a new reply?
Could you **edit** your **previous comment** instead of **posting another one**?
entries.k: 原句正確。**文法完全正確**——instead of + V-ing（adding）用對了，這是本系列第 47、46 條反覆修正過的句型，已內化；想更明確指是「你貼的那則」可說 **your last / previous comment**（the last comment 在多人串裡可能指任何人的最後一則）；「再貼一則」= **post another one**，編輯既有留言用 **edit / update**。（原分類：Could you 請求句）

entries.o: FOO改為引用單一來源
nat: **Have** `FOO` **reference** the **single source of truth**.
Let's **have** `FOO` **reference** the **single source of truth**.
**Change** `FOO` to pull the tag from `BAR` **instead of hardcoding it**.
entries.k: 「單一來源」的業界慣用語是 **single source of truth**（縮寫 SSOT），只說 single source 母語者會覺得少一半；「改為引用」= **change X to reference ...**，更自然的說法是 **have X reference ...**；口語也常說 **pull it from / derive it from**；補上對比 **instead of hardcoding it** 會讓意圖更清楚。

entries.o: when insert a markdown, table title would be insert to the beginning of the paragraph, not right on the table
nat: **When** **markdown is pasted**, the table heading **gets inserted** at the start of the paragraph **instead of** right **above the table**.
**When I paste** **markdown**, the table heading **gets inserted** at the start of the paragraph **instead of** right **above the table**.
The table heading **ends up** at the top of the **pasted** block **rather than** directly **above the table**.
entries.k: 時間子句要有主詞——**when I paste ...**（同文法結構第 1 條 if **we** split 的缺主詞問題）；**markdown 不可數**，不加 a（要指某份文件才說 a markdown file）；被動語態動詞要用過去分詞——**gets inserted / is inserted**，would be **insert** 是錯形；描述結果位置母語者慣用 **ends up ...**；「而不是」用 **instead of / rather than**，位置介係詞是 **above the table**（right on the table 會變成「壓在表格上面」）。（原分類：文法結構 第 74 條）

entries.o: could you set the status range?
nat: Make this check **cover** the whole 5xx range.
Could you make this check **cover** the whole 5xx range?
Could you change this to **match any 5xx status** **instead of** just 500?
entries.k: **動詞選擇**——「把判斷改成範圍」不是 set a range，而是 **cover / match a range**（set 會讓人以為要設定某個 range 變數）；請求句要點出**改什麼、改成什麼**（instead of just 500），只說 the status range 對方得猜。（原分類：Could you 請求句・其他請求句 第 31 條）

entries.o: could you also make the busy message use i18n? and save this to notes
nat: Also **run the "system busy" message through i18n**.
Could you also **run the "system busy" message through i18n**?
Could you also **localize the busy message** **instead of hardcoding it**?
entries.k: 原句文法正確、意思清楚；以下說法更道地。「改走多語系」慣用 **run X through i18n**、**localize X**；對比原本寫死可補 **instead of hardcoding it**；訊息名稱加引號（the "system busy" message）更明確。（原分類：Could you 請求句・其他請求句 第 32 條）

entries.o: why did you name Branch instead of node
nat: Why **is** it **named** `Branch` instead of `Node`?
Why did you **name** it `Branch` instead of `Node`?
**Why** `Branch` **rather than** `Node`?
entries.k: **name** 跟 rename 一樣是及物動詞——name **it** X（同文法結構第 87 條，第二次出現：動詞後面少了「被命名的東西」）；只想問取捨不必寫完整句，**Why X rather than Y?** 兩個字就到位；比較兩個選項時 **rather than** 比 instead of 更適合放在名詞之間。（原分類：文法結構）

entries.o: can I write like this?
nat: Can it **be written** like this?
Can I **write** it like this?
**Would this work**?
entries.k: 指著一段具體程式碼問「能不能這樣寫」，**write 要有受詞 it**（同第 83、84 條 rename / name，本系列第三次）——裸的 write like this 會讀成「我的寫作風格像這樣」；最短又最自然的其實是 **Would this work?**，母語者貼一段程式碼徵詢可行性幾乎都用這句。

entries.o: save {JSON A} instead of {JSON B}
nat: **Saving produces this instead of the expected output below**.
When I **save**, the nested NOT comes out wrapped in an extra bool **instead of** sitting next to `foo`.
entries.k: 單一個動詞 save 夾兩段 JSON 是筆記式片語不是句子，要補主詞與時態——**Saving produces X instead of Y** 或 **When I save, I get X instead of Y**；回報 bug 的固定講法是 **actual vs expected**（貼兩段長 JSON 時直接標 Actual: / Expected:，或寫 the first is what I get, the second is what I expect），否則讀的人得自己猜哪段是錯的；**instead of** 接在兩個對比的東西之間用得對（同本系列第 79 條）。

series.title: code comment
series.desc: same topic, collected together; how to talk about code comments — a/the comment, the JSDoc on X, stale／type comment

entries.o: fix [建議] file-a.js:5-6 — JSDoc 寫「於元件建立時求值標籤」已與新行為不符
nat: Fix **the** **stale** JSDoc **at** `file-b.js:5-6` — the comment still says the labels are evaluated at component creation, which **no longer matches** the new behavior.
entries.k: 指審查回報的項目要補名詞與冠詞——fix **the** stale JSDoc / **the** finding **at** file:line（同第 56 條 fix the ... issue at）；「過時註解」= **stale/outdated comment**；「已與～不符」= **no longer matches ...**。

entries.o: update the code comment ／ update foo code comment
nat: Update the **comments**.
Fix that **stale comment**.
Update **the JSDoc on** `foo`.
Update **the comment above** `foo`.
entries.k:
指多處要用**複數 comments**（單數 the code comment 會被讀成「就那一行」）；在程式碼裡講註解，**code** 通常可以省——上下文已經很清楚；「內容過時、與程式對不起來的註解」有專門說法 **stale comment**（也可說 **outdated comment**），比泛稱精準。
指特定那段註解要冠詞 **the**（同第 60 條 the catch、第 58 條 an index prop）；「函式上方那段說明」英文直接說 **the JSDoc on X** / **the comment above X**，比把名詞疊成 foo code comment 自然（中文語序的名詞堆疊，同第 60 條 login-modal catch）。

entries.o: this file 程式註解
nat: **This is about** the code **comment** in this file.
**I meant** the code **comment** in this file.
**I was referring to** the **comment** in this file, not the PR description.
entries.k: 程式碼裡的註解叫 **comment**（description 是 PR／工單的說明本文；用詞區分同第 63 條 heading vs title）；澄清自己指的是什麼用 **I meant ... / I was referring to ...**。

entries.o: fix index 型別註解與測試 fixture 互相矛盾
nat: Fix **the mismatch** between the `index` **type comment** and the test fixture.
The **type comment** on `index` **contradicts the test fixture** — please fix that.
entries.k: 「互相矛盾」= **mismatch between A and B** / **A contradicts B**（inconsistent with 亦可）；「型別註解」= **type comment**（type annotation 指 TS 型別標記）；祈使句 fix 後面要接名詞受詞——fix **the mismatch**。

entries.o: select show the label while saving the key, Foo both show and save the key, the behavior is different, add the code comment
nat: Select **shows** the label while saving the key, but Foo **shows and saves** the key. Since the behavior differs, add **a** code comment explaining that.
entries.k: 第三人稱單數——Select **shows**、Foo **shows and saves**（同第 93、57 條）；「兩者都做」用 **shows and saves** 即可，both 放在這裡多餘；四個子句只用逗號串是 **comma splice**（同第 113 條）——用 but／Since 串出對比與因果；泛指一則新註解用 **a** code comment。while saving the key 用得對（第 53 條 while ＋ V-ing 內化）。（原分類：文法結構 第 35 條）

entries.o: rename FOO
nat: **Rename it to** `FOO`.
Let's **rename the constant to** `FOO`.
entries.k: rename 要「舊名＋to＋新名」才完整——**rename it to X**，只丟新名字對方得猜是要改成還是改掉（介係詞 to 缺漏，同第 110 條 put X to／本系列第 24 條 remind me about）；同類動詞都吃 to：**rename A to B**、**change A to B**、**move A to B**。

entries.o: update the jsdoc
nat: Update the **JSDoc**.
Update the **JSDoc** **on** `foo`.
entries.k: 冠詞用對了（第 63 條的修正內化）；只差**縮寫大小寫**——**JSDoc**（同 Git・review 第 32 條的 pr → PR，**第二次出現**）；要指明是哪個函式的就接 **on X**。

entries.o: remove TODO dead code
nat: Remove the TODO and the dead **code**.
Drop the TODO comment and **the commented-out block**.
entries.k: 兩個東西要用 **and** 連接、各自帶冠詞 the，疊成 TODO dead code 會讀成「TODO 的死碼」一個東西（名詞堆疊，同第 63 條 foo code comment、第 60 條 login-modal catch）；「被註解掉的程式碼」精準說法是 **the commented-out block/code**。（原分類：介係詞與冠詞 第 25 條）

entries.o: 在 foo 的註解補一句「排序一併回預設」
nat: Add a line to the `foo` comment **noting that** the sort order also goes back to default.
Mention in the `foo` comment **that** it **resets the sort** as well.
entries.k: 「在註解補一句」= **add a line to the comment** 或 **mention in the comment that …**（comment 單數有冠詞 the，指既有那一條）；要補的內容用 **noting that … / that …** 子句帶出，不要直接引號貼中文；「排序回預設」= **the sort order goes back to default / resets the sort**。

series.title: clean / cleaner / cleanest
series.desc: same word, collected together; clean up = tidy for readability (not optimize, which means performance); "the cleanest way to …" asks for the best way to write something

entries.o: how to get keys in FOO[op].children
nat: **What's the cleanest way to** **get** the keys **out of** `FOO[op].children`?
**How do I** **get** the keys **out of** `FOO[op].children`?
**What's the cleanest way to** **pull** the keys **from** `FOO[op].children`?
entries.k:
* 「從某結構取出」說 **get … out of / pull … from**，in 會變成「在裡面取」語意不清
* **How to V 是標題式寫法**，對話裡要成句——**How do I / How can I + 動詞原形**（同第 2、3、65 條「疑問句要有主詞＋助動詞」）
* 問做法時 **What's the cleanest way to …?** 能同時徵詢寫法建議，比單問 how 更精準

entries.o: how about refactor like this
nat: **How about** **refactoring** **it** like this?
**What do you think of** this approach?
entries.k: **how about** 後面只能接動名詞或名詞片語——how about **refactoring**（how about + 動詞原形是最典型的中式英文；what about、think about、instead of 後面同樣一律接 -ing）；refactor 是及物動詞，要補受詞 **it**；徵詢意見是疑問句，要加問號（同第 4、51 條標點）。丟出一版寫法請對方評價，母語者也常說 **Does this approach look better? / Would this be cleaner?**；徵詢對方對做法的看法最常用 **What do you think of X?**（of 後面接名詞，同樣不接原形動詞）。

entries.o: would it be better using my version?
nat: **Would it be better** **to use** this version?
**Would it be better** **to use** my version?
**Would** my original version **have been a better starting point**?
entries.k: **Would it be better** 後面固定接 **to** V，不能接 -ing——better **to use**（**與第 144 條 better to name it X 完全相同的錯型，第二次出現**；記法：it 是虛主詞，真主詞是後面那個不定詞）；問「當初那版是不是比較好的起點」用完成式假設 **Would … have been a better starting point?**，語氣是回頭檢討而非現在二選一；只想問取捨也可以說 **Which way do you think is cleaner?**

entries.o: should these foo be optimized?
nat: **Could** the `foo` handling here **be tidied up**?
**Is there a cleaner way to** deal with `foo` in this block?
entries.k: **these + 單數名詞**不搭——指同一個變數出現多次要說 **the `foo` handling / these `foo` references**；**optimize** 是效能用語，這裡是可讀性問題，用 **tidy up / clean up / simplify**；問法用 **could … be tidied up?** 或 **is there a cleaner way to …?** 比 should 更像徵詢意見。

entries.o: how to write this
nat: **How should** this **be written**?
**How should I** write this?
**What's the cleanest** way to write **this condition**?
entries.k: **how to + 動詞是片段**（同第 113 條，第二次）——發問補主詞與助動詞 **How should I …?**；問「最好的寫法」可用 **What's the cleanest / idiomatic way to …?**；只丟 this 對方要猜指哪段，加受詞 **this condition / this guard** 更清楚。

entries.o: can this optimize? ／ could you optimize this?
nat: Can this **be optimized**?
**Is there a cleaner way** to write this?
**Clean this up**.
Could you **clean this up**?
entries.k:
程式碼是「被優化」，要**被動** can this **be optimized**（同第 2 條 could ... be written 的被動缺失）；問「有沒有更好的寫法」更常說 **Is there a cleaner way ...** / **Could this be simpler?**。
文法完全正確（受詞 this 有補上，第 136、137 條的修正都內化了）；唯一剩下的仍是**動詞選擇**——整理版面／可讀性用 **clean up / tidy up / refactor**，**optimize** 會讓讀者以為在調效能（同第 137、138 條，**第三次出現**）；指著某段程式時補 **this block / this markup** 更明確。

entries.o: optimize this code comment
nat: **Clean up** this comment.
**Tidy up** **this comment block**.
entries.k: **optimize 第四次出現**（同第 137、138、139 條）——整理可讀性一律 **clean up / tidy up / refactor**，optimize 會被讀成調效能；指一整塊註解用 **this comment block** 比單數 comment 精準（同第 198 條的單複數問題）；**code** 在程式碼語境可省。

entries.o: clean draggable="false"
nat: **Remove** **the** `draggable="false"`.
**Drop** **the** **now-redundant** `draggable="false"`.
entries.k: **clean 不是「刪除」**——clean (up) 是「整理、清乾淨」，要刪掉某段程式用 **remove / drop / get rid of**（本系列主題）；指特定那一個屬性要冠詞 **the** `draggable="false"`；想說明理由可補 **now-redundant / no longer needed**，對方就知道不是隨手刪。

entries.o: clean it
nat: **Clean it up**.
**Yeah, drop them**.
entries.k: **與第 141 條同一個錯（第二次出現）**——clean 單用不是「刪除」，光要「整理掉」也至少得補 particle **clean it up**（clean it 讀起來是「把它擦乾淨」，對程式碼沒意義）；這裡要刪的是三筆 `foo_key`，受詞用複數 **them** 才精準；同意對方提議刪東西時，母語者最常回 **Yeah, drop them.** / **Go ahead and remove them.**，比單一個動詞完整。

entries.o: fix foo
nat: **Clean up** the `foo` flag.
**Go ahead with** the `foo` cleanup.
entries.k: **fix 用於「壞掉的東西」**——這裡的 `foo` 沒有 bug，只是語意可以收緊，這種整理用 **clean up / tidy up**（同 optimize 系列第 79 條，選詞要對應實際意圖）；變數名前補個類別名詞 **the `foo` flag** 讀起來更完整；若是承接對方剛提的建議，**Go ahead with ...** 一句就表達「就照你說的做」。

entries.o: update the code comment
nat: Update the code **comments**.
**Clean up** the **comments** **in that block**.
entries.k: 指的是**多處**註解就用複數 **comments**（單數 the code comment 讀起來像只改某一行）；「整理／清掉雜訊」比 update 更精準的動詞是 **clean up / tidy up**；指定範圍加 **in that block / in `foo`** 更清楚。（原分類：文法結構 第 58 條）

entries.o: maybe merge FOO to BAR is better?
nat: **Maybe it'd be better to merge** `FOO` **into** `BAR`?
Would it be cleaner **to** **fold** `FOO` **into** `BAR`?
entries.k: **merge / fold** 的介係詞是 **into** 不是 **to**（併入某個容器用 into，同第 14 條 put X **into**、Could you・replace 系列的 replace **with**）；句型也要擇一——**Maybe it'd be better to merge …** 或把動詞名詞化 **Maybe merging X into Y is better**，動詞原形 merge 直接當主詞不成立；「把小東西併進大結構」母語者很愛用 **fold X into Y**，比 merge 更貼「收進去」的語感。

series.title: extract X into · a helper

entries.o: should it move to a share helper? ／ would it be worth extracting into a helper?
nat: **Should it** **be moved** **to** **a shared helper**?
**Should we** **move** it **to** **a shared helper**?
Is this worth **pulling out into** **a shared helper**?
Would it be **worth** **extracting** this **into** **a helper**?
entries.k:
**should it move → should we move it**（與第 115、116、120 條同型，當天第四次：動作的主詞是人）；**share → shared**：修飾名詞要過去分詞 **a shared helper / a shared constant**（同第 33 條提過的 share module → shared 系列）；「抽成共用」口語 **pull X out into a shared helper / extract X into**。
**worth** + V-ing 用得對，但及物動詞缺受詞——worth extracting **this / that block**（同 optimize 系列第 48、52 條，**第三次出現**）；「抽成獨立函式」= **pull ... out into a helper / extract ... into a helper**；問值不值得也可用 **Is this worth ...?**（主詞提前就不用補受詞）。

entries.o: query-statement-view also need this, so fold this Modal into a component
nat: `query-statement-view` **needs this too**, so **extract** the Modal **into** **a shared component**.
`query-statement-view` **needs this too**, so could you **extract** the Modal **into** **a shared component**?
**Pull** this Modal **out** **into** **its own component** so `query-statement-view` can use it **as well**.
entries.k: **fold into** 的方向是「併進既有的東西」（本系列前幾條都是把 A 收進 B），把一段程式「抽出來」成新元件是反方向，要用 **extract X into a component / pull X out into its own component**；第三人稱單數主詞動詞要加 s——query-statement-view **needs**（同文法結構的主詞動詞一致問題）；「也需要」口語放句尾 **needs this too / as well**，also 放動詞前雖然沒錯但較書面。（原分類：慣用說法與詞彙選擇）

entries.o: why not move similiar form like foo into share file?
nat: **Why weren't** the **similar** form sections **extracted** **into** **a shared component**?
**Why didn't you** **extract** the **similar** form sections **into** **a shared component**?
entries.k: 拼字 **similar**；「共用的」用形容詞 **shared**；「抽共用」動詞用 **extract**；問過去的決定用 Why didn't you。

entries.o: can the split extract more share part?
nat: Could the split **share more code** between the two files?
Is there more we could **extract** **into** **shared modules**?
entries.k: share part → **shared code / common logic**；問可行性用 Could we...。

entries.o: extract file-a.vue [FOO / BAR / BAZ] into the share file
nat: **Extract** `FOO` / `BAR` / `BAZ` **from** `file-a.vue` **into** the **shared** file.
**Move** these three constants **out of** `file-a.vue` **into** `file-b.js`.
entries.k: 「共用的」是形容詞 **shared**，**share** 是動詞——the **shared** file（同第 50 條 share function、介係詞與冠詞第 36 條 share function，**第三次出現**，要特別留意）；「從 A 抽到 B」動詞搭配 **extract X from A into B** 或 **move X out of A into B**，來源檔用 from / out of 帶出，不直接黏在 extract 後面；目標檔若已知就直接點名（file-b.js），比 the shared file 少一次來回。

entries.o: or define to a general share params?
nat: Or should **they** be defined **in** a general **shared** **constants** file?
Or should we define **them** **in** a general **shared** **constants** file?
entries.k: define 及物要受詞 **them**；「定義在檔案裡」= define ... **in** a file（不是 to）；**shared** 是形容詞（share 動詞——第 1 條 share part、文法結構第 22 條 share function 之後**第三次**）；「常數」= **constants**，params 專指函式參數／請求參數。

aliases: extract into a helper / shared helper
pull X out into / extract X into / move X into / to / factor X out into · a (shared) helper / component / module
pull X out into / extract X into / move X into (or to) / factor X out into · a (shared) helper / component / module
series.keys: pull X out into / extract X into / move X into (or to) / factor X out into · a (shared) helper / component / module

series.title: group
notes: Could you put all the ... entries together
Could you collect the 'instead of' entries into one series?

entries.o: please reorder the similar phrasing mistake
nat: **Group** the similar **mistakes** **together**.
Could you **group** the similar **mistakes** **together**?
Please reorder the notes so similar **mistakes** are **grouped** **together**.
entries.k: 「同類排一起」用 **group ... together**；mistake 要複數 **mistakes**。

entries.o: could you group yt as a category?
nat: **Group** the YouTrack-related **entries** **into** their own category.
Could you group the YouTrack-related **entries** **into** their own category?
entries.k: group 的受詞要指明是**條目**（the YouTrack-related **entries**），不能只說 yt；「歸成一類」= group ... **into** their own category / give them their own category。

entries.o: could you group the Git-releated entries into their own category?
nat: **Group** the Git-**related** entries into their own category.
Could you group the Git-**related** entries into their own category?
entries.k: 句型全對（活用了第 2 條的 group ... into their own category）；只差拼字 **related**（releated 是常見手滑）。

entries.o: Could you group the similar mistakes "let's get rid of..." together
nat: **Group** the "let's **get rid of**..." mistakes together.
Could you group the "let's **get rid of**..." mistakes together?
Could you put all the "**get rid of**" entries together?
entries.k: 引用片語當修飾語要放在名詞**前面**（the **"get rid of"** mistakes），不能掛在名詞後面當補述；有了引號片語就不用再加 similar。

entries.o: could you put all the "leave" entries together, right bellow existing series?
nat: **Put** all **the** "leave" entries together, right **below** the existing series.
Could you put all **the** "leave" entries together, right **below** the existing series?
entries.k: 拼字 **below**（bellow 是動詞「吼叫」）；series 要冠詞 **the**；put ... together 與 right below 都用得道地。

entries.o: could you put all the "like as or same way" entries together?
nat: **Put** all the "like / as / **the same way**" entries together.
Could you put all the "like / as / **the same way**" entries together?
entries.k: 句型全對（第 12 條的 put all the ... entries together 內化）；只差引號裡的標籤——並列幾個詞要用**斜線或 or 分隔**（"like / as / the same way"），三個詞連著寫讀不出是三個選項；**the same way** 的 the 不能省（同慣用說法・like 系列第 63 條 the same A as B）。

entries.o: also fold "rather than" into "instead" enteries
nat: **Also** **fold** **the "rather than" entries** into **the "instead" series**.
**Could you also** **fold** **the "rather than" entries** into **the "instead" series**?
entries.k: 拼字 **entries**（enteries 是字母順序手滑，同本系列第 4 條 releated）；受詞要講清楚搬的是**條目**、目的地是**系列**，且都要冠詞——**the "rather than" entries**、**the "instead" series**（只說 into "instead" 會被讀成搬進 instead 這個字）；**fold X into Y** 用得道地（同介係詞與冠詞・merge / fold into 系列）；接在前一個請求後面用 **Could you also ...?** 比祈使句語氣一致。

series.title: replace
series.desc: same collocation, collected together; replace **with** mistaken as "to" 4 times

entries.o: could you replace to FOO
nat: Replace it **with** `FOO`.
Could you replace it **with** `FOO`?
entries.k: replace 要有受詞（replace **it**），且搭配 **with** 不是 to；change **to** ≠ replace **with**，兩組搭配別互換。（缺受詞問題同文法結構・動詞與受詞系列）

entries.o: could you replace query-statement-page mode to exist param?
nat: Replace the `mode` prop **with** the **existing** `foo` param.
Could you replace the `mode` prop **with** the **existing** `foo` param?
entries.k: 「現有的」用形容詞 **existing**（exist 是動詞），且要加冠詞 the；replace **with** 不是 to（同第 8 條，第二次出現）。（原分類：拼字與易混字・existing 系列）

entries.o: replace to query-time-shortcuts
nat: **Rename** it **to** `query-time-shortcuts`.
Could you **rename** it **to** `query-time-shortcuts`?
entries.k: 「改名」動詞用 **rename ... to**；replace 只能搭 **with** 且要受詞（同第 8、25 條，第三次出現——前一句「replace t with i18n.global.t」才剛用對，搭配詞要固定下來）。

entries.o: replace foo_key to hn
nat: **Replace** `foo_key` **with** `hn`.
**Use the existing** `hn` key instead of `foo_key`.
entries.k: **replace A with B**（介係詞是 with，不是 to，**第四次出現**）；change A **to** B 才用 to（介係詞與冠詞第 8 條）——兩個動詞搭配別混；「改用既有的」= **use the existing X instead**。（原分類：介係詞與冠詞）

entries.o: replace the modal title to this
nat: **Change** the modal title **to** this.
**Replace the modal title with this**.
entries.k: **replace A with B**（介係詞是 with 不是 to，**第五次出現**，同第 8、25、10、11 條）；用 to 的動詞是 **change ... to**；「用這個當標題」也可說 **Use this as the modal title**。

entries.o: replace mdr-endpoint-* to match the new spec
nat: **Update** the mdr-endpoint-* **list** **to match the new spec** as well.
**Replace** the hard-coded mdr-endpoint-* **list** with the data from the new API.
entries.k: **replace A with B**——只說 replace X to match ... 少了「換成什麼」的 with 片語（**第六次出現**，同第 8、25、10、11、12 條）；「改成符合新規格」動詞用 **update ... to match the new spec**；受詞補完整名詞——the mdr-endpoint-* **list/handling**。

entries.o: replace with foo.type === LOGGER return BAR
nat: Replace it with a `foo.type === LOGGER` check **that returns** `BAR`.
**Change the condition**: if the type **is** LOGGER, **return** `BAR`.
entries.k: **replace with** 終於用對（本系列六次修正的內化）；replace 及物仍要受詞——replace **it** with ...；條件＋結果兩個動詞要接起來——a check **that returns** ...（兩動詞相連問題同文法結構・動詞與受詞系列）。

entries.o: why cannot replace {{ $t(foo(BAR)) }} with {{ $t(BAZ(BAR)) }}
nat: **Why can't** `$t(foo(BAR))` **be replaced** **with** `$t(BAZ(BAR))`?
**Why can't we** **replace** `$t(foo(BAR))` **with** `$t(BAZ(BAR))`?
**What stops us from** just indexing the map directly here?
entries.k: **replace A with B 這次完全正確**（本系列七次修正後第三次一次到位，同第 12、14 條）；問題出在主詞——**why cannot** 後面要有主詞 **why can't we / why can't I**，中文「為什麼不能」省主詞英文不能省（同文法結構第 1 條）；否定疑問句口語一律縮寫 **can't**，cannot 拆開寫偏正式書面；問「為什麼不能這樣做」也可用 **What stops us from V-ing?**，語氣是請對方講理由而非質疑。

entries.o: why cannnot replace FOO with BAR
nat: **Why can't** `FOO` **be replaced** **with** `BAR`?
**Why can't we** **replace** `FOO` **with** `BAR`?
**What breaks if** we just use `BAR` here?
entries.k: **replace A with B 再次用對**（本系列第 12、33、39 條）；**缺主詞與第 37 條完全相同**——why cannot → **why can't we**（同一錯型第二次，寫 why 開頭的疑問句時先問自己「誰做這件事」）；拼字 **cannot**（cannnot 多一個 n）；想聽的是「壞在哪」而不是「可不可以」時，**What breaks if …?** 比 why can't 更直接。

entries.o: keep showing assistant copy, only user content hover show
nat: Keep the assistant's copy **icon** **always visible**; only show the user **message's** icon **on hover**.
entries.k: 「常駐顯示」= keep it **always visible**（比 keep showing 道地）；「hover 才顯示」= show it **on hover**（同第 28 條）；名詞說完整——the assistant's copy **icon**、the user **message's** icon。

entries.o: copy keep table format
nat: **Keep** the table format **when copying**.
**Preserve the table formatting** in the copied text.
entries.k: 兩個動詞不能並排（copy keep）——其中一個收進子句 **when copying**；「保留格式」= **keep/preserve the format(ting)**。

entries.o: messages save assistant's content as response, only when showing then render markdown
nat: Store the assistant's content as the **raw** response **in** `messages`, and render the markdown **only when displaying** it.
entries.k: 「存進 X」= store ... **in** X（messages 是容器不是主詞）；「顯示時才～」= **only when displaying**（同第 28 條，中文的「才/就」不翻 then）；「原始內容」= the **raw** response。

entries.o: could you save the commit subject rule in English
nat: (a) Save a rule **that** commit subjects should be in English. ／ (b) Save the commit-subject rule, **written** in English.
(a) Could you save a rule **that** commit subjects should be in English? ／ (b) Could you save the commit-subject rule, **written** in English?
entries.k: **修飾語歧義**——in English 掛在 rule（規則內容＝標題用英文）或掛在 save（存檔時用英文寫）意思不同；要說清楚就把子句展開：a rule **that** subjects should be in English，或補 **written** in English。

entries.o: could you write a file for me to report this bug?
nat: **Write up** a bug report for this.
Could you **write up** a bug report for this?
Could you draft a bug report I can **file** **upstream**?
entries.k: 原句文法正確；以下說法更道地。「寫一份（報告類）文件」慣用 **write up** a bug report；「回報 bug」動詞慣用 **file**（file a bug/issue）；「給上游專案」= **upstream**。

entries.o: could you allow path C:\...\claude to global claude setting? maybe append this path in restrict-file-access.sh?
nat: **Allow** **the** path `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Project\claude` in the global Claude **settings** — **maybe just** append it **to** `restrict-file-access.sh`.
Could you **allow** **the** path `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Project\claude` in the global Claude **settings**? **Maybe just** append it **to** `restrict-file-access.sh`.
entries.k: **allow X in the settings**（不是 allow X **to** settings）；**append to** a file（不是 append in）；冠詞與複數——**the** path、**the** global Claude **settings**（設定檔慣用複數）；「乾脆就…」= **Maybe just ...**（提議做法時比 maybe 單用更自然）。

entries.o: Could you put together a department report of my work from last Friday through today, grouped by module, one sentence per PR?
nat: Put together **a report for the department** **covering** the work **from last Friday through today**, grouped by module, **one sentence per PR**.
Could you put together **a report for the department** **covering** my work **from last Friday through today**, grouped by module, **one sentence per PR**?
entries.k: **a department report** 聽起來像「關於部門的報告」——要說「給部門看的報告」用 **a report for the department**；報告的內容範圍用 **covering ...** 或 **on my work**，a report **of** my work 語意鬆散（of 只適合 a summary of ...）；**put together a report**、**from last Friday through today**、**one sentence per PR** 都很道地，per 用得精準。

entries.o: could you follow this to build?
nat: **Build on this** approach instead.
Could you **build on this** approach instead?
Could you **keep this structure** and fix it from there?
entries.k: **follow this to build 語序不自然**——follow 後面接「照著走的東西」，再接 to build 會被讀成目的（照這個去蓋什麼），母語者講「照這個方向繼續做」用 **build on this**、**go with this approach**、**keep this structure**；**this 在長討論裡指涉不清**，點名具體對象更好——this version / the `FOO.forEach` version（同其他請求句第 43 條 it 指涉不明）；若重點是「不要改我的寫法、只修 bug」，最精準的說法是 **Could you fix it without changing this structure?**

entries.o: could you make the block more obvious（＋中文備註：優化方向：再明顯一點，像是增加 padding、hover 滑鼠移過去放大顯示）
nat: Make the block **stand out** more — **for example**, give it more padding and **enlarge it** **slightly** **on hover**.
Could you make the block **stand out** more? **For example**, give it more padding and **enlarge it** **slightly** **on hover**.
Could you make the nested blocks **more noticeable** — more padding, and scale them up **a bit** **on hover**?
entries.k: UI 元素「要更顯眼」慣用 **stand out (more)** 或 **more noticeable / more prominent**；**obvious** 偏「顯而易見、不用想就懂」，形容外觀醒目時不夠貼切；「滑鼠移過去」一律講 **on hover**（不用 when the mouse moves over）；「放大顯示」= **enlarge it / scale it up (slightly / a bit)**，程度詞加上去才不會被理解成放很大；補充說明的細項用 **For example, ...** 或破折號接在請求句後面。

entries.o: could you translate 我的原句 母語者 重點, description and tiltle to english
nat: **Translate** the labels, **the description**, and **the title** **into** English.
Could you **translate** the labels, **the description**, and **the title** **into** English?
Could you put **the** labels, **the description**, and the **headings** **into** English?
entries.k: **並列項目之間要有逗號**——我的原句, 母語者, 重點（用空白隔開會被讀成一個詞組）；**translate X into English** 是最道地的搭配（to English 也通，但「轉換成另一種語言」慣用 into，同 merge / fold **into** 的「進入」語感）；**the description / the title** 要加 **the**，指的是這份檔案裡特定那一段（同介係詞與冠詞多條的冠詞漏字）；拼字 **title**（tiltle 多打一個 l）；指 `##` 這種節標題，母語者會說 **headings**（title 多指整份文件的標題）。

entries.o: could you split Foo into new file?
nat: Go ahead and split `Foo` into **separate files**.
Could you go ahead and split `Foo` into **separate files**?
entries.k: 拆成多個檔用複數 **separate files**；請人動手做用 go ahead and...。

entries.o: could you create to strategy version like ai-summary-form in separate new file
nat: Create **the** strategy version, like `ai-summary-form`, in **separate new files**.
Could you create **the** strategy version, like `ai-summary-form`, in **separate new files**?
entries.k: create 後直接接受詞，**不加 to**（create **the** strategy version）；「另開新檔」用複數 **separate new files**。

entries.o: Could personal ticket detail add foo tab?
nat: Add **a** `foo` tab **to** **the** personal ticket detail **view**.
Could **we** add **a** `foo` tab **to** **the** personal ticket detail **view**?
entries.k: 做動作的主詞是**我們**，不是被改的頁面——說 Could **we** add X **to** Y，別讓 detail 當主詞去 add；名詞要加冠詞 **a** tab、**the** ... detail **view**。

entries.o: also add query-group-mngt, report-doc-detail, report-chapter-detail test
nat: Also add **tests** **for** `query-group-mngt`, `report-doc-detail`, and `report-chapter-detail`.
Could you also add **tests** **for** `query-group-mngt`, `report-doc-detail`, and `report-chapter-detail`?
entries.k: 「幫 X 補測試」= add tests **for** X（多個測試用複數 **tests**，同第 24 條）；三項以上並列，最後一項前要加 **and**。

entries.o: add copy function to copy content
nat: Add **a** copy function to copy **the** content.
Could you add **a** **copy button** for **the** message content?
entries.k: 可數名詞要冠詞——**a** copy function／button（同第 24、25 條系列）；特定內容加 **the** content；UI 情境更常說 **copy button**。

entries.o: add copy Tooltip
nat: Add **a** tooltip **to** the copy icon.
entries.k: 冠詞——add **a** tooltip（同第 26 條 a copy function 系列）；「加在～上」= **to** the copy icon。

entries.o: could you address the pr comment
nat: **Address** the PR **comments**.
Could you **address** the PR **comments**?
Could you **address the review feedback** on #558?
entries.k: 一輪 review 通常有**多則**留言，用複數 **comments**（單數指特定某一則）；整批回應審查意見更常說 **address the review feedback**；**address 這個動詞用得很好**——回應／處理審查意見的標準說法，比 fix／handle 精準（含「逐條回覆或處理」之意，不必真的每條都改）。

entries.o: Could you save the before-and-after phrasings to this file everytime I send you a message?
nat: Save the before-and-after phrasings to this file **every time** a message is sent.
Could you save the before-and-after phrasings to this file **every time** I send you a message?
entries.k: 幾乎全對，只差 **every time** 要拆成兩個字。（everytime 錯誤同拼字・every time 系列）

entries.o: could you add total count at the notes file begining? and start a new order in each categary
nat: Add a total count at the **beginning** **of** the notes file, and **restart the numbering** in each **category**.
Could you add a total count at the **beginning** **of** the notes file, and **restart the numbering** in each **category**?
entries.k: 拼字 **beginning**（雙 n）、**category**；「檔案開頭」= at the beginning **of** the notes file；「重新編號」= **restart the numbering**。

entries.o: could you add the tests in this branch? expecially for content-insert-tool and query-statement-edit
nat: Add **tests** **on** this branch, **especially** for `content-insert-tool` and `query-statement-edit`.
Could you add **tests** **on** this branch, **especially** for `content-insert-tool` and `query-statement-edit`?
entries.k: 拼字 **especially**（expecially 是常見手滑）；泛指尚不存在的測試不加 the——add **tests**／some tests（the tests 是指特定那批）；分支介係詞用 **on**（同 Git 系列第 1 條 stay **on** the branch）。

entries.o: could you rename the i18n keys to a genetic name, and move to top
nat: Rename the i18n keys to **something more generic** and **move them** to the top.
Could you rename the i18n keys to **something more generic** and **move them** to the top?
entries.k: **genetic（基因的）≠ generic（通用的）**，只差一個字母但意思天差地遠；複數 keys 對應的名稱也要複數，或照第 35 條的修正用 **something more generic**（英文避免 a + 形容詞 + name 的堆疊）；後半子句要補受詞 **move them** to the top（同 to test 缺受詞系列）。

entries.o: could you not use 'index' to determine whether it is ouside the table?
nat: Avoid using `'index'` to **detect** drags from **outside** the table.
Could we avoid using `'index'` to **detect** drags from **outside** the table?
**Is there a way to** **tell external drags apart** **without** relying on `'index'`?
entries.k: 拼字 **outside**（ouside 漏了 t）；**Could you not ...?** 語氣像在制止或抱怨（「你可不可以不要⋯」），提替代做法用 **Could we avoid -ing ...?** 或 **Is there a way to ... without ...?** 比較像在一起找方案（同 Could you 系列第 40 條 could you not insert 的同一個問題，**第二次出現**）；**it 指涉不明**——講清楚主體是拖曳這件事：**whether the drag came from outside**；「分辨」用 **detect / tell X apart**，determine 偏正式書面。

entries.o: could you rename foo and bar, they are confuse
nat: Rename `foo` and `bar` — they're **too easy to mix up**.
Could you rename `foo` and `bar`? They're **too easy to mix up**.
Could you rename `foo` and `bar` — the names are **confusing**.
entries.k: **confuse** 是動詞；形容「東西令人困惑」要用 -ing 形容詞 **confusing**（-ed 的 **I'm confused** 是「人感到困惑」，見拼字與易混字第 26 條——同一個 confuse 系列的第三種變化，這次錯在該用 -ing 的那一邊）；**逗號連兩個完整句是 comma splice**（同文法結構第 51、53 條），請求與理由要斷成兩句或用破折號；「名字太像會搞混」母語者更常說 **too easy to mix up / too close to each other**，比 confusing 更精準點出問題在哪。（原分類：拼字與易混字）

entries.o: could you add a Modal to input custom title when click the HEADING?
nat: Add **a** modal for **entering** a custom title **when** a heading item **is clicked**.
Could you add **a** modal for **entering** a custom title **when** a heading item **is clicked**?
Could you pop up **a** modal so **I** can **type** a custom title **when** I click a heading?
entries.k: **when 子句要主詞**——when **I** click 或 when a heading **is clicked**（同文法結構第 16 條 when click the risk，第二次出現）；冠詞——**a** custom title、**a** heading；UI 的「輸入」慣用 **enter/type**（input 當動詞偏技術文件語感）。

entries.o: could you identify paste a table?
nat: **Detect when a table is pasted**.
Could you **detect when a table is pasted**?
**Can we tell whether** the pasted content is a table?
entries.k: identify 後面不能直接接動詞原形——要嘛 **detect when a table is pasted**（時機），要嘛 **identify a pasted table**（用過去分詞當形容詞）；程式偵測事件慣用 **detect** 而非 identify（identify 偏「辨識出是哪一個」）；問可行性也可用 **Can we tell whether ...?**（tell = 分辨，很口語）。

entries.o: could you not insert a table heading when paste a markdown
nat: Skip inserting the table heading **when** **markdown is pasted**.
Could we skip inserting the table heading **when** **I** paste **markdown**?
Could you **leave out** the table heading **for markdown pastes**?
entries.k: **when 子句要主詞**——when **I** paste（同第 25 條 when click the HEADING，第三次出現）；**markdown 不可數**，不加 a；否定請求用 **skip -ing / leave out / hold off on**，could you **not** insert 文法沒錯但聽起來像在制止對方；情境當形容詞用連字號或 for 片語——**for markdown pastes**（同第 36 條偵測表格貼上的主題）。

entries.o: could you show me fix what would look like if write like this as a diff
nat: Show **what the fix would look like** **if it were written this way** — as a diff.
Could you show me **what the fix would look like** **if it were written this way** — as a diff?
Could you show me this version with **the** bugs fixed, as a diff?
entries.k: **間接問句語序**——「什麼東西會長怎樣」是 **what the fix would look like**，不是 show me fix what would look like（疑問詞要領頭，且 fix 是可數名詞要加 **the**）；**if 子句要有主詞**，「照這樣寫」是被動 **if it were written this way**（假設語氣用 were）；**this way / like this 擇一**，不要 write like this 又 as a diff 疊在一起——把 as a diff 用破折號分出來當補述最清楚。

entries.o: change to foo and bar
nat: Change **these** to `foo` and `bar`.
Could you change **these** to `foo` and `bar`?
entries.k: change 要有受詞——change **these/it** to（同慣用說法・instead 系列第 45 條的 change to 缺受詞；及物動詞缺受詞問題同文法結構・動詞與受詞系列）。

entries.o: could copy align bottom?
nat: Could the copy **icon** be aligned **to the** bottom?
Could you **bottom-align** the copy **icon**?
entries.k: 主詞要完整——the copy **icon**（copy 單獨當主詞會被讀成動詞）；「對齊到～」= be aligned **to the** bottom（被動＋介係詞＋冠詞）；口語動詞也可說 **bottom-align**。

entries.o: change to new line, only when hover content then show copy
