nat: Move the copy icon to **a** new line, and show it **only when hovering over** the content.
entries.k: 「換行放」= move/put it **on its own line**／to **a** new line（冠詞）；「hover 才顯示」= show it **only when hovering over** ...（when 子句用動名詞或補主詞，中文的「就/then」不用翻出來）。

entries.o: read C:\Users\user\Desktop\Project\claude to test
nat: Try reading `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Project\claude` to check **whether it works**.
**Read** something under that path **to confirm** the hook change **took effect**.
entries.k: 驗證用途的祈使句慣用 **Try -ing ...**（直接 read ... to test 像在下命令，語氣硬）；**to test** 後面最好補受詞或子句——to test **it** / to check **whether it works**（同 mention it、extract this 的缺受詞系列）；「（設定）生效」= **take effect / it works**。

entries.o: would you suggest a better button title?
nat: **Suggest** a **better** **label** for this button.
**Could you suggest** a **better** **label** for this button?
**Any better ideas for** the button **label**?
entries.k: 請人提建議用 **Could you suggest …** 或 **Do you have a (better) suggestion for …**——**Would you suggest** 是問「你會不會建議（這樣做）」，偏在徵詢意見的方向而不是要對方給選項；按鈕上顯示的文字叫 **label**（或 button text），**title** 在前端會被理解成 HTML 的 title 屬性（滑鼠停留的提示）；口語也可用 **Any better ideas for …?** 直接開放對方提案。

entries.o: could you take a look for file-a.md any tell me the plan
nat: **Take a look** **at** `file-a.md` and outline the plan.
Could you **take a look** **at** `file-a.md` and tell me the plan?
Could you go through `file-a.md` and **walk me through the plan**?
entries.k: **take a look 固定搭 at**——look **for** 是「尋找」，會被理解成「幫我找 file-a.md 這個檔」（介係詞與冠詞第 28、41 條、YouTrack 第 1、14 條都是 take a look at，這次搭錯介係詞是新錯法）；**any → and** 手滑拼錯；「把計畫講給我聽」口語常說 **walk me through the plan**、**fill me in on the plan**，比 tell me 多了「逐步說明」的意思。

entries.o: I had checkout, use SOCMSSPP-2165
nat: **A new branch is already checked out** — use SOCMSSPP-2165.
**I've already checked out** a new branch — use SOCMSSPP-2165.
entries.k: **check out** 當動詞是兩個字（checkout 是名詞）；「已經做了」用現在完成式 **I've already checked out**，不用 had＋名詞。（原分類：YouTrack 工單，更早為文法結構）

entries.o: stay in current branch
nat: Stay **on** the current branch.
Let's stay **on** the current branch.
Just do it **on** the current branch.
entries.k: 分支的介係詞用 **on**，不用 in。（原分類：介係詞與冠詞）

entries.o: commit
nat: **Commit it**.
**Go ahead and commit** this.
entries.k: commit 及物要受詞——commit **it**（同第 15 條）；單一動詞當指令口語可通，補受詞更完整。

entries.o: commit only Foo
nat: Commit only **the** time-shortcuts **change**.
entries.k: commit only 語序正確；指「那部分變更」要補名詞——the time-shortcuts **change**（拿識別字當普通名詞時前面要 **the**）。

entries.o: 拆兩個，都掛 SOCMSSPP-2070
nat: Split it into two **commits**, and **reference** SOCMSSPP-2070 **on both**.
Make it two **commits** — **tag** both **with** SOCMSSPP-2070.
entries.k: 「拆兩個」要補名詞——split it into two **commits**；「掛單號」= **reference / tag ... with** a ticket（Refs footer 動詞常用 reference）；「都」指兩個 commit = **on both / both of them**。

entries.o: commit and push, change the pr title
nat: Commit and push, **then** change the PR title.
entries.k: 兩組祈使句不能只用逗號相連（comma splice，同第 22 條）——用 **then / and** 串；the PR title 冠詞用對了。

entries.o: commit this, and split into two commits
nat: Commit this, **but** split it into two commits.
Commit this **as two separate commits**.
entries.k: split 是及物動詞要受詞——split **it** into（缺受詞問題同文法結構・動詞與受詞系列）；「拆成兩個 commit」也可直接說 **as two separate commits**；前後語意是「做，但要拆」，連接詞用 **but** 比 and 貼切。

entries.o: 拆成 feat 與 refactor 兩筆
nat: **Split it into two commits**: **a feat and a refactor**.
Make it two **commits** — **one feat, one refactor**.
entries.k: 「拆成兩筆」= **split it into two commits**（同第 7 條，split 要受詞 it）；列舉兩種類型用冒號或破折號帶出 **a feat and a refactor / one feat, one refactor**；commit type 當名詞用時加冠詞 **a feat (commit)**。

series.title: review
notes: Could you address the review feedback on PR 543?
Could you take care of the comments on PR 543?

entries.o: open pr
nat: Open **a** PR.
Could you open **a** PR for this branch?
entries.k: 可數名詞首次提及要冠詞——open **a** PR（同第 15 條 update **the** PR、第 13 條 push 系列的 PR 冠詞）。

entries.o: could you fix pr comment ／ could you address the pr 534 comment? ／ could you address the comment on the pr 511? ／ could you address the pr comment
nat: **Address** **the** PR comment.
Could you **address** **the** PR comment?
**Address** the comment **on** PR 534.
Could you **address** the comment **on** PR 534?
entries.k:
回應／處理審查意見慣用 **address**（fix 是修程式本身）；名詞要冠詞——**the** PR comment。（原分類：Could you 請求句）
**address** 用對了（第 10 條內化成功）；名詞堆疊 the PR 534 comment 拆成 the comment **on** PR 534 更自然（comment on 搭配同第 14、14 條與 YouTrack 系列第 2 條）。
第 11 條的 comment **on** 修正已內化；差最後一步——**編號當專名不加 the**：on PR 511（同 SOCMSSPP-2165、issue #12 這類「名詞＋編號」都不加冠詞）。
文法正確（address the comment 的用法已內化，同本節第 19、21 條）；只差 **PR 是縮寫要全大寫**；若不只一則用複數 **comments**，要指名哪張單則說 **the comments on PR 551**（同第 11 條 the comment on PR 534）。

entries.o: could you leave the comment to pr ／ could you leave the comment to pr about the tests
nat: Leave **a** comment **on** the PR.
Could you leave **a** comment **on** the PR?
Leave **a** comment **on** the PR about the tests.
Could you leave **a** comment **on** the PR about the tests?
entries.k:
首次提及的留言用 **a** comment（the 是指特定那則）；comment 搭 **on** the PR 不用 to（同第 5 條 comment on the PR、YouTrack 系列第 2 條 comment to yt，第三次出現——這組搭配要固定下來）。
與第 14 條同款——**a** comment **on** the PR（comment 搭配錯誤**第四次出現**）；about the tests 用得對。

entries.o: it is intended, commit, update yt, and update pr
nat: **That's intended**. Commit it, update **the** YouTrack ticket, and update the PR.
entries.k: 確認「是刻意的」慣用 **That's intended / That's intentional**；commit 是及物動詞要受詞（commit **it**）；ticket / PR 前加 **the**。（原分類：YouTrack 工單，更早為慣用說法＋文法結構）

entries.o: push and update pr ／ push it and update pr
nat: Push **the changes** and update **the** PR.
Push it and update **the** PR.
entries.k:
push 及物用法補受詞更完整——push **the changes / the branch**（git 情境單獨說 push 口語也通）；PR 前要冠詞 **the**（同第 15 條 update **the** PR，第二次出現）。
push **it** 這次有補受詞（第 13 條 push and update pr 的進步）；PR 前仍要冠詞 **the**（同第 15、13 條，第三次出現）。

entries.o: I had confirm the backend has been deployed at the same version and the data migration is complete
nat: **Confirmed**: the backend has been deployed at the same version and the data migration is complete.
**I've confirmed** the backend has been deployed at the same version and the data migration is complete.
entries.k: 「已經做了」用現在完成式 **I've confirmed**（have＋過去分詞；I had confirm 與第 1 條的 I had checkout 同款錯誤）；句子後半 deployed at the same version、migration is complete 都全對。

entries.o: Take a look at the last comment in PR, the reviewer said I over change, so I need to rename PR and YT title to match the change?
nat: The last comment **on** the PR says **the changes went beyond the** **original** **scope**. **Does that mean** the PR and the YouTrack ticket **should be renamed** to match what actually changed?

Take a look at the last comment **on** the PR — the reviewer said **the changes went beyond the** **original** **scope**. **Does that mean I should** rename the PR and the YouTrack ticket to match what actually changed?
entries.k: comment **on** the PR（同 YouTrack 系列第 2 條）；「改過頭／超出範圍」不說 over change，說 **the changes went beyond the (original) scope**（審查用語也常見 **scope creep**）；問句要有助動詞——**Does that mean I should ...** / **Do I need to ...**，不能拿直述句掛問號。

entries.o: the demand is in PR #511 file-a.vue
nat: **The actual consumer** is in PR #511 — `file-a.vue`.
The **requirement** comes from PR #511.
entries.k: 軟體「需求」用 **requirement**（同 Could you 系列第 15 條，demand 偏「索求／需求量」）；指「實際用到的地方」更道地說 **the actual consumer / the actual usage**。

entries.o: this branch is name by short-desc, go ahead with #2 and #3
nat: This branch is **named** **after** a short description — go ahead with #2 and #3.
entries.k: 被動語態要用過去分詞——is **named**（is name 是 be＋原形名詞的混用）；「以～命名」= named **after / using**，不用 by；go ahead with 用得很道地。

entries.o: I'm not going to follow that rule, I name by 具體功能 not issue serial number ／ I name branches after the specific feature, not the issue number. in this module I'm not going to follow name by the issue number, fix the pr description
nat: That rule won't be followed — **branches** are named **after** the specific feature, not the issue number.
I'm not going to follow that rule — I name **branches** **after** the specific feature, not the issue number.
Branches are named after the specific feature, not the issue number. **For** this module the **issue-number convention** won't be followed — please fix the PR description.
I name branches after the specific feature, not the issue number. **For** this module I'm not going to **follow the issue-number convention** — please fix the PR description.
entries.k:
name 是及物動詞要受詞——name **branches**（缺受詞問題同文法結構・動詞與受詞系列）；「以～命名」= name ... **after**（同第 21 條的 named after）；兩個完整句子不能只用逗號連接（comma splice），用破折號或分號。
第一句全對（第 22 條 name ... after 的修正內化）；「遵循某命名慣例」= **follow the issue-number convention**（follow name by 是兩個動詞相撞）；兩個獨立子句用破折號或句號，不能只用逗號（comma splice，Git 系列第五次）；句首 **In/For** 大寫、PR 大寫。

entries.o: 以前團隊說分支要以具體功能命名
nat: The team **previously agreed** that branches should be **named after** the specific feature.
entries.k: 「以前（團隊）說好」= **previously agreed / decided**（比 said 正式、有約定力）；被動 should be **named after**（同第 21、22 條）。

entries.o: 開發可能涉及多單號，若只用一個單號命名可能無法表示完整調整
nat: A change often **spans multiple tickets**, so naming the branch after a single ticket number **can't capture the full scope** of the work.
entries.k: 「涉及多張單」= **spans multiple tickets**（span 表橫跨）；「無法表示完整調整」= **can't capture the full scope**；因果用 so／which means 串起來。

entries.o: 太複雜了，是否有更好懂得寫法
nat: This is too complicated — is there **a clearer** way **to write it**?
entries.k: 「更好懂的寫法」= **a clearer / more readable way (to write it)**；code review 情境也常說 **Could we simplify this?** / **This could be more readable.**

entries.o: 正規化移除後直接指派給 this.selectedRiskLevels
nat: **Since** the normalization **is gone**, just **assign it directly to** `this.selectedRiskLevels`.
entries.k: 「直接指派給」= **assign it directly to**（assign 要受詞 it，搭 to）；「～移除後」開頭用 **Since/Now that ... is gone (removed)** 帶出因果。

entries.o: drop it. add also fix pr 511's missing bug, query-statement-edit use Foo but not given bar
nat: Drop it. **Also** add that this fixes a bug PR 511 **missed**: `query-statement-edit` **uses** `Foo` **without passing** `bar`.
entries.k: **also 放動詞前**——also add（同慣用說法第 21 條 also 位置）；「被遺漏的 bug」= a bug **that was missed** / a **missed** bug（missing bug 意思是「找不到的 bug」）；第三人稱 **uses**；「沒有傳」= **without passing**；drop it 用得對（慣用說法第 20 條 deprecate 的修正活用）。

entries.o: 到底在講甚麼看不懂。Foo 有驗證必須要全部欄位都非空才能送出，完全不會有畫面沒填完就送出的議題。the latest PR comment
nat: **It's unclear what** the latest PR comment **is saying**. Foo already validates that every field is non-empty before submitting, so **there's no way** **a half-filled** row could get submitted.
**I don't get what** the latest PR comment **is saying**. Foo already validates that every field is non-empty before submitting, so **there's no way** **a half-filled** row could get submitted.
entries.k: 「看不懂在講什麼」口語 = **I don't get what ... is saying** / **I can't follow this comment**；「完全不會有～的議題」= **there's no way ... could happen**（issue 在這裡不需要，直接說 no way）；「畫面沒填完就送出」= **a half-filled / incomplete row gets submitted**；the latest PR comment 冠詞用對了。

entries.o: set this ticket number as default in this branch
nat: **Make this ticket number the default** for this branch.
Use this ticket as **the** default **on** this branch.
entries.k: **the** default 要冠詞；分支介係詞用 **on**——on this branch（同第 2 條 stay **on** the branch）；set X as default 可通，更慣用 **make X the default**。

entries.o: reply the pr comment
nat: **Reply** **to** the PR comment.
**Post a reply to the latest review comment**.
entries.k: **reply** 是不及物動詞，受詞前要加 **to**——reply **to** the comment（同文法結構・動詞與受詞系列第 5 條 reply me → reply to me，**第二次出現**）；想省掉介係詞就換及物動詞：**answer the comment** / **address the comment**（同第 31 條）/ **respond to** 也要 to；「回一則留言」名詞用法 **post a reply to X** 最常見。

entries.o: highlight need backend in the pr
nat: **Highlight** **the backend dependency** **in the PR**.
**Call out** **in the PR** **that this needs the backend** **deployed first**.
entries.k: **need backend 不成名詞片語**——highlight 後面要接名詞 **the backend dependency**，或改成子句 **that this needs the backend (deployed first)**；「特別標出、提醒 reviewer 注意」用 **highlight / call out / flag**（call out 最口語）；「在 PR 裡」介係詞 **in the PR**（描述內文），留言則是 on the PR（同第 11 條）。

entries.o: save Highlight the backend dependency if any pr match
nat: **Save this as a rule**: highlight the backend dependency **whenever a PR has one**.
Remember to **call out** backend dependencies in **any PR that has them**.
entries.k: **if any pr match 條件不完整**——match 是及物動詞，要有受詞，而且這裡想說的是「有後端相依的 PR」，直接講 **whenever a PR has one / if a PR depends on backend work**；「存成規則」= **save this as a rule** 或口語 **remember this**；規則句用 **whenever** 比 if 更有「每次都要」的意思；第三人稱單數 **a PR has**。

entries.o: comment to yt
nat: Post a comment **on** the YouTrack ticket.
Could you post a comment **on** the YouTrack ticket?
Add a comment **to** the ticket.
entries.k: 動詞 comment 搭 **on**（comment on the ticket）；用 add/post 時才是 a comment **to/on** the ticket；yt 口語可，正式寫 YouTrack。（原分類：介係詞與冠詞）

entries.o: include all the changes to the range, update the yt content
nat: Include all the changes **in** the **scope**, and update the YouTrack ticket.
Widen the **scope** to cover all the changes and update the ticket **description**.
entries.k: 工作「範圍」= **scope**（range 是數值／日期區間）；in the scope 用 **in** 不用 to；「工單內容」= the ticket **description**（同第 10 條，現移至 leave 系列第 18 條）；兩個祈使句用 **and** 連接（comma splice 同 Git 系列）。（原分類：慣用說法）

entries.o: rename title to [soc-web] foo 改用 file-a.js 共用版
nat: **Change** **the title** to "[soc-web] Switch foo to the shared file-a.js".
Update the ticket **title** to …
entries.k: 可數名詞要冠詞——the **title**（同介係詞與冠詞第 33、34 條的冠詞漏字）；改標題文字用 **change / update the title to**，**rename** 偏「重新命名檔案、變數、分支」這類有識別名的東西；新標題用引號框起來，對方才知道從哪裡開始是標題本文。（原分類：介係詞與冠詞）

entries.o: yt-attachments folder
nat: Put it in **the** yt-attachments **folder** **instead**.
Save it under `yt-attachments/<ticket>/` **instead**.
entries.k: 只丟名詞，對方要猜動作——補動詞與介係詞 **put / save it in the X folder**；「改放那裡」的語氣用 **instead** 收尾；資料夾名當專有名詞不加冠詞，但後面的 folder 要 **the**。（原分類：文法結構 缺動詞）

entries.o: give me Youtrack ticket content example
nat: Give **an** example **of** the **YouTrack** ticket content.
Could you give me **an** example **of** the **YouTrack** ticket content?
Could you **show me what** the ticket **should look like**?
entries.k: example 是可數名詞要冠詞——**an** example **of** ...；名詞別堆疊太長（Youtrack ticket content example → an example of the ticket content）；拼字 **YouTrack**（T 大寫）。

entries.o: update yt checklist
nat: Update **the** YouTrack checklist.
Could you update **the** acceptance checklist **on the ticket**?
entries.k: 特定那份清單要冠詞 **the**（同 Git 系列第 3 條 update **the** PR）；「工單上的」= **on the ticket**。

entries.o: could you take a look at SOCMSSPP-2070 "ELK index及欄位名稱清單" part, and replace the spec of foo
nat: Take a look at **the** "ELK index and field name list" **section of** SOCMSSPP-2070, and **update** `foo` **to match the new spec**.
Could you take a look at **the** "ELK index and field name list" **section of** SOCMSSPP-2070, and **update** `foo` **to match the new spec**?
entries.k: 「工單裡的某段」= **the ... section of** the ticket——名詞掛 part 直接接在單號後是中文語序，且要冠詞 **the**（文件段落慣用 **section**，part 偏口語模糊）；「換成新規格」= **update X to match the new spec**，或 **replace the old spec with the new one**（replace 只能搭 with，同 Could you・replace 系列）；take a look at 用得對（本系列第 1 條內化）。（原分類：慣用說法）

entries.o: go ahead, and open an issue for other project which use foo
nat: Go ahead, and open a ticket for **the other place** **that uses** `foo`.
Go ahead, and **file an issue to switch** **the** **other** `foo` **call site** **over to** the shared helper.
entries.k: 同一個 repo 裡的另一處程式碼是 **the other place / component / call site**——project 會被理解成「另一個專案」；**other 前面要 the**（指已知的那一個）；關係子句主詞單數動詞加 s——**that uses**（which use 少了 s，同文法結構的主詞動詞一致問題），描述程式碼慣用 that 不用 which；「開單追蹤某件待辦」可直接講目的 **file an issue to switch X over to Y**。（原分類：文法結構）

entries.o: look at SOCMSSPP-2059 and add foo
nat: **Take a look at** SOCMSSPP-2059 and add `foo`.
entries.k: 原句正確。look at 沒有錯；口語請人查看更常說 **take a look at**（也可 check out）。（原分類：慣用說法）

entries.o: create a vulnerability issue
nat: **Open** a ticket for the **Dependabot** vulnerabilities.
**File** an issue to track the **dependency** vulnerabilities.
entries.k: 原句文法正確；以下說法更明確。開單慣用動詞 **open / file** a ticket/issue（create 也通）；補來源讓對方不用猜——for the **Dependabot** vulnerabilities／the **dependency** vulnerabilities；冠詞 a ... issue 用得對。

entries.o: SOCSM-32977 將取代 BI mdr-gen
nat: SOCSM-32977 will **replace** **the** BI mdr-gen **dashboard**.
**The new** MDR **dashboard** from SOCSM-32977 **replaces** **the** Foo mdr-gen **page**.
entries.k: 「取代」日常用 **replace**，正式文件可用 **supersede**；受詞補上 **the ... dashboard / page**，只寫 BI mdr-gen 像在講代號；用工單號當主詞時，母語者常改成 **the new X from SOCSM-xxx** 讓句子有實體主詞。（原分類：慣用說法）

series.title: Other
notes: How can I show both the foo_key and bar_key names at the same time?
— 或更貼近情境的 "How do I map and display both SOC handler and MDR handler names in the same view?"

entries.o: post to yt
nat: Post it to the **YouTrack ticket**.
entries.k: post 及物要受詞——post **it**（缺受詞問題同文法結構・動詞與受詞系列）；yt 口語可、正式寫 **YouTrack ticket**（同第 2 條）。

entries.o: 濃縮精簡版本, I will address whether posting to yt
nat: Give **a condensed version** — **whether** **to post** it to the YouTrack ticket will be **decided** later.
Could you give me **a condensed version**? I'll **decide** later **whether** **to post** it to the YouTrack ticket.
entries.k: 「再決定要不要～」動詞用 **decide**（address 是「處理／回應」某問題或意見，同 Git 系列第 4 條 address the PR comment）；**whether 後接不定詞**——whether **to post**，不是 posting；「濃縮版」= **a condensed version**。

entries.o: 一起提交, is it necessary appending to youtrack ticket?
nat: Commit it together. Is it **necessary** **to append** it to **the** YouTrack ticket?
Does **the** YouTrack ticket need updating too?
entries.k: **necessary + to V**（it's necessary **to append**；同文法結構第 18 條 better **to move** 的不定詞規則）；append 及物要受詞 **it**；**the** YouTrack ticket（拼字同第 5、9 條）。（原分類：文法結構）

entries.o: do not open any issue, it decide by reviewer
nat: Don't open an issue — **that's the reviewer's call**.
**It's up to** the reviewer **to decide**.
entries.k: 被動要有 be 動詞＋過去分詞——it**'s decided** by（it decide 是主動原形的混用，同 Git 系列第 7 條的 is name）；「由某人決定」道地說法 **that's ~'s call** / **it's up to ~**。

entries.o: open a new youtrack ticket and branch, then do it
nat: Open **a** new **YouTrack** ticket and a branch, then do it.
entries.k: 並列的第二個可數名詞也要冠詞——a ticket and **a** branch；產品名拼 **YouTrack**（T 大寫，同第 5 條）；then do it 用得很口語自然。（原分類：介係詞與冠詞）

entries.o: checkout a new branch with SOCMSSPP-2104
nat: **Check out** a new branch **for** SOCMSSPP-2104.
Create a branch **for** SOCMSSPP-2104.
entries.k: 動詞是兩個字 **check out**（checkout 是名詞；同 Git 系列第 2 條，**第二次出現**）；「為某工單開分支」介係詞用 **for**，with 會變成「帶著工單一起」。（原分類：Git）

entries.o: SOCMSSPP-2177 if index=mdr-endpoint-* append these keys to Foo's Bar's baz
nat: **For SOCMSSPP-2177**: **when** the index is `mdr-endpoint-*`, append these keys to **the** `baz` **of the Bar inside Foo**.
entries.k: 條件句要完整——**when/if the index is** ...（index=... 是程式寫法，口說要補 the ... is）；兩層所有格 X's Y's Z 讀起來卡，改成 **the Z of Y inside X**；工單當前綴用 **For SOCMSSPP-2177:**。（原分類：文法結構）

subZh: props、state、元件與 composable 的講法

entries.o: would it be better using provide/inject to trans customer id instead of prop
nat: **Would it be better** **to use** provide/inject to **pass** the customer id **down** instead of **props**?
Should we provide/inject the customer id rather than drilling it through **props**?
entries.k: **would it be better** 後面接不定詞 **to** + 原形——better **to use**（better using 不成立，同第 193 條 would it be better save 少了 to，這次是多了 -ing，**第二次出現**）；「傳遞資料」動詞是 **pass (down)**，**trans** 不是英文單字（是中文縮寫式的省略，transfer / transmit 也不用在這裡）；「一層層用 prop 傳」有專門說法 **prop drilling**；**props** 指這種機制時用複數；the customer id 補冠詞。

entries.o: the component already has v-if="!foo(bar)" this guard, so this !baz(data) guard is unnecessary?
nat: The component already **has a** `v-if="!foo(bar)"` **guard**, so **isn't** the `!baz(data)` check **redundant**?
Given the `v-if` on `bar`, **do we still need the** `!baz(data)` **guard**?
entries.k: **has X this guard** 語序錯——名詞片語是 **has a … guard** 或 **already guards with …**，this 不能跟 a 疊著放；直述句加問號在英文裡是口語猜測語氣，要問「是不是多餘」用 **isn't X redundant?** 或 **do we still need X?**；「多餘」程式圈慣用 **redundant**，unnecessary 也對但少了「已經有別的東西擋著」的意思。

entries.o: fix foo props.data[0]
nat: Fix `foo` **so it doesn't rely on** `props.data[0]`.
Fix **the** `props.data[0]` **issue in** `foo`.
entries.k: **兩個名詞直接並列缺連接**——「修 X」與「問題在 Y」要用 **so it doesn't rely on Y** 或 **the Y issue in X** 接起來，否則對方看不出 Y 是問題所在還是要改成 Y（名詞疊放同第 106 條 with backend link to guideline 型）；更快的講法是直接說要改成什麼：**make `foo` use the first non-empty `result` instead of `props.data[0]`**。

entries.o: name props will confulse with defineProps
nat: **Having "props" in the name** **could be confused with** `defineProps`.
"**Props**" **clashes with** the component's `props` object.
entries.k: **confuse 要被動**——「X 會跟 Y 搞混」是 X **could be confused with** Y（主動 confuse 是「使人困惑」，主詞得是人或事情本身），或換成 **clash with / collide with**（命名衝突最常用）；「名字裡有 props」要講成 **having "props" in the name**，name props 兩個名詞疊放（同第 112 條）；confulse → **confuse** 拼字滑掉。

entries.o: add index
nat: Add **an** `index` **prop**.
Add **an** `index` **prop** **to** Foo, next to `bar`.
entries.k: 可數名詞要冠詞＋補名詞說清楚加的是什麼——add **an** index **prop**（同第 6 條 a validator、YouTrack 系列第 19 條 a copy function）；加在哪個元件用 **to**——to Foo。

entries.o: could you merge both foo and bar to one param?
nat: **Merge** `foo` and `bar` **into** a single **state property**.
Could you **merge** `foo` and `bar` **into** a single **state property**?
entries.k: **merge A and B into ...**（介係詞是 into 不是 to，同第 49 條 merge into，第二次出現）；Vuex state 的欄位叫 **state property/field**（param 專指函式參數）；merge **both** A and B 的 both 可省——A and B 已表兩者。

entries.o: can foo detect screen height?
nat: Can `foo` **adapt to** the screen height?
**Is there a way to make** `foo` **depend on** the **viewport height**?
entries.k: 文法正確，差在動詞——**detect** 是「偵測到某事發生」，主詞要是會感測的東西（a sensor detects、the code detects），一個數值 prop 不會 detect；「隨螢幕高度變」是 **adapt to / depend on / scale with the screen height**；問「有沒有辦法讓 X 做到 Y」的慣用句是 **Is there a way to make X do Y?**；前端講畫面高度時 **viewport height** 比 screen height 精準（screen 是整個螢幕，viewport 是瀏覽器可視區）。

entries.o: let's get rid of the foo and inline it
nat: **Get rid of** `foo` **and inline it**.
Let's **get rid of** `foo` **and inline it**.
Let's get rid of **the** `foo` **composable** and inline it.
entries.k: 專有名稱前**不加 the**；要加 the 就得補上名詞（the ... **composable**）。與第 51 條互補：「the ＋ 名稱 ＋ 類別名詞」或「裸名稱」擇一。

entries.o: could you replace the mode prop with the existing FOO param?
nat: Use the existing `FOO` **constant** **for** the `mode` prop.
Could you use the existing `FOO` **constant** **for** the `mode` prop?
entries.k: replace with 用對了（第 8、27 條的修正立刻活用）；`FOO` 是**常數 constant** 不是 param；換的是 prop 的「值」，說 use X **for** the prop 更精確。

entries.o: could you add the props demand in SOCMSSPP-2070
nat: Add the **requirement** for these props **to** SOCMSSPP-2070.
Could you add the **requirement** for these props **to** SOCMSSPP-2070?
entries.k: add ... **to**（不是 in，同文法結構第 6 條的 add to）；軟體「需求」慣用 **requirement**，demand 偏「索求／需求量」。
